jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **AI Engineer** Harpin AI \| Product Engineering ***Build Intelligent Systems That Deliver Measurable Outcomes*** At Harpin AI, we believe cutting\-edge engineering combined with autonomous development dramatically shortens the time between insight and impact. Rather than building in isolation and deploying months later, we design and prototype real customer workflows early and often beginning during initial customer engagements. AI agents help accelerate build, test, and iteration cycles, allowing us to deliver measurable value faster and build trust along the way. As an AI Engineer, you will join a dedicated product pod aligned to one of Harpin’s product families: * Clarity – Delivers trusted, board ready insights to complex business questions through extreme diagnosis * Concierge – Empowers frontline staff with autonomous decision support to drive superior CX \& personalization * Canon – Trusted data \+ our agentic intelligence creates a secure foundation for every decision and interaction You’ll work closely with Product Managers and engineers to design, prototype, and scale AI\-native capabilities embedded directly into enterprise workflows. ### **Our Current AI Stack** * Backend Framework: FastAPI (Python) with Uvicorn ASGI server * AI/LLM: Multi\-provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google — routed through a Portkey gateway (containerized) * Orchestration: LangGraph (state machine workflows) * Data/Query Engine: AWS Athena \+ AWS Glue (catalog) * Database: PostgreSQL 14\.5 (with SQLAlchemy ORM, Liquibase migrations) * Cloud Infrastructure: AWS (S3, SQS, Athena, Glue, Cognito for auth) — managed via Terraform For daily use, we use claude code, codex and cline heavily * ### **What You’ll Do** #### **Design Outcome\-Focused AI Systems** * Translate business objectives into AI\-powered workflows. * Build LLM\-driven features grounded in real enterprise data. * Integrate advanced proprietary machine learning AI models to augment capabilities in our products * Develop evaluation methods to measure quality, reliability, and business impact. * Apply Agentic \& Autonomous Development Techniques. * Design and implement multi\-step AI workflows (retrieval, reasoning, tool use). * Use AI\-assisted development to accelerate iteration and experimentation. * Implement guardrails and structured outputs to ensure enterprise\-grade reliability. #### **Engineer Context \& Data Grounding** * Build structured context pipelines using normalized enterprise data, embeddings, and vector search. * Design systems that maintain workflow state and continuity. * Ensure AI outputs are explainable, auditable, and aligned with customer data realities. #### **Rapid Prototyping \& Iteration** * Contribute to early\-stage prototypes during customer engagements. * Iterate quickly based on real\-world feedback from contact centers and marketing operations teams. * Help convert successful prototypes into scalable product capabilities. #### **Platform \& Systems Integration** * Develop backend services and APIs that support AI orchestration. * Work within cloud\-native environments to ensure performance, reliability, and security. * Collaborate across product pods to share reusable AI components and patterns. ### **What Makes This Role Unique** The way software is built is evolving quickly. AI\-assisted development and agentic systems are changing how teams design, test, and deliver solutions. ### **At Harpin:** * Engineers are empowered to design outcomes, not just implement requirements. * Customers experience working solutions earlier in the engagement cycle. * Feedback loops are fast and collaborative. * AI tools are leveraged thoughtfully to improve speed and quality. * We are building systems that operate inside real enterprise workflows where reliability, data grounding, and measurable impact matter. ### **What You Bring** * 3–7\+ years of experience in software engineering, applied AI, or ML systems. * Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered applications. * Strong skills in prompt engineering and structured output design. * Familiarity with RAG systems, embeddings, and vector databases. * Proficiency in Python and experience building APIs or backend services. * Comfort working in fast\-moving, collaborative environments. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience designing multi\-agent workflows. * LLM evaluation and testing frameworks. * Enterprise system integrations. * Startup or high\-growth company experience. ### **How We Measure Success** * Speed from concept to working prototype. * Reliability and business impact of AI\-powered workflows. * Quality and reusability of AI components. * Contribution to faster iteration cycles across product pods. ### **Who Thrives Here** * Engineers who enjoy building and iterating. * Problem\-solvers who connect technical design to business outcomes. * Collaborative builders who are excited about applying AI in real enterprise environments. * If you’re excited about designing intelligent systems that directly impact customer workflows, we’d love to talk.

jobs.title: AI Product Builder & Business Development Associate
jobs.description: Job Description Axon AI is a new startup building conversational AI products that make websites, resumes, presentations and business tools more intelligent and interactive. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with technology, AI tools and rapid product building. You do **not** need to be a traditional software engineer or write complex code from scratch. The right person should be able to take clear direction, work with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor or similar AI development platforms, and turn ideas into working products. Examples of the type of work include building and improving products such as the **Axon AI Interactive Resume**, conversational websites, AI powered presentations, business tools and other new applications built around the Axon AI platform. This role is not only technical. We are also looking for someone who is comfortable talking with potential customers, explaining the product clearly, helping generate sales and growing with the company. What You Would Do * Build and improve AI powered websites and digital products using modern AI development tools * Follow detailed instructions and turn concepts into working products * Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms * Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and web platforms when needed, even if AI tools assist with most of the coding * Test products, find problems and help improve the user experience * Learn the Axon AI platform and help develop new applications * Demonstrate Axon AI products to potential customers * Help identify potential customers and business opportunities * Assist with sales, outreach and customer follow up * Grow into a larger role as the company develops What We Are Looking For * Strong comfort level with computers and new technology * Experience using AI tools to build websites, applications or digital products * Ability to follow detailed instructions accurately * Good problem solving skills * Willingness to learn quickly and experiment * Strong communication skills * Comfortable speaking with potential customers * Entrepreneurial mindset * Reliable and able to work independently * Interested in joining an early stage company rather than simply completing isolated freelance projects Helpful Experience Experience with any of the following would be helpful but is not required: * Cursor * ChatGPT * Claude * Gemini * HTML and CSS * JavaScript * GitHub * Render or other web hosting platforms * Website development * AI agents or conversational AI * Voice AI * Sales or business development * Startup environments Compensation **Hourly or project based compensation to start, depending on experience, with the potential for increased responsibility, commissions and a larger long term role as Axon AI grows.** About Axon AI Axon AI builds conversational artificial intelligence that can be integrated into websites and other digital experiences. Instead of forcing users to search through pages, menus or traditional forms, Axon AI allows people to simply ask questions and interact naturally with the information. One example is the **Axon AI Interactive Resume**, which allows an employer to ask questions about a candidate’s professional history rather than simply reading a static resume. Ideal Candidate The ideal person is somewhere between a **technical builder and a salesperson**. You do not need to be a senior programmer. You do need to be comfortable using AI tools to build things, learning quickly, following directions and helping turn new ideas into real products and customers. We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with a new AI company**, not simply complete one assignment and disappear. Screening Question **Please briefly describe something you have built using ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, Gemini or another AI tool. It does not need to be a traditional software project. Tell us what you built, what tools you used and how much of the work you personally completed.** For the salary field, I would **not** put a full time salary yet. Put something like: Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: API and Data Infrastructure Engineer (Manufacturing Systems)
jobs.description: **API and Data Infrastructure Engineer (Manufacturing Systems)** ================================================================ **Location:** Grandview Heights, OH **Let’s get right to it** ------------------------- * **The mission:** Build the APIs, services, and data pipelines that connect machines and sensors to ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System—and the operator/engineer interfaces that depend on them. * **Why it matters:** As we scale, reliability, security, and performance are non‑negotiable. Your services will power real‑time insight and control for live manufacturing. * **Who you’ll work with:** Software engineers, robotics and controls engineers, manufacturing teams, and company leadership. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs for our manufacturing platform. * Define data models; operate SQL/NoSQL databases; run pipelines for machine, production, and operational data. * Integrate with controllers, sensors, third‑party tools, and our Universal Operating System. * Deliver secure, scalable REST and event‑driven endpoints for internal and front‑end consumers. * Power dashboards and visualizations that present real‑time equipment status and production performance. * Contribute to front‑end components in JavaScript/TypeScript with React (or similar) as needed to ship features. * Set service design patterns, architecture principles, and coding standards for long‑term scale. * Monitor and troubleshoot performance in development and live manufacturing environments. * Prototype fast based on feedback from operators, customers, and engineering teams. **Do you identify with the following?** --------------------------------------- * Backend‑minded, comfortable owning systems end‑to‑end—including the UI touchpoints when necessary. * Energized by turning physical manufacturing signals into clean services and trustworthy data. * Clear communicator across software, manufacturing, robotics, controls, and leadership. * Motivated by building robust infrastructure that runs in the real world. **Skills and experience** ------------------------- * Professional experience with backend services, APIs, or distributed systems. * Proficiency in one or more: Node.js, Python, Go, Java. * Database design and operations (SQL and/or NoSQL) with practical data modeling. * RESTful and/or event‑driven API development and integration. * Front‑end fluency: JavaScript/TypeScript with a framework like React sufficient to modify/build components. * Understanding of application architecture, service design, and state/data management. * Experience with real‑time/data‑rich systems (dashboards, telemetry, operational apps). * Strong debugging and problem‑solving skills across the stack. * Team‑based development experience. **Extras we value** ------------------- * Manufacturing software, industrial automation, robotics, machine interface, or real‑time systems exposure. * Experience with message queues, streaming data, or time‑series databases. * Interest in AI‑enabled systems for smarter manufacturing. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * Quick ramp on ForgeNest’s architecture and user workflows. * Ownership of critical services that raise reliability, scalability, and performance. * Clear, scalable architecture and development standards in place. * APIs that make building resilient interfaces straightforward—for our front‑end teams and for you. * Recognized as a trusted technical voice as the platform and org grow. **About ForgeNest** ------------------- We’re a venture‑backed startup modernizing forging with an AI‑driven, software‑first platform. By combining commercially available hardware, proprietary software, AI toolpath generation, and our Universal Operating System, we’re transforming how forged metal parts are designed and manufactured for defense, aerospace, energy, maritime, and industrial sectors. Join a small, high‑impact team where your code immediately influences advanced manufacturing, automation, and industrial technology.

jobs.title: Data Engineer with OCI Exp.
jobs.description: As a **Data Engineer with OCI**, you will be a part of an Agile team to build healthcare applications and implement new features while adhering to the best coding development standards. **Mandatory Technical skills: \-** **PySpark, Python, Advanced SQL, Big Data Processing, OCI** **Responsibilities: \-** * Design, develop, and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark, Python, and advanced SQL. * Build enterprise\-grade ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and consumption pipelines across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. * Design and operate cloud data solutions primarily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), while supporting platform evaluation or integration with Databricks and Snowflake where appropriate. * Process structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured content at scale, including document ingestion, metadata extraction, and entity extraction. * Engineer enterprise knowledge\-base pipelines using chunking, embeddings, vector stores, and graph databases to support search, retrieval, and agentic AI use cases. * Design reusable data models, lakehouse/warehouse structures, semantic layers, and data products for enterprise consumption. * Implement data quality, observability, lineage, governance, security, and incremental\-processing controls across the platform. * Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance for high\-volume data workloads. * Collaborate with data architects, AI teams, platform teams, business stakeholders, and client leadership to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Contribute hands\-on to development, code reviews, troubleshooting, production deployments, and technical design decisions. * Mentor engineers and support initial technical screening, solution discussions, and delivery planning.

jobs.title: Data Operations Associate - AI & Energy Data
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** --------------------- Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Data Operations Associate on a contract or full\-time basis to source, clean, and validate energy data. Your initial focus will be Ask The Grid, our live product for exploring the power grid, its markets, and its assets. You will use AI\-assisted research and coding to turn scattered information into dependable records and repeatable workflows. Judgment is central: you should be able to explain where a value came from, catch incorrect matches or unsupported claims, and decide what to verify, correct, or escalate. You will scope work with the founders and data engineering team, own sourcing and validation tasks, and collaborate with engineers on integrating the results into our products. Students, recent graduates, and early\-career candidates are welcome; projects, independent research, and freelance work can demonstrate the skills we need. **What you'll own** ------------------- * Find and evaluate public datasets, reports, websites, and APIs; document their coverage, definitions, freshness, and limitations. * Research and enrich energy\-asset records with traceable sources and clear treatment of unknowns. * Clean, standardize, deduplicate, and reconcile names, identifiers, units, and locations across sources. * Investigate missing or inconsistent data, trace the cause, and make corrections or escalate unresolved questions with evidence. * Build lightweight Python, SQL, or AI\-assisted extraction and validation workflows that another team member can inspect and run. * Maintain clear documentation and follow\-through on data requests, checks, and completed work. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on AI use: you already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or AI coding assistants to complete real work and can explain your contribution and checks. * Sound judgment about source reliability, entity matching, conflicting evidence, and uncertainty. * The ability to break an ambiguous task into steps, investigate discrepancies, and ask focused questions when needed. * Practical Python or SQL skills for cleanup, investigation, and simple automation, including with AI assistance. * Careful documentation and clear communication about decisions, quality checks, and limitations. * Curiosity about energy, infrastructure, geography, or complex real\-world systems. No particular degree or minimum number of years of experience is required. We care about evidence of useful work, clear thinking, and independent follow\-through. **First 90 days** ----------------- * 30 days: Understand our data conventions and complete an agreed research or cleanup task with traceable sources and documented checks. * 60 days: Deliver a repeatable sourcing or validation workflow and show how you verify its output. * 90 days: Own a recurring data workflow, communicate its limitations clearly, and propose a practical improvement to quality or efficiency. For contract work, we will agree milestones, acceptance criteria, and timing based on the scope and available hours. **Why join** ------------ You will work directly with a small technical team, see your work used in a live energy product, and build experience in AI\-assisted research, data quality, and practical automation. You will have responsibility for useful outcomes and room to grow as your skills and the work develop. **Location and compensation** ----------------------------- **Engagement:** Contract or full\-time employment. We can consider a full\-time hire from the outset or start with a part\-time contract. Contract work may grow into full\-time employment based on performance, company needs, and mutual fit. **Contract:** $30–$40 USD per hour, initially approximately 10–15 hours per week. Scope, hours, and schedule will be agreed before work begins. Remote contractors may be considered. **Full\-time:** $65,000–$85,000 USD annual base salary. Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge, with in\-person collaboration three days per week, consistent with our other full\-time roles. Compensation within each range depends on demonstrated skills and agreed scope. No equity is included in contract work; any full\-time equity would be discussed separately as part of the offer. **How to apply** ---------------- Share a resume or relevant project links, an example of real work completed with AI, and how you verified the result. Include your location, availability, preferred contract or full\-time arrangement, and compensation expectations. Our process includes a short conversation, a paid 60–90\-minute practical data exercise with AI encouraged, and a discussion of your sources, decisions, and quality checks.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technology Solutions Engineer (AI & Automation)
jobs.description: About Linea Energy Linea Energy is a leading independent power company dedicated to developing, building, and operating renewable energy projects across the Americas. Our mission is to provide sustainable energy solutions that empower communities and drive the transition to a clean energy future. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, Linea Energy is committed to innovation, excellence, and the highest standards of environmental stewardship. About the Position We are seeking an Enterprise Technology Solutions Engineer to join Linea Energy on a full\-time basis, preferably based in any of our existing office locations: Austin, TX, Chicago, IL, or San Francisco, CA. The successful candidate will own the design, build, and deployment of AI\-driven automations and custom internal applications that eliminate manual work across development, legal, finance, GIS, and execution teams. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise architecture, software development, and business operations, with a strong emphasis on agentic workflows, LLM\-powered automation, and rapid AI\-assisted development. The ideal candidate will be resourceful, technically versatile, and comfortable working across disciplines in a fast\-paced renewable energy environment, and will also share responsibility for technology operations, administration, and security for the company’s information technology environment. Responsibilities and Essential Functions * Key individual within company responsible for enterprise software architecture and solutions * AI Automation and Agentic Workflows: Design, build, and operate AI\-powered automations and agent\-based workflows (using LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and workflow platforms) that connect to the systems where work already happens, such as Sitetracker/Salesforce, SharePoint and Microsoft 365, Notion, financial and data\-room platforms, and document repositories. Prioritize automations by business impact and measure hours saved, accuracy, and adoption. * Application Development: Design, build, and maintain custom internal tools and applications using Python and JavaScript that put AI automations in the hands of development, legal, GIS, finance, and execution teams. * AI\-Assisted Development: Leverage modern AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver production\-quality software, applying appropriate testing, code review, and deployment discipline to AI\-generated code. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with stakeholders across the organization to identify high\-value automation opportunities, map current workflows, gather requirements, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Train and support employees in adopting AI tools and automated workflows. * Enterprise Integration: Build and maintain integrations between internal systems of record, cloud services, and third\-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, and MCP connectors to streamline data flows and reduce manual processes, with attention to reliability, monitoring, and error handling. * GIS and Spatial Applications: Develop or enhance GIS\-enabled applications, spatial data pipelines, and automated spatial analyses to support energy project siting, analysis, and reporting. * Code Quality and Version Control: Maintain clean, well\-documented codebases using Git, participate in code reviews, and follow best practices for collaborative development, including testing and evaluation of AI\-driven workflows. * AI Governance and Data Protection: Help define and enforce policies for responsible AI use, including approved tools and models, data classification, handling of confidential project, financial, and counterparty information, prompt\-injection and data\-leakage safeguards, human\-in\-the\-loop review for high\-risk automations, and logging and auditability of automated actions. * Cloud Infrastructure: Deploy and manage applications, automations, and services within Azure cloud environments, including VMs, app services, functions, and data storage, along with access control, cost monitoring (including AI/LLM usage costs), backups, and patching. * Technology Operations and Administration: Serve as a technical resource for select IT operations, help manage the IT consultant, and support escalated end\-user technical issues. * Security and Access Management: Apply and help maintain security best practices, including multi\-factor authentication, least\-privilege access, periodic access reviews, and secure handling of credentials and secrets across applications and cloud resources. * Documentation and Vendor Coordination: Document systems, automations, configurations, and support procedures, and coordinate with third\-party IT providers, AI and software vendors on evaluation, licensing, renewals, and issue resolution. Qualifications and Key Skills * 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, automation engineering, or a related technical role, including hands\-on delivery of production automations or applications. * Demonstrated experience building AI\-powered automations or agentic workflows, including working with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt and context design, tool use/function calling, and MCP or comparable integration frameworks. * Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with experience building web applications, APIs, and internal tools, and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs and webhooks. * Demonstrated experience with AI\-assisted software development tools and workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar). * Proficiency with Git and modern version control practices. * Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure (VMs, App Services, Functions, DevOps, or similar), and with securing service accounts, API keys, and secrets. * Comfort troubleshooting technical issues and supporting non\-technical users. * Preferred: GIS experience (ArcGIS Pro (Esri Suite), ArcPy, PostGIS, or spatial data libraries). * Preferred: Prior experience in energy development, ideally renewable energy (wind, solar, or storage). * Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Preferred: Experience with low\-code and workflow automation platforms (Power Platform/Power Automate, n8n, Zapier, or similar); administration of enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce/Sitetracker, or ArcGIS Online/Enterprise; scripting for administrative automation (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API); and Microsoft or Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-104, MS\-102, AI\-102\). Compensation and Location * Job Type: Full\-Time. * Compensation: Competitive salary and benefits commensurate with experience. * Location: Austin, TX, Chicago, IL, or San Francisco, CA preferred. Remote candidates will be considered for exceptional applicants. Equal Opportunity Employment Linea Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, arrest record, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Our management team is committed to this policy in all aspects of employment.

pumps, light plants, trailers, attachments, and specialty construction equipment. **Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to understand mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical systems. * CAD design experience and ability to develop fabrication drawings. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate mechanical failures. * Ability to communicate effectively with mechanics, operators, superintendents, project teams, and management. * Ability to communicate and collaborate cross\-departmentally with Fleet, Operations, Estimating, Project Management, and leadership. * Willingness to work in shops and active construction environments and travel to R\-2 jobsites and shop locations. * Ability to manage projects from concept through implementation. * Must be a team player, organized, self\-driven, and capable of balancing field needs with engineering discipline. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. jobs.title: Founding Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP shows up in the world. We're defining a category as it forms — how enterprises put AI agents to work without handing over the keys — and you're the one who turns a deep, fast\-moving technical product into a story that engineers, security leaders, and buyers actually get. This is a founding role, so you own the whole arc. You'll set our messaging and narrative, the source of truth for what we say, to whom, and why it matters, and you'll hold it steady as the product and the market move underneath you. You'll drive launches end to end, from narrative to release to follow\-through, staying close enough to customers to carry each release from beta to broad availability and own how activated people are on what ships. You'll turn customers like Coursera, Stability AI, and Modern Treasury into case studies and proof. You'll establish MintMCP's point of view on agent governance and get it heard through thought leadership, the SEO/AEO engine, and the agencies that scale it. And you'll build the sales content system that equips our AEs with the collateral they own for prospects and customers. You'll scale yourself with MintMCP’s team of coworker agents (our own product). You'll sit with engineers to learn how the product really works and with customers to hear how it lands, and turn both into differentiated, jargon\-free messaging. Do it well and MintMCP's story becomes the one the whole category gets described in. **About You** ------------- * 5\+ years in product marketing, ideally with technical or infrastructure products. * A strong writer and storyteller who can turn deep technical capability into a clear narrative. * You can sit with engineers and customers, absorb deep technical detail, and turn it into differentiated, jargon\-free messaging. * A strategic thinker — you set positioning and priorities, make sharp trade\-offs about what *not* to do, and tie marketing back to company goals. * Agent\-native — you use Claude and agents to scale your own output, with the judgment to tell a differentiated, on\-strategy idea from one that only sounds good. * Well organized — the scope is broad, and you'll wrangle engineers, internal teams, customers, and agencies at once without letting things slip. * Bias to ship — you can run a launch and move fast. * A track record you can point to: a product or category you positioned, a launch you ran, and the results that followed. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with MCP, AI agents, or enterprise security. * You know the CIO, CISO, and platform/IT buyer — you've marketed to them and know how they evaluate. * Fluent across the content and search stack — SEO and AEO, editorial calendars, and briefing and managing agencies or freelancers. * You've been an early marketing hire or built a function from scratch — comfortable creating structure where there's little. **Details** ----------- In person, San Mateo and San Francisco. Competitive salary and meaningful early\-stage equity (add a range before posting). To apply: email hiring@mintmcp.com and tell us why you're interested.

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Tereina** Tereina is on a mission to revolutionize B2B payments. We're a well\-funded, early\-stage startup, supported by SAP, building cutting\-edge solutions that will transform the way businesses move money. Our platform handles cross\-border payment processing, counterparty management, bank account administration, and compliance workflows for enterprise customers worldwide. Our Security Operations function keeps that platform — and the money and data that move through it — secure. Tereina runs on Java and Spring Boot microservices on Google Kubernetes Engine, built and shipped through automated CI/CD pipelines, and operates under the security and compliance expectations of our banking partners, enterprise customers, and SOC 2\. Security Operations finds risk across our cloud, build, and runtime environments and drives it to resolution —through automation — and owns our security audit program, from SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through internal audits and partner and customer assessments. **About the Role** Reporting to our head of Technology Operations, the Security Operations Engineer will be part of the team that owns Tereina's daily security operations and help lead our security audit and compliance program. You will help harden our cloud and CI/CD infrastructure and work with engineering teams to maintain secure environments. You will be a point person for security operations; you will identify potential issues before they become actual issues. You will continue to automate our pipeline from finding identification through to resolution, and you will guide our security practice as we increase our scale and scope. You will also lead audits, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and our internal audit program, and serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors, banking partners, and enterprise customers on security and compliance. You will partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Compliance to turn findings into clear, prioritized remediation work and to keep our controls continuously audit\-ready. **Key Responsibilities** * **Cloud Security Posture:** Assess, triage, and resolve Security Command Center findings across our GCP environments, hardening cloud infrastructure and configuration. * **Vulnerability Management:** Review CVEs and drive remediation efforts throughout the build and runtime environments — from application dependencies and container images to the infrastructure they run on. * **Pinpointed Remediation:** Turn automated scanner findings into precise code, library, and configuration change requirements that engineering teams can act on quickly. * **Security Automation:** Automate the tools, services, and code build and inspection steps that take a finding from identification to resolution, reducing manual effort and time to remediate. * **CI/CD Hardening:** Strengthen the security of our build pipelines and the artifacts they produce, embedding scanning and checks directly into how we ship software. * **Proactive Risk Identification:** Act as the point person for security operations, spotting emerging risks early and raising them before they become incidents. * **Security Practice Leadership:** Guide and evolve our security practices, standards, and tooling as Tereina grows in scale and scope. * **External Audit Leadership:** Lead audits as required, including SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits end to end — scoping, readiness, evidence collection, auditor walkthroughs, and remediation of exceptions — and manage the relationship with our audit firms and coordinate internal resources. * **Internal Audit Program:** Plan and run regular internal audits and control testing against SOC 2, ISO 27001, and our own policies, tracking findings through to closure. * **Auditor \& Partner Point of Contact:** Serve as the primary point of contact for auditors, and support security reviews, questionnaires, and due diligence from banking partners and enterprise customers. * **Controls \& Evidence Automation:** Own our security control framework, policies, and risk register, and automate evidence collection so we stay continuously audit\-ready rather than preparing once a year. * **Cross\-team Collaboration:** Work with Engineering, DevOps, Compliance, and leadership across time zones to keep environments secure and embed control requirements into how we build and operate. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 5\+ years in security operations, security engineering, or DevSecOps, including hands\-on ownership of cloud and application security in a production environment. * **Audit Leadership:** Proven experience leading SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001 audits and acting as the primary point of contact for external auditors, plus experience planning and running internal audits. * **Controls \& Frameworks:** Strong working knowledge of security control frameworks (SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, ISO 27001 Annex A), including designing controls, writing policies, and preparing audit evidence. * **Java \& Gradle:** Hands\-on experience with Java and Gradle, with the ability to turn automated fault findings into pinpointed code and library change requirements. * **Vulnerability Scanning:** Experience with vulnerability and code scanning tools such as SonarQube, GitHub Dependabot, or Amazon Inspector. * **Tooling \& Automation:** Ability to write and maintain security tooling and automation in Node.js or Python. * **Systems Fundamentals:** Strong working knowledge of shell scripting, Unix/Linux, and networking. * **AI Tooling Proficiency:** Fluent use of modern AI assistants (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to build and maintain tooling and automation. * **Ownership \& Judgment:** Self\-directed and proactive, with the judgment to prioritize risk and drive remediation to completion. * **Communication \& Influence:** Able to explain security findings, control gaps, and their impact clearly to engineers, leadership, auditors, and external partners — and to drive remediation across teams you don't manage. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with GCP Security Command Center. * Experience with Jenkins, GCP Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or similar build pipelines. * Experience in payments, banking, fintech, or another regulated financial environment, including partner and customer security due diligence. * Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, or similar). * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer. * Experience working with global development and operations teams. **Why Join?** * **Growth:** Own the platform and the operations function end\-to\-end, and expand your scope across new products, rails, partners, and markets as we scale. * **Impact:** Shape how payments operations scale at a fast\-moving B2B payments company. * **Innovation:** Work at the intersection of payments operations and AI\-enabled automation. * **Culture:** Join a collaborative team that values curiosity, inclusion, and sustainable work. We are looking for curious, driven builders who want to create secure, scalable, user\-friendly payments products. If you do not meet every qualification but bring initiative and a growth mindset, we encourage you to apply. We embrace AI as a powerful tool for innovation and welcome team members eager to leverage it in their work. As an equal opportunity employer, we're committed to diversity, inclusion, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Compensation Range: $140K \- $170K

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: ### **About harpin AI** harpin AI is a high\-growth startup on a mission to help enterprise clients unlock the hidden value of their data. We solve the most critical hurdle in AI: data integrity. **Our Pedigree**: Our founding team built the Disney MagicBand and Carnival’s Ocean Medallion, two of the most complex personalized guest experience systems ever deployed. They learned firsthand that the hardest problem isn’t the AI, it’s the data underneath it. harpin AI exists to solve that problem at scale. **The Proof**: This isn’t a lab; these are real outcomes. Princess Cruises cut handle time by 38%, Belami eCommerce grew CLTV by 16%, and our deployments are delivering 40%\+ data quality improvement across enterprise systems already “in production.” #### **The Short Version** harpin AI turns messy, fragmented contact center data into intelligent systems that actually work: real\-time routing, AI\-powered agent assist, identity resolution across channels. We’re a \~80\-person company where product decisions have immediate, measurable impact on how millions of customer interactions play out every day. ### **Position Overview** As a Principal/Senior Product Manager at harpin AI, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our products and driving the company’s success. You will be the primary advocate for our customers, leading the strategic vision, development, and execution of our product. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership and make impactful decisions that will shape the direction of the company. **Position Location:** Remote **Reports to:** CPO **Travel Required**: Up to 25% (Customer Meetings, Trade Shows, Company Events) We’re hiring a Principal or Sr Level Product Manager to own some of the hardest problems in the contact center AI space. Not to manage a backlog. Not to write tickets. To discover what customers actually need, validate it fast, and ship solutions that create durable competitive advantage. If you’ve spent your career turning deep customer insight and technical intuition into products that changed how an industry works and you want to do it again with AI that’s rewriting the rules in real time, keep reading. ### **What You’ll Actually Do** **Own outcomes, not roadmaps.** You’ll be accountable for solving specific, meaningful customer problems not for shipping a list of features on a timeline. Your success is measured by whether customers’ businesses improve, not by whether you hit a release date. **Run continuous discovery.** You’ll spend real time with contact center leaders, agents, and operations teams not to “gather requirements” but to develop a deep, evolving understanding of how work actually happens, where value is lost, and where intelligent systems can fundamentally change outcomes. You’ll validate ideas before they become commitments. **Lead an empowered product team.** You’ll work as a true trio with engineering and design, not handing specs over a wall, but solving problems together. Your engineering partners are building with AI\-native tools and moving fast. You need to match that pace with equally rigorous discovery and decision\-making. **Make hard calls with imperfect information.** Which problems are worth solving? What’s a real signal versus noise? When does a forward\-deployed experiment become a scalable product? When do you kill something that’s not working? You’ll make these decisions constantly, and you’ll be right often enough that the team trusts your judgment. **Bridge the gap between AI capability and customer value.** The contact center space is being flooded with AI promises. Most of it is vaporware or science projects. You’ll figure out where machine learning, real\-time inference, and intelligent automation create genuine, defensible value and just as importantly, where they don’t. **Turn bespoke into repeatable.** Harpin works deeply with enterprise customers. Some of the best product ideas start as one\-off solutions. You’ll identify which innovations deserve to become standardized capabilities, define what “productized” means, and ensure the transition happens without losing what made the original solution valuable. ### **What Makes This Role Different** **AI isn’t a feature here, it’s the product.** You’re not bolting ML onto an existing SaaS platform. You’re building systems where intelligence *is* the value. That means product decisions and model decisions are inseparable, and you need the technical depth to navigate both. **You’ll feel your impact.** At our scale, a single product decision can shift the trajectory of the company. You won’t spend months navigating org politics to get something approved. You’ll spend that time in discovery, prototyping, and learning. **The CEO and CPO believe in empowered teams.** This isn’t a company where “product\-led” is a slide in a deck. Leadership is actively building toward a model where product teams own problems end\-to\-end. You’ll have real autonomy and real accountability. **The domain is deep and the problems are hard.** Contact centers sit at the intersection of real\-time systems, human behavior, messy data, and high\-stakes customer interactions. If you like problems with genuine technical and behavioral complexity, this is it. ### **You Might Be the Right Person If…** * You’ve shipped AI/ML\-powered products that customers actually use and pay for: not demos, not pilots, products at scale. * You’ve operated in product discovery environments: performing customer interviews, rapid prototyping, experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making not just prioritization frameworks. * You have strong opinions about where AI creates real value in enterprise workflows versus where it’s theater, and you can articulate why. * You’ve worked in or around contact centers, customer experience, identity resolution, or adjacent domains and you understand the operational realities, not just the technology. * You’ve navigated the tension between enterprise customer needs and building scalable, repeatable product and you have a philosophy for when to customize and when to say no. * You communicate with precision. You write clearly. You can hold a room of executives or a room of engineers with equal credibility. * You’ve done this for 7\+ years and you’re looking for a place where your judgment, speed, and depth will be the difference between a good company and a great one. ### **Relevant Technical Context** You don’t need expertise in all of these, but familiarity with several signals that you’ll ramp fast: * Identity resolution and entity matching across fragmented data sources * Real\-time ML inference (routing, next\-best\-action, recommendation systems) * Contact center ecosystems: CCaaS, CRM, WFM, QM platforms and how they interconnect * Connector/integration architecture for enterprise environments * AI agent frameworks — copilots, agent assist, autonomous workflows * Multi\-touch attribution and customer lifetime value modeling * B2B Enterprise experience ### **What We Offer** * Equity (stock options) you’re building this with us * Competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401K * PTO and paid holidays * A product leadership team that’s serious about doing this the right way * Hard problems worth solving, with real customers who care about the outcomes *Harpin AI is building the intelligence layer for contact centers. If you want to do the best product work of your career in a space where AI is creating genuine, measurable value not just hype — we’d like to talk.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Edge Controller & Integrations
jobs.description: **About Xsponse** Xsponse builds a life\-safety platform that helps organizations detect threats, communicate critical information, and respond quickly. Its local controllers continue operating when internet connectivity is unavailable, so reliability and security are essential. **The Role** We’re looking for a mid\- to senior\-level software engineer to develop and support the Linux\-based controller at the core of our platform. Working with our Backend Controller Architect, you’ll build controller features, integrate devices and services, and improve reliability across software, networks, and cloud\-connected systems. Remote work is available for a senior candidate. We prefer someone based in Central Washington or the Dallas area. This role includes a 24/7 on\-call rotation for critical production incidents. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Python applications and services on Linux. * Develop REST APIs, database services, and reusable integration frameworks. * Integrate third\-party devices, software, and cloud services. * Troubleshoot issues across software, networks, databases, devices, and cloud services. * Improve monitoring, logging, recovery, testing, and diagnostic tools. * Participate in design and code reviews, release validation, and technical documentation. * Respond to critical incidents, find root causes, and help prevent repeat problems. Example projects include door\-status alerts, communications directories, audio\-stream support, and tools for controller deployment and remote support. **Required Qualifications** * Professional software development experience, with strong Python skills. * Experience with REST APIs, databases, AWS, and Linux. * Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS. * Experience troubleshooting production or distributed systems. * Ability to build maintainable, testable, fault\-tolerant software. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively. * Willingness to participate in on\-call coverage and respond promptly to critical incidents. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with edge computing, IoT, embedded systems, third\-party integrations, audio streaming, event\-driven systems, Linux deployments, automated testing, or high\-availability products. **What We’re Looking For** A hands\-on engineer who takes ownership, works well across software and hardware boundaries, and approaches life\-safety software with urgency and care. Pay: $85,400\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) 4% Match * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Prosper, TX 75078

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Linux Kernel
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. Efficient Computer is building the next generation of energy efficient, general\-purpose processors designed around the Fabric architecture, a novel spatial dataflow design spun out from decades of fundamental SOC research at CMU. We are looking for a Senior Staff Linux Kernel Driver Engineer to own the kernel\-mode driver that brings our Fabric to life. You will bring up new silicon from the very first boot, often before the silicon exists, working in QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, and FPGA environments to make sure our runtime software layers work on day one. This is a key role for the System Software team: you will work closely with architecture, micro\-architecture, verification and compiler teams during pre\-silicon development and bring\-up. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Own the Kernel Driver** * Design, implement, and maintain the Linux kernel\-mode driver for the Fabric accelerator. This includes device discovery and probe, MMIO register interfaces, interrupt handling, command and completion queue management, power management, firmware, chip diagnostics, logging and device health, as well as abstracting the user\-space ABI with a HAL that the runtime depends on. * Define how custom hardware accelerators are exposed to Linux: ioctl and sysfs interfaces, and the submission and synchronization model between application cores and the Fabric. * Keep the driver clean, upstreamable in style, and portable across kernel and device versions. * Implement the unified memory model between ARM cores and the Fabric accelerator. * Own SMMU (IOMMU) integration: stream and context configuration, tensor pool allocation, page table management, stage\-1 and stage\-2 translation, shared virtual addressing, and fault handling. ### **Drive Pre\-Silicon Bringup and Platform Enablement** * Build and maintain QEMU device models and board definitions for the Fabric and its SoC so that the kernel, driver, and runtime can be developed and tested before silicon. * Own the Linux boot path on new platforms: boot firmware handoff, device tree, kernel configuration, early console, and root filesystem, from the first boot in emulation through FPGA prototypes to production silicon. * Lead kernel\-side bring up on first silicon: validating MMIO map, interrupts, clocks, resets, and memory against the hardware specification, and turning what you find into bug reports and design feedback for the hardware team. * Be the go\-to engineer for kernel debugging across the stack: crash dumps, KGDB and JTAG, ftrace and perf, lockdep and KASAN, and the hard\-to\-reproduce hangs and memory corruptions that only show up on real hardware. * Establish kernel\-level test coverage, including driver unit tests, emulation\-based regression suites, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. a plus. * **7\+ years** of systems software experience, including **significant hands\-on Linux kernel\-mode driver development** for complex devices (accelerators, GPUs, NPUs, networking, or storage). * Deep understanding of Linux kernel memory management, including cache coherence, IOMMU/SMMU configuration, and unified or shared virtual memory between CPU and accelerators. * Hands\-on experience with QEMU, emulation, or simulation environments, including writing or extending device models and board definitions. * Experience with pre\-silicon hardware bring up and first\-silicon enablement, working from hardware specifications and register maps before the platform is stable. * Experience designing runtime interfaces between kernel and user space: ABI and HAL design, synchronization, memory sharing, and error handling. * Strong kernel debugging skills across crash analysis, tracing, hardware debuggers, and race and memory\-corruption diagnosis. * Fluency with memory\-mapped I/O: register\-level programming, ordering and barrier semantics, and interrupt handling. * Experience interfacing custom hardware accelerators to Linux. * Strong experience with ARM cores and the ARM architecture (AArch64, exception levels, GIC, SMMU, cache and memory attributes). * Solid understanding of the Linux boot flow: boot firmware, device tree, kernel initialization, and early platform enablement. * Expert C and strong scripting skills; comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools for code, analysis, and debugging. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with FPGA prototyping and hardware emulation platforms (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce, or similar). * Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures, and of how compilers and runtimes target them. * Experience on a first\-generation silicon product, where the software stack and the hardware matured together. * Experience working on a CUDA, ROCm, or other language runtime software stack. We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $220,000 to $270,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Linux Runtime & Drivers
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. Efficient Computer is building the next generation of energy efficient, general\-purpose processors designed around the Fabric architecture, a novel spatial dataflow design spun out from decades of fundamental SOC research at CMU. We are looking for a Senior Staff Linux Runtime Software Engineer to own the user\-mode components that interface with the Fabric and support the effcc compiler. This includes owning the user\-mode driver, interfacing with our kernel mode driver, as well as defining the HAL interface exposed by the Fabric ABI. You will be working within pre\-silicon environments, involving QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, and FPGAs to ensure applications run on day one. This is a key role for the System Software team. As such, you will work closely with the compiler, kernel driver, architecture, micro\-architecture, and verification teams during all phases of development. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Own the Runtime Library and User\-Mode Driver** * Design, implement, and maintain the user\-mode runtime driver for the Fabric accelerator. This is a critical shared library which sits between the compiler and the Fabric ABI. This library implements context management, program loading, resource management, command queue construction and submission, descriptor allocation and setup, streaming, completion queue/event synchronization, error handling, logging, memory allocation, as well as general library support. * Design and implement all user\-mode interfaces between the compiler, the Fabric ABI, and the kernel mode driver. * Define the in\-memory representations generated by the compiler and consumed by the Fabric. * Design and implement the underlying runtime library support and interfaces needed by 3rd party ML framework backends used by PyTorch, ONNX, and/or TensorFlow. * Lead the user\-mode efforts to bring up on first silicon. This includes being comfortable with functional simulation, emulation and FPGA environments. * Establish runtime test coverage, including API unit and conformance tests, emulation\-based regression suites, performance benchmarks, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. a plus. * **7\+ years** of systems software experience, including **significant hands\-on Linux user\-mode driver as well as language runtime library development** for accelerators (GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, FPGAs, or similar). * Experience building or contributing to a production accelerator runtime software stack, from the driver API up through the user\-facing runtime library. * Solid understanding of accelerator memory models, in particular unified memory systems, allocators, and zero\-copy data paths. * Experience designing public APIs exposed by runtime libraries: ABI stability, versioning, error models, thread safety, and documentation. * Experience working with compiler teams on binary formats, loaders, launch ABIs, and kernel metadata, for ahead\-of\-time or just\-in\-time compilation. * Experience integrating runtimes with language runtimes or ML frameworks: Python bindings, framework backends or execution providers, and C/C\+\+ application interfaces. * Hands\-on experience with QEMU, emulation, or simulation environments during pre\-silicon development. * Experience designing interfaces between kernel and user space: ABI and HAL design, synchronization, memory sharing, and error handling. * Strong user\-mode debugging skills across crash analysis, sanitizers, tracing, profiling, and race and synchronization diagnosis. * Working knowledge of ARM/AArch64 Linux systems and the Linux driver model. * Expert C and C\+\+ and strong Python skills; comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools for code, analysis, and debugging. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience contributing to CUDA Runtime (cudart), ROCm (HIP, ROCr, HSA), the Tenstorrent runtime (TT\-Metalium), oneAPI Level Zero, OpenCL, or another accelerator runtime software stack. * Familiarity with LLVM or MLIR, and with how compilers for accelerators hand off to runtimes. * Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures, and of how compilers and runtimes target them. * Experience on a first\-generation silicon product, where the software stack and the hardware matured together. * Experience with FPGA prototyping and hardware emulation platforms (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce, or similar). We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $220,000 to $270,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** ------------- * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*
