jobs.title: Software Engineer - Payment Team
jobs.description: **About Tereina** Tereina is on a mission to revolutionize B2B payments. We're a well\-funded, early\-stage startup supported by one of the largest software companies in the world, SAP. We're building cutting\-edge solutions that will transform the way businesses move money. Our platform handles cross\-border payment processing, counterparty management, bank account administration, and compliance workflows for enterprise customers worldwide. The Payment Team owns how money moves through Tereina — from payment initiation and validation through routing, execution with our banking and payment partners, and status tracking all the way back to the customer. We're a team of five engineers today and growing, and we already integrate with several payment processors across domestic, international, and real\-time (RTP/FedNow) rails. Our payment services are built on Java and Spring Boot microservices running on Kubernetes, with Google Pub/Sub messaging and Apache Camel integration pipelines at their core. **About the Role** As a Software Engineer on the Payment Team, you will build and operate the services that carry a payment from the moment a customer's ERP submits it to the moment funds reach the beneficiary. You will report to the Engineering Manager – Payment Team and work alongside senior engineers and an architect on the two services at the heart of our money flow: * **Payment Request:** intake of payment batches over REST and ISO 20022 (pain.001\), validation and entity resolution, sanctions and AML screening, rules\-driven routing, FX\-locked multi\-step instruction plans, scheduling into rail\-specific execution windows, and pain.002 status reporting back to the customer. * **Payment Execution:** signed instruction intake, fund verification and reservation in a double\-entry ledger, dispatch through processor adapters across ACH, wire, real\-time (RTP/FedNow), SEPA, Faster Payments, and digital\-asset rails, settlement and return tracking from processor events, reconciliation, and CAMT.052/053 account reporting. You will ship features end to end, help bring new banks and payment processors onto the platform, and share responsibility for production health with the rest of the team. It's a role for an engineer who wants to go deep on how money actually moves — and who cares that every payment is correct, traceable, and on time. **Your First Months** * **Day 1:** Ship your first commit to a payment service. * **Week 1:** Get both payment services running locally, follow a payment end to end from request intake to settlement in our dev environment, and join the team's stand\-ups and design reviews. * **Month 1:** Deliver your first feature or fix to production and shadow an on\-call shift. * **Month 3:** Own a feature end to end — such as a new validation rule, a routing change, or a processor adapter enhancement — and join the on\-call rotation. * **Month 6:** Contribute to a new processor or rail integration from sandbox certification through go\-live, and become a go\-to person for an area of the payment flow. **Key Responsibilities** * **Payment Flow Development:** Implement and evolve features across payment request and payment execution — validation rules, routing decisions, instruction planning, funding, dispatch, and status tracking — in Java and Spring Boot microservices. * **Processor \& Bank Integrations:** With guidance from senior engineers and the architect, build and maintain adapters for banking partners and payment processors, including API\- and webhook\-based connectivity, rail\-specific rules, sandbox certification, and feature\-flagged production go\-lives. * **Correctness by Design:** Write code that is idempotent, safe to redeliver, and auditable — enforced state\-machine transitions, duplicate\-submission guards, signed instructions, and full revision history. * **Ledger \& Reconciliation:** Contribute to ledger postings and fund\-state transitions (pending, clearing, settlement, return) and to the reconciliation that keeps our books matched against provider balances. * **Exceptions \& Operations Tooling:** Help improve how failed and held payments are surfaced, explained, and resolved — clear error codes, operator actions such as reprocess, fail, and return, and internal tooling that lets Payment Operations act quickly. * **Code Quality:** Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end — and contribute to design reviews and technical documentation. * **Production Ownership:** Monitor service health and take part in incident response and root\-cause analysis. On\-call rotates across the team, and we aim for follow\-the\-sun coverage across our time zones, though you may occasionally be asked to jump in on an emergency. * **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Work with Product, Payment Operations, Quality Engineering, and the Platform, SAP Integrations, and UX teams — as well as engineers at our banking and payment partners. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 3\+ years in software engineering, with experience building and running backend systems and APIs in production. * **Technical Foundation:** Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including SQL and schema migrations. * **Distributed Systems:** Working knowledge of message\-driven systems — publish/subscribe, queues, retries, dead\-lettering — and of idempotency, consistency, and failure handling. * **AI Tooling Proficiency:** Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and the ability to use them to improve engineering speed, quality, and impact. * **Communication \& Collaboration:** Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional, distributed team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Exposure to payments and money movement — payment lifecycles, settlement, returns, and exceptions * Experience with payment rails such as ACH, wires, SWIFT, real\-time (RTP/FedNow), SEPA, or Faster Payments * Familiarity with ISO 20022 messages (pain.001, pain.002, camt.052/053\) * Experience with Apache Camel or other enterprise integration frameworks, and with Google Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar messaging * Exposure to rules engines or decision tables (e.g., DMN/Drools) and explicit state\-machine modeling * Experience with double\-entry ledgers, fund reservation, or financial reconciliation * Understanding of secure API design, handling of sensitive financial data, and compliance requirements such as sanctions/AML screening and SOC 2 * Familiarity with Kubernetes, GCP, observability tooling, and CI/CD * Exposure to cross\-border payments, FX, multi\-currency money movement, or digital\-asset/stablecoin settlement * Familiarity with SAP ERP payment processes **Why Join?** * **Growth:** Own the platform and the operations function end\-to\-end, and expand your scope across new products, rails, partners, and markets as we scale. * **Impact:** Shape how payments operations scale at a fast\-moving B2B payments company. * **Innovation:** Work at the intersection of payments operations and AI\-enabled automation. * **Culture:** Join a collaborative team that values curiosity, inclusion, and sustainable work. We are looking for curious, driven builders who want to create secure, scalable, user\-friendly payments products. If you do not meet every qualification but bring initiative and a growth mindset, we encourage you to apply. We embrace AI as a powerful tool for innovation and welcome team members eager to leverage it in their work. As an equal opportunity employer, we're committed to diversity, inclusion, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description: **About TMO** The Mortgage Office is the most trusted loan management platform in private lending. Founded in 1978, we power the full loan lifecycle for over 1,100 lenders, including private money firms, CDFIs, nonprofits, and government agencies, servicing more than $190 billion in loans. We're recognized as G2's \#1 Loan Servicing Software and Capterra's Best Ease of Use. With offices in Huntington Beach and San Mateo, we're now building the next generation of AI\-native lending tools, and hiring a Support Engineer to help lead that work. **The Opportunity** We are seeking a technically skilled Support Engineer to serve as the critical link between our customer\-facing support team and our Engineering and Product organizations. This role owns the full lifecycle of complex technical escalations; from front\-end triage and backend investigation to defect documentation and custom resolution, ensuring that only thoroughly vetted, well\-documented issues reach development. You will be the technical escalation for API, SmartView, and SQL\-related issues, build custom SQL and API\-based solutions to resolve complex customer problems, and provide hands\-on technical guidance to Tier 1 specialists. **What You'll Own** * Conduct thorough backend investigations on all escalated issues before they reach Product or Development, including reproduction, root cause analysis, and workaround identification. * Author detailed bug tickets and track defects through resolution, maintaining clear documentation of reproduction steps, expected behavior, and workarounds. * Serve as the primary owner of all API, SmartView, and SQL\-related support issues, diagnosing and resolving complex technical problems end\-to\-end. * Develop custom solutions using SQL and internal APIs to resolve complex, customer\-facing issues that fall outside standard support workflows. * Provide technical guidance to Tier 1 Support Specialists, assisting with complex cases and building team knowledge. * Rigorously test and reproduce escalated issues to confirm defect behavior, validate fixes, and identify interim workarounds that minimize customer impact. * Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams by delivering well\-documented, fully triaged defect reports that accelerate resolution and reduce back\-and\-forth. * Communicate with customers via phone, email, or chat regarding complex or escalated support issues. **What You Bring** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field or equivalent work experience. * 5\+ years of experience in a technical support, support engineering, or software QA role, ideally in B2B SaaS or Fintech. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills; ability to read logs, trace errors, and isolate root causes. * Working knowledge of APIs, databases (SQL), and software integrations. * Proficiency with bug tracking and support platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, HubSpot CRM, or similar). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to operate cross\-functionally, building effective working relationships with Development, Product, and Customer Success teams. **Preferred** * Experience in mortgage, lending, or fintech software. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) or SaaS infrastructure concepts. * Technical writing skills for producing high\-quality support and developer documentation. * Microsoft Excel proficiency and comfort with data analysis, formulas, and logical reasoning. * Experience with loan origination, loan servicing, or private lending workflows. **Benefits \& Perks** * Competitive compensation (Base: $80,000 \- $90,000\) \+ Bonus * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) * 401(k) matching * Wellness programs * Professional development * Employee recognition programs * Team building \& on\-site amenities **Life at TMO,** TMO pairs 45\+ years of category leadership with a culture that's still hands\-on and collaborative. Ideas flow freely, every team member has a voice, and we have fun while we build. **Our Values: DRIVE** * **Data\-Driven:** numbers over opinions. * **Respect:** high on empathy, low on ego. * **Initiative \& Agency:** don't wait to be told. * **Value to Customers:** create value for them above all else. * **Evolve:** progress over perfection. **The pay range for this role is:** 80,000 \- 90,000 USD per year(Huntington Beach, CA (Hybrid))

jobs.title: UI Developer (ReactJS)
jobs.description: * Bachelor//'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5 or more years of professional front\-end engineering experience. * 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with React (18\+) and TypeScript. * 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with Angular (v18\+), including standalone components, signals, and RxJS. * Strong JavaScript fundamentals: DOM, the object model, and modern ECMAScript. * Strong HTML and CSS: layout, responsive breakpoints, and cross\-browser behaviour. * Demonstrated experience building a shared component library or design system consumed by other teams. * Hands\-on experience with Angular Material and React MUI, including theming and style overrides. * Experience with design tokens and multi\-brand or multi\-theme styling. * Experience with Storybook for component documentation and development. * Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility and how to build to it. * Experience writing automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and working in Git\-based workflows. * Daily working use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex, including writing effective prompts and repo\-level instruction files. Preferred: * Experience with web components and Lit, including custom elements and Shadow DOM. * Experience with micro\-frontend architecture, Nx, and Webpack or Rspack Module Federation, particularly with multiple frameworks composed on one page. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain components across the Angular, React, and web component toolkits, keeping behaviour, accessibility, and styling in parity across all three. * Build reusable UI components with Angular Material, React MUI, and Lit, working from Figma designs supplied by the UX team. * Own and extend the shared design token layer that feeds every toolkit, and the theming that lets products adopt brand changes without rework. * Build and extend micro\-frontend applications using Nx monorepo tooling and Module Federation, including runtime composition of multiple frameworks on a single page. * Design component APIs for consumption by other teams: props and inputs, composition patterns, and controlled versus uncontrolled behaviour. * Own versioning, deprecation, and migration guidance for every breaking change. * Publish and maintain npm packages to a private Azure Artifacts feed, with semantic versioning and release notes that consuming teams can act on. * Integrate micro\-product UIs with enterprise platforms, including Okta (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT bearer authentication) token flow across shell and products, and REST and GraphQL service layers. * Keep quality high with automated testing: Jest and Karma for unit tests, Playwright or Cypress for end\-to\-end, and visual regression testing across every component on every deployment. * Document components in Storybook across frameworks, and maintain the documentation site that designers and engineers both use. * Build accessibility to WCAG 2\.1 AA into every component — keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and focus management — so consuming products inherit it rather than solving it independently. * Maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions across dev, test, stage, and prod, with coverage and quality gates enforced. * Take part in spec\-driven development: turn design and product requirements into technical designs, ADRs, and implementation plans. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools throughout. * Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and contribute to reference patterns, coding standards, and reusable components across the team. * Evaluate new technologies and run proofs\-of\-concept to improve platform maturity and developer productivity.

jobs.title: Staking Technician I
jobs.description: **Summary:** This is an entry\-level position designed to train the incumbent to achieve the level of Staking Technician II within a four (4\) year period. This position will provide designs, stake, procure easements and additional required paperwork needed for new construction and system improvements. Work to excel in electric distribution design, load studies, RUS construction specifications, NESC code and general electrical utility understanding. **Objectives:** · To provide engineering assistance in the areas of general field staking and design work, providing documents and orders for construction, maintenance, and retirement of electrical system facilities. · To design distribution facilities to extend or enhance service in compliance with RUS construction specifications and other requirements of RUS, the Virginia State Corporation Commission, and The National Electrical Safety Code in order to obtain the most efficient and effective system design. · Perform any field surveys, drawings, sealed and recorded plats for all company districts with assistance from parties requesting work. o Use drawing/staking software on PC to create plat or drawings. o Answer any questions from the parties involved. o Be responsible for keeping up with all necessary training and re\-qualifying requirements to maintain license. **Reporting Relationships:** · Reports to: Director, Design \& System Management · Directs: None **Duties and Responsibilities:** · Schedules appointments and meets with members, developers and contractors at the work site providing input regarding the design and construction of new facilities, or upgrades, modifications or removal of existing facilities. · Participates in the design, staking, procuring of easements, and creating required paperwork (drawings, staking sheets, materials lists, cost estimates, tree trimming, tree replacements, joint use documentation, etc.) for new construction and system improvements. This includes, but is not limited to: o General construction (overhead and underground) o System improvement o Construction Work Plan o Member services o System protection (fuses, reclosers, GOAB switches, etc.) · Estimates cost of providing facilities and service to new and existing members, including contributions in aid to construction per Cooperative policies. · Design, route and lay out electric distribution and service facilities including transformers in accordance with mem­ber's desires, if possible, while satisfying RUS Specifica­tions, and accepted practices for design and construction of rural lines and prepare staking sheets, member orders and connection orders in accordance with the Cooperative's accepted practices. · Prepare load studies and recommend changes and additions required to meet the members’ needs. · Advise members and the public regarding engineering problems regarding electric service requested and/or required. · Operate and maintain transportation equipment, tools and working equipment in proper condition, and report deficiencies or repairs needed. · Prepare staking sheet and assist in preparing agreements to accommodate joint use of poles and trenches by other utilities or communication companies in accor­dance with the agreement with each company. · Prepare required work order documents for transmission line construction and retirement as directed. · Personally agrees to adhere to and abide by the Cooperative's safety rules, safety policies, and safety procedures. · Prepare sketches, plats and construction cost estimates as required. · Submit full and concise written reports of field activities and investigations as required. · Assist with the securing of topo data and layout of substation sites. · Solicit sales for home resource products by providing brochures, through the mail or in person, and having the ability to explain each product. · Maintain system maps including necessary drafting as re­quired. · Must possess basic computer skills, including a working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including, but not limited to: Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint as required for job responsibilities. · Investigates and resolves member and contractor requests for service upgrades, relocations, right of way problems or other changes to existing facilities. · Prepares and obtains construction permits from VMRC, Corps of Engineers, Accomack County Wetlands Board, US Department of Environmental Quality and VDOT. · Provide technical knowledge to support the research and recommendation for system upgrades and improvements. · Request Virginia’s Miss Utility locates when needed to support electrical design projects. · Maintain a thorough understanding of the latest RUS, NESC, and other specifications and codes so that job designs are in compliance. · Perform other duties as assigned. **Relationships:** Establishes and maintains the following contacts and relationships for the purpose of coordination and communication: ***Internal*** · Director of System Planning \& Design, Supervisor, Engineering, Field Engineer, Staking Technician I/II and Supervisor, System Management: to seek advice on special projects, details, and procedures so that other personnel may be properly informed. · Operations and Construction: to discuss special line design projects and/or locations of facilities. ***External*** · Members: maintains a relationship with applicants, members, businesses and the public that will command respect for the Cooperative. · Local, county, state, and federal governmental agencies: to confer and coordinate with relative to building or relocating distribution lines and facilities. · Utility and communication companies: to coordinate activities for joint use, permits and conflicts. · Electricians and contractors: to advise and seek advice for providing service and/or the requirements thereof. **Specifications and Requirements:** **Education:** High school diploma and a strong mathematics aptitude required. Associate’s degree in science, math, or technology preferred. **Experience:** Three (3\) years of experience in an approved utility construction program may be substituted for the education requirements above. **Job Knowledge:** Must have a strong knowledge of mathematics and be able to develop a working knowledge of distribution line design, transformer sizing, construction specifications, right\-of\-way easement procedure, National Electrical Safety Code, National Electric Code, RUS specifications, Virginia Department of Transportation utilities relocation procedure, drafting, construction materials, communication skills, GPS, and surveying. Must possess a valid driver’s license. Understand and adhere to all regulations and requirements set up by the Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation. Must possess basic computer skills, including a working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including, but not limited to: Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint as required by job responsibilities. **Abilities and Skills:** Must have the ability to: · Design distribution lines, service laterals, and transformer sizes. · Prepare clear and concise staking sheets, plats, right\-of\-way easements and other. · Support documents. · Prepare cost estimates for line extensions and relocation projects. · Communicate with the general public and secure right\-of\-way easements and contractual. · Follow agreements. · Must have strong PC skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office is required. · Perform all office and field procedures related to completing a successful survey. · Perform other duties as assigned. **Working Conditions:** The majority of the work schedule will be performed traveling to and working at various field locations within the service territory with some office time each day. Must be willing to work in all weather conditions and negotiate uneven terrain over long distances. Must be willing to assist with service restoration during storms. Overtime may be required at times of heavy workload or outage emergencies. Occasional travel for meetings, seminars and conferences may be required. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $23\.07 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Education: * High school or equivalent (Preferred) License/Certification: * Driver's License (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Quality Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The Quality Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, and improving HVAC systems and components to meet performance, quality, reliability, and cost objectives. This role contributes to organizational objectives by independently executing engineering projects, supporting product development initiatives, and solving complex technical challenges. The position collaborates with cross\-functional teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, reliable, and aligned with customer and regulatory requirements. This role plays a key part in advancing product performance, supporting innovation, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. **Primary Duties:** * Design and develop HVAC components, assemblies, and systems to meet performance, quality, cost, and regulatory requirements. * Perform engineering analyses, calculations, and evaluations to support product design and development efforts. * Create, review, and maintain technical drawings, specifications, test plans, and engineering documentation. * Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and product development teams to ensure successful product execution. * Lead assigned engineering projects and deliver solutions within established schedules and project objectives. * Support prototype development, testing, validation, and implementation of new products and product improvements. * Investigate product performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. * Identify opportunities to improve product performance, manufacturability, quality, and cost. * Participate in design reviews and provide technical recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders. * Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. **Primary duties may include, but are not limited to:** * Support laboratory testing and validation activities. * Assist in evaluating new technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to engineering processes and product performance. * Provide technical guidance and support to entry\-level engineers and technicians. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Job Requirements** **Education and Experience Requirements:** * Requires a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline; * 2\+ years of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field, * Or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. * **Preferred:** * Experience in HVAC, manufacturing, or industrial equipment design environments. * Engineer in Training (EIT) certification or Professional Engineer (PE) licensure preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and heat transfer. * Ability to perform engineering calculations, analysis, and technical evaluations. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical jobs.title: Scientist I - ML/AI Foundational Models for Synthetic Enhancer Design
jobs.description: ***Scientist I – ML/AI foundational models for synthetic enhancer design*** The **Allen Institute** accelerates science for a healthier world through large\-scale research designed to answer some of the most complex questions in biology. Our multi\-disciplinary teams generate foundational knowledge, tools, and data to understand how our brain, cells, and immune system work. We share our work openly so others can build on it, move faster, and ask bigger questions. We drive discovery forward and create new possibilities for improving human health. **Brain Health** is a new global collaborative research initiative designed to accelerate understanding of human brain diseases through large\-scale human tissue analysis, open science, AI\-enabled disease modeling, and translational platform technologies. Building on foundational advances in human brain cell atlases, quantitative neuropathology, single\-cell and spatial biology, multimodal molecular profiling, and AI\-enabled analysis, Brain Health is developing a scalable framework for understanding disease progression directly in the human brain and identifying new opportunities for therapeutic development. We seek a **Scientist I** to build the computational backbone of a lab\-in\-the\-loop platform that designs and validates synthetic enhancers for precision cell\-type targeting in the brain. In this cycle, model\-designed sequences are tested experimentally, and the results retrain the next round of models. You will contribute to an open\-source codebase for training, fine\-tuning, evaluating, and running inference on genomic sequence\-to\-function models. You will scale training across our cloud GPU infrastructure, turn large\-scale cross\-species whole\-brain multi\-omic data into reproducible training sets, and build on the thousands of enhancer\-AAV vectors already screened and released publicly through the Allen Institute Genetic Tools Atlas to inform the design of novel synthetic enhancers. The ideal candidate is a strong scientific software engineer and ML practitioner excited to share their models, sequences, and code as community tools for exploring regulatory genomics and designing enhancers in any tissue. At the Allen Institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. We are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to STEM careers more broadly. We also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices. We strive to make the Allen Institute a place where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to do their best work in a supportive environment. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our open positions. **Essential Functions** * Build and maintain an open\-source codebase for training, fine\-tuning, and serving genomic sequence models, and package models and benchmarks for use outside the Institute * Train large\-scale whole\-brain models efficiently in multi\-GPU cloud environments * Turn cross\-species multi\-omic data into reproducible, versioned training sets * Implement active\-learning loops that feed in vivo screening results back into the next round of models * Publish and present findings in peer\-reviewed journals and at scientific conferences *Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.* **Required Education and Experience** * Ph.D. in computer science, computational biology, bioinformatics, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of degree and experience * Strong software engineering practice in Python, including version control, testing, code review, dependency management, and reproducible environments * Experience training deep learning models in PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow on multi\-GPU or distributed infrastructure * Experience building data pipelines for large scientific datasets that do not fit in memory * Familiarity with modern foundation models, including transformer architectures and large language models. * Proven experience working independently and in a collaborative, fast\-paced team environment **Preferred Education and Experience** * Experience with genomic sequence models (Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome, ChromBPNet, CREsted) * Experience with experiment tracking platforms such as Weights \& Biases or MLflow * Experience with cloud platforms and with containers (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer) and workflow managers (Nextflow, Snakemake) * Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or reinforcement learning approaches to model fine\-tuning * Experience with the use of AI\-assisted coding tools in a development workflow * Experience releasing and maintaining open\-source scientific software, including documentation, versioned releases, community support, and model\-serving or API layers for outside users * Familiarity with gene regulation, chromatin accessibility data, or single\-cell genomics * Experience contributing to large, collaborative consortium projects and shared open data resources * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to experimental biologists **Work Environment** * Working at a desk and at a computer developing software and analyzing data **Physical Demands** * Fine motor movements in fingers/hands to operate computers and other office equipment **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** * This role is currently able to work both remotely and onsite in a hybrid work environment. We are a Washington State employer, and the primary work location for all Allen Institute employees is 615 Westlake Ave N.; any remote work must be performed in Washington State. **Travel** * Occasional travel to collaborator sites, consortium meetings, and national or international conferences **Additional Comments** * + Please note, this opportunity offers relocation assistance * + Please note, this opportunity may may offer visa sponsorship **Annualized Salary Range** $87,450 – $108,250 \* * *Final salary depends on the required education for the role, experience, level of skills relevant to the role, and work location, where applicable.* **Benefits** Employees (and their families) are eligible to enroll in benefits per eligibility rules outlined in the Allen Institute’s Benefits Guide. These benefits include medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees are also eligible to enroll in the Allen Institute’s 401k plan. Paid time off is also available as outlined in the Allen Institutes Benefits Guide. Details on the Allen Institute’s benefits offering are located at the following link to the Benefits Guide: https://alleninstitute.org/careers/benefits. *It is the policy of the Allen Institute to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Allen Institute will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.*

jobs.description: Description: **Location**: Beaumont, TX **Hourly rate**: $31\.50 \- $40\.00 \| OT after 8 hours of travel and work time, double time after 10 hours each day. Saturday work 0\-10 hours is paid at time and a half and Sunday work is double time. All travel is also paid. **Travel**: Position is road/client based; most travel is within home territory; however technicians may be called to support other teams/clients as needed. Technicians are allowed to book work\-related flights and rooms directly for reimbursement so they can collect points. Technicians are scheduled on weekend rotations. **Advancement \& Training Opportunities**: Yes, after one year of satisfactory service, technicians may be eligible for additional training opportunities such as PLC, FANUC, panel automated shelving, additional electrical and leadership training etc. Internal employees are also eligible for promotions and advancement. **Education**: HSD/GED or equivalent is required, vocational or technical school degree is preferred **Experience:** Minimum 3\-5 years of troubleshooting and repair of mechanical equipment and 2 years of troubleshooting and repair of electrical equipment is required; flexibility to travel and work when customers need assistance is required, this may include some overnights and weekends, as required.? Must be able to communicate with customers and management in both written and verbal form. Must be able to stand/bend for up to 8 hours and lift\-up to 50lbs to shoulder height. Requirements: **Responsibilities:** * Perform installations, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on electro\-mechanical material handling equipment. This includes conveyor belts, sortation systems, transfers, diverters, merges, and accumulation systems, as well as 480V electrical systems, motors, contactors, three\-phase systems, gearboxes, drives, couplings, lift tables, hoists, cranes, dock equipment, material lifts, control panels, electrical enclosures, bearings, belts, chains, sprockets, and rollers \- all with minimal support from the Lead Technician. * Respond to emergency calls within territory, as needed on a 24/7 basis; occasional but rare travel outside of home territory may be required to support other teams.(Travel time is always compensated) * Perform mechanical work including fabricating, stick welding, and painting. * Carry out maintenance on machinery at client sites as scheduled * Use a multi\-meter to check fuses, troubleshoot contactors, verify power, troubleshoot 3\-phase motors * Appropriately document all work performed in E\-360 reporting system (i.e., Field Service Reports / inspection and audit forms) * Communicate machine issues, status, repair needs/timelines effectively with clients and leadership in both written and verbal communications * Work within the safety guidelines of customers, Adaptec Solutions and OSHA; always operating by the most stringent safety protocol. * Work independently and conscientiously to complete a job, know when to escalate questions or concerns to leadership or the client. **Requirements:** * HSD/GED or equivalent is required, vocational or technical school degree is preferred * Strong electro\-mechanical reasoning ability is required * 5 years of troubleshooting and repair of mechanical equipment and 2 years of troubleshooting and repair of electrical equipment is required * Rigger, Millwright, Machine Builder experience is also acceptable * Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics and detailed repair drawings related to material handling equipment * Ability to use hand tools, measurement instruments (such as indicators, calipers, micrometers, tape measure, scales, etc.), power tools to include drills, grinders, welders, impact wrenches and more. Use/operation of heavy equipment such as forklifts, aerial and scissor lifts is required on some jobs * Must possess a foundational understanding of MIG/TIG/Stick welding * Must have valid driver’s license, a clean driving record and ability to comply with DOT regulations. * Must be able to pass DOT physical. * Must be able to attend emergency calls as needed, this may require overnight travel for field service work, preventative maintenance visits, equipment installation and troubleshooting (all travel is paid time) * May be required to travel outside of home territory to assist other teams and customers as needed. * Must have strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact with the customer and managers * Must have basic hand tools (Adaptec will provide additional tools) * Must have computer skills, experience turning in field service reports is strongly preferred * Ability to exert 50 to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds **What We Offer** * Paid Travel Time – You’re compensated for all travel related to field service work, installations, and emergency calls. * Advancement \& Training Opportunities – After one year of satisfactory service, you’ll be eligible for additional training in PLCs, FANUC robotics, panel and automated shelving systems, advanced electrical skills, and leadership development. Internal employees are prioritized for promotions and advancement. * Comprehensive Benefits – Competitive pay, health, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and paid holidays. * Tools \& Equipment Support – You’ll need your own basic hand tools, but Adaptec provides specialty tools, safety gear, and ongoing resources to help you succeed. * Team Environment – You’ll work with highly skilled technicians and engineers who support one another and share knowledge openly. * Career Growth in a Growing Industry – Material handling and automation are only expanding, and you’ll have the chance to build your expertise in some of the most in\-demand skills in the field. * Culture of Safety – We never cut corners. Our customers, OSHA, and Adaptec standards are all upheld so you can do your best work with confidence. **Measurements of Success:** * Technicians cross\-trained and versatile in local market * First time fix rate is 95% or better * Strong Voice of the Customer responses/ratings * Technicians are properly utilizing service software * Projects completed safely in expected time frame In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the wage range for this role is **$31\.50 \- $40\.00**. The rate range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Adaptec Solutions considers factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. Adaptec Solutions also offers a variety of benefits including generous paid time off (PTO), 11 paid company holidays including your birthday, generous health plans, dental and vision insurance, HSA/FSA accounts, generous 401(k) match and immediate vesting, short\-term/long term disability coverage and basic life/AD\&D insurance and education assistance. *Adaptec Solutions, LLC is an equal opportunity organization. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.*

jobs.title: Agency - Test Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY** Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission\-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. **WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?** Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best\-in\-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together. **POSITION SUMMARY:** This is a temporary assignment designed to support operational requirements during a period of increased business demand. The Test Engineer II is responsible for the design, development, and implementation of hardware and software solutions for engineering test systems that support product development activities. This role develops and executes comprehensive test plans to validate product performance against design requirements, collaborating closely with design engineers throughout all phases of the product development lifecycle. The successful candidate will create innovative test solutions that are closely aligned with product architectures and Advanced Energy's test platforms, enabling efficient product verification and validation. Through extensive interaction with cross\-functional engineering teams and exposure to product design methodologies, this position offers a unique opportunity to build the technical expertise needed for advancement into senior and principal\-level engineering roles. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, develop, and maintain software applications used for the calibration, testing, and validation of Advanced Energy products. * Integrate, configure, and automate electronic test and measurement equipment to support product development and manufacturing operations. * Develop and manage project schedules, deliverables, and implementation plans for test software, instrumentation, fixtures, and test system integration activities. * Create comprehensive verification and validation plans based on product specifications, system requirements, and engineering standards. * Execute test and validation activities, analyze results, troubleshoot issues, and provide clear technical documentation and reports. * Support the deployment of test and calibration systems into production environments and provide training and technical guidance to manufacturing and engineering personnel. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations, throughout the product development lifecycle. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance test system reliability, efficiency, and scalability. * Travel as needed to support system implementation, training, and project requirements. * Other duties as assigned. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** * Location: Vancouver, WA * Environment: manufacturing environment which may be noisy and fast paced. Many tasks are repetitive in motion and include the use of electronic assembly equipment **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Two to five years of experience developing test, calibration, data acquisition, automation, or system validation software in an engineering or manufacturing environment. * Experience developing test and calibration software using C\#/.NET and LabVIEW. * Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new programming languages, development environments, tools, and technologies. * Basic knowledge of SQL database design and user interface/front\-end development. * Working knowledge of thermal and optical sensors, signal conditioning techniques, and measurement principles. * Experience developing and executing system verification and validation plans. * Working knowledge of analog and digital electronics. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, instrumentation, and communication issues. * Familiarity with industrial and test\-equipment communication protocols, including SCPI, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS\-232, TCP/IP, and vendor\-specific interfaces. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional engineering teams. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience designing and maintaining normalized databases, including constraints, indexes, views, and stored procedures. * Knowledge of intermediate to advanced LabVIEW architectures, design patterns, and software development best practices. * Experience maintaining, enhancing, or modernizing legacy test, calibration, or engineering applications. * Familiarity with source control systems, issue tracking tools, code review processes, and configuration management practices. * Experience with printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) design, including schematic capture, prototyping, hardware bring\-up, testing, and troubleshooting. **EDUCATION:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. **COMPENSATION:** As required by multiple state pay transparency laws, Advanced Energy provides a reasonable range of compensation for each job posting. Actual compensation is influenced by an array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. **This is a temporary position employed and paid through a staffing agency.** The anticipated pay range for this role is **$40\.00 to $48\.00 per hour**. Advanced Energy is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities. Advanced Energy is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our job application process/procedures for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance in completing an Advanced Energy application, please reach out to HumanResources@aei.com. **Nearest Major Market:** Portland Oregon **Nearest Secondary Market:** Tacoma

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Applications Engineer to provide technical leadership and support for Advantest's V93000 Semiconductor Test Systems. In this role, you will work closely with customers and partners to deliver innovative test solutions, drive successful implementations, and influence business outcomes through technical excellence. Responsibilities: * Lead technical engagements throughout the sales and support lifecycle, including requirements analysis, feature demonstrations, competitive benchmarking, and solution implementation. * Ensure Advantest products meet customer specifications and integrate seamlessly into their test environments. * Analyze complex customer requirements and provide expert guidance on performance, design optimization, test program development, and implementation strategies. * Design and validate test solutions that align with customer business objectives. * Identify and coordinate internal and external resources to deliver comprehensive customer solutions, ensuring timely and high\-quality deliverables. * Serve as a technical liaison between customers and Advantest's field and factory teams, representing customer needs and feedback. * Develop and manage project plans for complex engagements, tracking milestones and deliverables. * Deliver technical training and consultation to customers, including the creation of training materials and documentation. * Stay current with emerging technologies and share insights with global technical teams. * Build strong customer relationships by delivering value through technical expertise and becoming a trusted advisor in their decision\-making processes. Technologies \& Focus Areas: * HPC and High\-speed SoC (System\-on\-Chip) technologies * Semiconductor test systems and applications * Test program development and conversion * System\-level integration and optimization Requirements: * Education \& Experience: * + Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field. + Minimum of 5 years of experience in semiconductor testing. * Technical Skills: * + Strong understanding of semiconductor devices and proven debugging skills for test programs. + Proficiency in Java programming and working knowledge of Linux environments. + Ability to quickly learn and develop test programs using high\-level APIs in Java or C\+\+. + Experience with V93000 SmarTest 7 and SmarTest 8 platforms is a strong plus. + Familiarity with scripting languages such as Perl and Python is a plus. + Knowledge of SoC, HPC, and High\-Speed I/O device testing is desirable. + Hands\-on experience with the V93000 platform is preferred. * Project \& Communication Skills: * + Demonstrated experience leading technical projects is a plus. + Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, project\-driven, team\-oriented environment. + Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive attitude are essential.

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer - Semiconductor Test
jobs.description: Advantest America develops and supports advanced semiconductor test solutions for next\-generation SoC, high\-performance computing, RF, and mixed\-signal products. We are building a high\-caliber application engineering team for engineers who want ownership, customer impact, and hands\-on access to leading\-edge ATE, silicon, and lab infrastructure as demand for AI compute and inference accelerates. **The Role** ------------ This role places you near one of the most important semiconductor buildouts underway: AI compute and inference. You will help bring up, validate, and optimize advanced SoC devices for high\-performance computing and large\-scale AI infrastructure—working across silicon, software, ATE, and customer programs. * We are seeking a hands\-on Semiconductor Test Application Engineer in San Jose, CA. This role is ideal for an experienced ATE, validation, test development, or system\-level debug engineer who wants to solve complex semiconductor test challenges with lab hardware, customer teams, and next\-generation Advantest V93000 platforms. * You will become a key technical owner for Advantest SmarTest 8 and V93000\-based SoC test solutions, helping architect, debug, and optimize production\-grade test programs for complex devices. Because the work includes hardware bring\-up, lab execution, customer collaboration, and fast\-moving ramps, the position is based on\-site. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Test Program Development: Architect, write, debug, and optimize SoC test programs in modern ATE software environments, including Advantest SmarTest 8, for advanced AI compute, inference, and high\-performance semiconductor devices. * Silicon Bring\-Up and Validation: Support and help drive first\-silicon bring\-up on V93000 testers, debugging interactions between silicon, system behavior, test content, and the tester environment. * Pattern Workflow Engineering: Drive pattern translation, validation, and debug across DFT and tester workflows. Work with STIL, WGL, or comparable pattern sources; support tester bring\-up; and collaborate with design and product engineering on emerging virtual test workflows using SmarTest 8 and V93000 environments. * Hardware Co\-Design and Debug: Collaborate with PCB and hardware teams to specify, validate, and troubleshoot high\-density Device Interface Boards (DIBs), including signal integrity, power delivery, and tester\-to\-device interfaces. * Test Time and Automation: Build automation in Python, Java, C\+\+, or similar languages to analyze logs and STDF data, streamline debug, interface with test platforms, improve multi\-site efficiency, and accelerate learning loops. Requirements: * Education:S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Location and Presence: Based in San Jose, CA, with regular on\-site work at least three days per week across customer sites, lab environments, and/or the Advantest office. * ATE and Semiconductor Test Experience: Hands\-on experience developing, debugging, or supporting test applications for manufacturing, characterization, validation, or production test. V93000 and SmarTest 8 experience is highly valued, but other ATE platforms or adjacent semiconductor test systems are also relevant. * SoC Test Foundations: Working knowledge of structural test, scan\-based test strategies, memory BIST, logic BIST, high\-speed digital I/O, or comparable SoC validation and production\-test concepts. * Programming and Automation: Strong skills in Java, C/C\+\+, Python, or similar languages, with the ability to build tools, automate workflows, parse test data, and debug hardware/software interactions. * Problem\-Solving Mindset: Ability to move between software, hardware, silicon behavior, and customer constraints to diagnose issues and drive practical solutions. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Hands\-On Lab Access: Get direct access to advanced V93000 testers, complex SoC bring\-up environments, and lab infrastructure for real customer test challenges. * Silicon Valley Impact: Work with leading design, architecture, DFT, and customer engineering teams on AI compute and inference devices where test strategy, debug speed, and production readiness affect time\-to\-market. * Career Growth: Build deep expertise in V93000 and SmarTest 8 while applying your ATE, validation, hardware debug, or automation background to AI compute and inference programs. If you are an ATE, semiconductor validation, test development, or hardware/software debug engineer ready to help power the next wave of AI compute, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: IT Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The Network Engineer II supports the design, implementation, maintenance, security, and troubleshooting of network infrastructure across corporate and manufacturing locations. The position works independently on day\-to\-day operations and assigned projects while collaborating with internal teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to provide reliable and secure connectivity **Essential Job Responsibilities and Duties:** * Maintain and troubleshoot network infrastructure across multiple locations, including wired, wireless, remote\-access, and internet connectivity. * Configure and support enterprise routing, switching, network security, and access control solutions in accordance with established standards. * Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and security; investigate issues and document root cause and corrective actions. * Participate in network projects and changes, including planning, testing, implementation, validation, and operational handoff. * Support corporate, manufacturing, and operational technology connectivity while following segmentation, cybersecurity, and change\-control requirements. * Maintain network documentation and assist with software updates, vulnerability remediation, and incident\-response activities. * Automate routine administration or reporting tasks where practical and share technical knowledge with other IT personnel. * Collaborate with infrastructure, security, business teams, and vendors to deliver effective technology solutions. * Participate in after\-hours maintenance, on\-call support, and travel to company locations as needed. * Perform other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned by management. Level II Scope * Works independently on routine and moderately complex network operations, troubleshooting, changes, and assigned projects with general supervision. * Uses established standards and judgment, escalating significant risks, architecture decisions, exceptions, and unresolved critical issues. * May lead a defined project workstream or site implementation and provide peer guidance without formal supervisory responsibility. **Work Environment and Physical Demands:** * Work is performed in office, data center, network closet, and manufacturing environments. Applicable safety requirements must be followed. * The employee must be able to move through office and plant areas, access network equipment locations, and occasionally lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position. **Qualifications:** *Education and Experience* * Associate's or bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and experience. * Three or more years of network administration or engineering experience in an enterprise environment. * Experience supporting business\-critical technology in a multi\-site or manufacturing environment is preferred. *Technical Knowledge and Skills* * Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and wireless networking. * Experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure and security solutions. Experience with Cisco, Arista, Fortinet, or similar platforms is preferred. * Experience troubleshooting network issues using monitoring, logging, packet analysis, and diagnostic tools. * Working knowledge of network authentication, access control, secure remote connectivity, virtualization, cloud networking, and hybrid infrastructure. * Understanding of cybersecurity principles, including segmentation, least privilege, secure administration, system hardening, and vulnerability remediation. * Basic scripting or network automation experience is preferred. * Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical audiences. *Professional Competencies* * Systematic troubleshooting, attention to detail, sound judgment, and ownership through resolution. * Ability to balance availability, security, safety, quality, and production requirements. * Effective teamwork, prioritization, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. *Preferred Certifications* Current networking, security, or cloud certifications from recognized industry providers are preferred. Certifications support, but do not replace, demonstrated hands\-on capability.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I (New Grad 2027) (NYC)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. We're excited to welcome a new cohort of graduates with a computer science or related major who are ready to leverage their skills to drive real\-world impact and shape the future of finance! In our hybrid early career program, you'll be paired with a tenured Affirmer and have an opportunity to collaborate in\-person 3 days a week out of our New York City, or San Francisco offices. You'll experience the best of both worlds: the in\-office experience and remote work. After the one\-year, you can remain hybrid, go remote, or stay in an office. Opportunities are available across different tech stacks and teams so that you can find a perfect fit to launch your career with Affirm! **What You'll Do** * With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals. * You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade\-offs related to your work. * You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime. * You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities. **What We Look For** * You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code. * You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. **USA Pacific base pay range (NY):** $130,000 \- 180,000 **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Akeneo is the leading AI\-powered Product Data Platform that helps brands, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers unify product data and pricing to power better product experiences, smarter decisions, and business growth in an AI\-driven commerce world. We're all about experience \- from the best\-in\-class product we build to the inspiring environment we create for our employees. You'll grow in a dynamic environment where your ideas and expertise will make an impact from day one. Our flexible work model empowers you to thrive, balancing professional success with personal fulfilment. At Akeneo, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team that values open communication, shared successes, and meaningful relationships. Learn more about our culture and values via our Career page. ### **Bridge the gap between consulting and engineering.** At Akeneo, we don't just build software; we solve the most complex product data orchestration challenges for global enterprises. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the technical heartbeat of our most strategic customer engagements. You aren't tucked away behind a backlog \- you are on the front lines, embedded with clients, and empowered to build the technical bridges that turn high\-level strategy into high\-performance reality. This is a unique hybrid role designed for the "Customer\-Minded Engineer." Part software architect, part strategic consultant, and part rapid\-prototyper, you thrive in the "gray area" where standard configurations end and innovation begins. This role interacts with varying customer levels with varying technical acumen: you are innately a problem solver, and able to provide solutions which never existed previously to bring value to our customers. ### **Why this role is different:** * **Real\-World Impact: Y**ou won't just ship code to a staging environment; you’ll see your solutions transform how global brands manage and move their data in real\-time. You will guide the customer through the changes you’ve made, closing the feedback loop. * **Architectural Sovereignty:** You have the autonomy to design bespoke integration patterns and influence the core product roadmap by acting as the "Voice of the Field" for our R\&D teams. * **The Best of Both Worlds:** You enjoy the deep technical challenge of a Senior Engineer with the strategic influence and variety of a Strategic Consultant. ### **What we look for** **Technical Architecture \& Integration Mastery** * API \& System Interoperability: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and data flows. Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with complex client ecosystems (ERPs, PLMs, E\-commerce) to ensure seamless, high\-performance data synchronization. * Solution Architecture \& Scoping: Ability to perform deep\-dive assessments of client environments, gather complex technical requirements, and design scalable architectures that balance business objectives with technical constraints. * Rapid Prototyping: A builder mindset with the ability to rapidly develop functional proof\-of\-concepts or custom code to unblock clients while long\-term product features are roadmapped. * Data Architecture \& Catalog Design: You don't just move data; you architect it. You will assess a client's current state and design a clean, performant Akeneo catalog structure; leveraging Product Models, Families, and Association Types, etc. \- that ensures long\-term scalability and seamless synchronization with downstream channels. **Implementation \& Consulting Excellence** * SaaS Deployment Track Record: Proven experience configuring and implementing SaaS solutions, ideally in a B2B environment. You have a history of successfully guiding enterprise clients through the full deployment lifecycle. * Technical Documentation \& Diagramming: Proficiency in creating high\-quality documentation, solution blueprints, and integration plans (using tools like Lucidchart, Miro, or Visio) to communicate deployment strategies clearly to both clients and internal research \& development. * Product Training \& Enablement: Skilled at leading workshops and technical training sessions. You can translate complex product jargon into functional knowledge for clients and partners, ensuring they are self\-sufficient post\-launch. **Strategic Mindset \& Leadership** * The "Translator" Ability: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain high\-level technical logic to non\-technical stakeholders (C\-Suite) without losing the strategic "why." * Entrepreneurial Ownership: A problem solver to your core. You are comfortable in the grey area, taking extreme ownership of high\-stakes or ambiguous technical decisions. * Strategic Mobility: Ready and willing to be "on the front lines," including traveling to client sites (approx. 20\-30%) to lead high\-intensity workshops and oversee mission\-critical "go\-live" moments. ### **What will set you up for success** * The Consultative Professional: Significant years of experience in Software Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Consulting \- specifically within SaaS, PIM, ERP, or E\-commerce ecosystems. * Software Engineering: Proficient in fullstack development (PHP/Symfony, Node, React \- or similar). Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Docker is essential. * Project Leadership: Ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously, acting as the strategic technical leader for the customer. You don't need to tick every box. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
