jobs.description: **Location:** Remote, United States **Travel:** Approximately one to three trips per year to Irvine, California, or a client location **Employment type:** Full\-time **Compensation:** $100,000–$150,000 base salary, depending on experience and location **Travel:** Occasional travel to Irvine, California, and client locations ***About Cappital*** Cappital is a product strategy and software development firm. We help organizations define, design, build, and continuously improve custom digital products. We are a small, highly collaborative U.S.\-based team that works closely with a long\-standing engineering organization in India. People here work across functions, stay close to the work, and take personal responsibility for helping clients succeed. ***About the role*** We are hiring a hands\-on Technical Delivery Manager to support one of our largest and most strategically important client relationships. You will serve as a stateside bridge among the client’s product and engineering stakeholders, other technology vendors, and Cappital’s engineering team in India. You will frequently participate in client meetings with engineers when no Cappital engineer is present. You must be able to understand the discussion, ask useful questions, identify dependencies and unresolved decisions, represent established engineering positions accurately, and keep work moving without making unsupported technical commitments. This is a client\-facing technical program and delivery role. It is not a software engineering or architecture position, but it is also not a nontechnical project\-management role. What this role is—and is not * It is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role. You will personally lead meetings, clarify requirements, document decisions, maintain delivery details, and follow up with stakeholders. * It is not a portfolio\-governance, executive\-oversight, or large\-team management position. * You will not independently set software architecture or override the engineers responsible for technical decisions. * You will be expected to understand technical issues well enough to improve the discussion, recognize missing information, and accurately communicate what engineering has decided. * Success depends on creating clarity in an environment where priorities, processes, and stakeholder expectations may change frequently. **What you will do** Lead client\-facing technical delivery * Serve as a trusted and responsive technical\-delivery contact during U.S. business hours. * Facilitate discussions involving requirements, integrations, implementation status, technical constraints, risks, incidents, and delivery tradeoffs. * Build productive relationships with client engineers, product stakeholders, other vendors, and Cappital team members. * Communicate uncertainty candidly without losing credibility, creating unnecessary alarm, or implying commitments that engineering has not made. * Identify emerging concerns and expectation gaps before they become escalations. Translate between stakeholders and engineering * Translate client objectives, questions, and concerns into clear technical and delivery inputs. * Translate engineering constraints, dependencies, risks, and recommendations into language appropriate for the audience. * Represent established engineering decisions accurately while recognizing when an engineer or specialist needs to participate directly. * Ask technically informed questions that expose assumptions, missing requirements, failure modes, and decision boundaries. * Adapt your communication for engineers, product leaders, executives, and external partners. Create and maintain delivery clarity * Maintain a dependable source of truth across roadmap documents, technical decisions, tickets, milestones, and client commitments. * Identify contradictions among product goals, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and implementation status; bring the right people together to resolve them. * Proactively trace the likely technical and operational implications of new requests. Understand the platform well enough to recognize when a change to one feature, integration, data flow, analytics implementation, or workflow may affect another system or team; involve the appropriate stakeholders before incomplete or conflicting direction reaches engineering. * Distinguish among proposed, decided, implemented, tested, approved, released, and operationally ready. * Turn ambiguous requests into sufficiently defined problems, requirements, acceptance criteria, owners, dependencies, and next actions. * Maintain clear records of decisions, assumptions, risks, unresolved questions, and follow\-up commitments. * Keep handoffs moving between U.S. stakeholders and the India engineering team with minimal avoidable delay. Support reliable delivery and handoffs * Maintain visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, approvals, and delivery health. * Coordinate handoffs involving code, CMS content, assets, configuration, analytics, env livery, implementation, consulting, or client leadership and still enjoys hands\-on coordination. * Solutions engineer or implementation architect whose responsibilities extended beyond presales into delivery and stakeholder ownership. * Technical consultant or application leader who personally coordinated complex integrations, releases, and distributed engineering teams. * Delivery leader from a digital product agency, technology consultancy, or enterprise\-software implementation organization. ***Working style that succeeds here*** * You listen carefully and get to the point. * You separate facts, assumptions, decisions, and unresolved questions. * You can disagree or surface risk without becoming combative or dramatic. * You are comfortable saying, “I need to confirm that with engineering,” and then reliably closing the loop. * You notice details, prepare for meetings, and follow through without repeated reminders. * You use enough process to create clarity but do not add ceremony for its own sake. * You adapt when the client changes priorities or working practices rather than insisting that everyone adopt your preferred system. * You care about both the client’s outcome and the sustainability of the engineering team. ***What success looks like*** During the first 30 days * Learn the client environment, current platform, active work, major stakeholders, and established decision boundaries. * Join the relevant client and engineering meetings, ask strong questions, and begin maintaining clear follow\-up and decision records. * Accurately route or respond to client requests while being transparent about what still requires engineering input. * Establish a dependable communication rhythm with Cappital’s engineering lead and CTO. Within 60–90 days * Independently facilitate routine client discussions involving technical delivery. * Recognize contradictions, missing decisions, and emerging risks early enough to act. * Help technical questions and delivery decisions move efficiently across teams and time zones. * Improve the clarity of requirements, ownership, acceptance criteria, and commitments. * Reduce the routine coordination and escalation burden on senior Cappital leaders without reducing technical accuracy. ***Compensation and benefits*** The anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$150,000, depending on relevant experience, technical background, geographic location, and demonstrated client\-delivery capability. The position also includes Cappital’s standard employee benefits. ***Working environment*** This is a remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Occasional travel—generally one to three trips per year—may be required for client meetings, team planning, or visits to our Irvine, California, office. ***Our client environment*** Our clients include commercial businesses, nonprofit organizations, faith\-based organizations, and organizations working in political media. Their missions, viewpoints, cultures, and meeting practices may differ from your own. Employees are not required to share a client’s beliefs, make statements of faith, lead prayer, or participate in religious observances. This role does require respectful and professional service to every client and colleague. ***Equal opportunity*** Cappital is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Experience: * software engineering: 4 years (Preferred) * technical delivery: 4 years (Preferred) * solutions engineering: 4 years (Preferred) * technical program management: 4 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92618

We are seeking a **Software Engineer I** to help build applications that bring AI into employees’ everyday workflows. Our team combines AI, shared knowledge, analytics, workflow automation, and reusable integrations to help employees find information, explore data, and complete tasks while remaining in control. In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop user interfaces, backend services, and integrations. You will strengthen your software engineering fundamentals, gain hands\-on experience building AI\-powered products, and contribute to features used by teams across Chewy. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop, test, and maintain scoped features across user interfaces, backend services, and APIs with guidance from experienced engineers. * Help build AI\-powered experiences for knowledge discovery, analytics, and workflow automation. * Integrate AI services and enterprise APIs using established patterns for security, human review, and reliable error handling. * Embrace a builder’s mindset: test ideas by building—make, break, and rebuild in pursuit of meaningful, intelligent systems. Fail fast and iterate continuously, incorporating guidance and feedback from experienced engineers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while reviewing, understanding, and testing generated outputs. * Help evaluate AI features using representative tasks, identify inaccurate or unexpected results, and suggest improvements. * Collaborate with engineers and product partners to understand requirements, communicate progress, and apply feedback from code reviews. * Help monitor and troubleshoot applications, building familiarity with production systems and reliable software delivery. **What You’ll Need** -------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1–2 years of software development experience; internships and co\-ops count. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or TypeScript, and familiarity with APIs and SQL or NoSQL databases. * Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, version control, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools through work, coursework, or personal projects, with examples of how you reviewed, tested, and improved generated code. * Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered systems through work, coursework, or personal projects, and the curiosity to find and frame your own problems to solve. * Awareness of AI limitations, including inaccurate outputs, and the importance of validating results and protecting sensitive information. * Ability to complete well\-defined tasks with guidance, ask clear questions, incorporate feedback, and collaborate with teammates. **Bonus Qualifications** ------------------------ * Experience developing user interfaces with React and TypeScript, or a comparable frontend framework. * Coursework or projects involving language model APIs, AI\-powered applications, or workflow automation. * Familiarity with prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, or evaluating AI\-generated responses. * Exposure to cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containers, or application monitoring. * Experience with data processing or analytics, or an interest in supply chain, operations, or enterprise software. **Success in This Role** ------------------------ You deliver well\-tested, scoped features with guidance and build increasing independence. You demonstrate an AI\-first mindset through hands\-on experimentation, thoughtful validation, and practical improvements to your work while strengthening your software engineering fundamentals. The base salary range for this role is $92,500 \- $160,000\.00\.* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. jobs.title: Agentic Operator, Growth Marketing
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Most growth teams don't lack ideas. They lack the infrastructure to test them fast enough to matter. We're hiring an Agentic Operator whose core output is one thing: reducing the time between hypothesis and signal. You'll build the agent pipelines, orchestration layers, and automation systems that let our growth team run more experiments in parallel — and learn from them faster — than any traditionally\-staffed team could. This is a builder role. You'll treat AI agents as a programmable workforce, replacing human bottlenecks in the experimentation loop with systems that pre\-validate, instrument, execute, and surface insights automatically. You won't be handed a playbook. You'll write it in code. You'll report to the Director of Demand Generation and work closely with channel owners, lifecycle, product, and sales to make the growth team's experiments faster, more rigorous, and more evidence\-based. The right person is operationally sharp with genuine growth instincts. You understand B2B SaaS funnels well enough to prioritize experiments intelligently and catch flawed hypotheses before they waste the team's time. You're technically fluent enough to build AI workflows, instrument experiments, and own the tracking systems the team depends on. And you bring the organizational discipline to manage a high\-velocity experiment backlog without letting things slip through the cracks. **What You'll Build** --------------------- ### **Agent Pipelines for Concept Pre\-Validation** Before human resources touch a test, your agents have already scored it — LLM\-evaluated copy variants, synthetic audience testing, funnel drop\-off analysis. Only the strongest hypotheses make it to execution. ### **An Automated Experiment Queue** You own the full loop: intake, prioritization, instrumentation, and readout — all accelerated via automation. Funnel drop\-off doesn't trigger a Monday meeting; it triggers the next test. ### **An Experimentation Process** You own the full loop — backlog, sequencing, instrumentation, and readout — with the rigor to match. Every test ships with a falsifiable hypothesis, clean measurement setup, and defined success metric. Null results get documented, not buried. Channel owners, lifecycle, and PLG stay in sync so the team is always running the highest\-leverage tests without conflicts or duplication. ### **Stack Orchestration** You wire together our existing tools — Amplitude, HubSpot, Clay, REO.dev and enrichment layers — so signals flow automatically into action. You integrate frontier LLMs (Claude, GPT) and workflow tools (n8n, Gumloop) into production\-grade systems that improve over time. ### **Parallel Experimentation Infrastructure** Instead of sequential tests, you build the infrastructure to run experiments across channels simultaneously — compressing the learning cycle and multiplying the team's throughput without multiplying headcount. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- ### **Growth Fundamentals** You understand acquisition funnels, CRO, CAC/LTV, and hypothesis\-driven testing deeply enough to know which experiments are worth building for. Instinct for what moves the needle isn't optional — it's the filter on everything you automate. ### **Agentic Build Skills** You've shipped multi\-agent workflows in production, not just personal automation scripts. You're fluent in API\-based orchestration, prompt engineering, and building feedback loops that self\-improve. You've built internal tooling that other teams depended on. ### **Systems Thinking** You design for leverage. Before touching a tool, you ask: what's the bottleneck, what happens if this scales 10x, and where does the loop close? You build things that get smarter over time. ### **Zero\-to\-One Comfort** The playbook for this role doesn't exist yet. You've operated in environments where you had to define the process, not just follow it — and you preferred it that way. You want the opportunity to build, improve, and adapt a new experimentation motion. ### **Multi\-stakeholder Management** Experience managing or coordinating a multi\-stakeholder experimentation program — not just running your own tests, but helping a team run better ones. **You Might Be a Fit If…** -------------------------- * You can describe a specific experiment cadence you drove — e.g., "we went from 3 tests/month to 18" — and walk through exactly what you automated to get there * Your first instinct when hitting a bottleneck is to build something, not escalate it * You think about your tech stack second and your growth hypothesis first CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

The various DWM Water Treatment \& Reclamation plants have CCTV, SCADA and DCS environments. This is a senior position still within the 1st tier (Break/Fix) of or troubleshooting and repairing issues, including complex issues, within the CCTV/SCADA/DCS environments with minimal supervision and before determining that the 2nd and highest tier of support CCTV Subject Matter Expert (SME), Process Control Engineer, Network Engineer and Server team as needed. Duties include review of plans and permits, establishing project document control, addressing customer service requests, contract administration, change order negotiations, claim management, schedule review, inspector daily report review, supervision of inspectors, running preconstruction and progress meetings, reviewing and issuing partial payments, management of the Contracts Database among many others. The position involves regular collaboration with ODOT D8, Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), architects, planners, graphic designers, inspectors, facility managers, and many others, providing a varied, interesting, and challenging experience. **Minimum Qualifications (KSAs)** --------------------------------- (Illustrative only. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: About the Role T. Mark Fay Consulting, Inc. (Claim Toolkit) builds software that enterprise property and casualty carriers across the US and Canada rely on for claims audit, compliance, total loss, and auto liability work. We are hiring a full\-time, remote, US\-based Full Stack Developer. You will be the in\-house technical owner of our production applications. That means keeping them running, secure, and compliant day to day, delivering enhancements our carrier clients request, and helping lead the modernization of our legacy Classic ASP applications. You will work alongside a small internal team and our external development partner, with wide latitude to design, build, test, and release your solutions. Products You Will Support You will support all four Claim Toolkit product lines, with the heaviest day\-to\-day load in Total Loss and Compliance. * **Total Loss:** calculates state\-specific taxes and fees on total loss vehicle settlements. Main touchpoints are monthly tax and fee updates, state programming, vendor rate issues, new clients, Notice to Owner, and form letters. * **Compliance:** tracks claims handling against state regulatory requirements. Main touchpoints are MFA and login reporting, SSO, new customer setup, and enhancements such as an interest calculator. * **Audit:** supports carrier claim file audits. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. * **Auto Liability:** supports auto liability claim evaluation. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. Key Responsibilities **Production support and incidents (all products)** * Own incident response for all products, including 500 errors and failed scheduled jobs, with same\-day diagnosis and resolution * Write programming specs in real time when issues are found, and follow them through to release * Manage the code deployment and release process * Keep UAT documentation current, including server screenshots * Contribute to hardware and infrastructure discussions **Total Loss system** * Complete monthly tax and fee updates and program future\-dated changes * Program state\-specific rules in CORE and maintain them as regulations change * When tax rate issues surface, retrieve XML files and work directly with vendors such as Thomson Reuters to investigate * Set up new clients, modify vehicle types and categories, and add user access for select clients * Maintain address validation, form letters, and Notice to Owner PDFs * Rotate Dealertrack/Vitu credentials securely * Produce client tax and fee reports on request (for example, all first\-party claims finalized in a date range, with all taxes and fees) * Explain how calculations are programmed so internal staff can answer client questions * Support billing setup, invoices, and billing\-related emails **Security and compliance** * Prepare for and respond to the annual penetration test, and implement remediation * Keep MFA compliance reporting accurate and troubleshoot compliance reports * Research enterprise SSO gaps, such as logins not captured when users reach Compliance through Total Loss * Evaluate and, if approved, implement the Shibboleth upgrade * Finish the WAF (Sucuri) rollout: confirm which sites are protected, add the remaining sites, and update .asp pages to prevent false blocking * Set up new Compliance customers, in\-house and external, using the onboarding checklist **Integrations, SSO, and SFTP** * Install and maintain SSO for all products, including annual certificate renewals, and coordinate rollouts with developers * Manage SFTP and Guidewire integrations for Audit and Auto Liability **Enhancements** * Review enhancement requests with the Account Manager and help set priorities * Define and run the enhancement process: intake, mockup, customer approval, customer review, build, release * Build project timelines and keep work on schedule **Product modernization** * Help choose the target language and framework for rewriting legacy products, working with outside experts as needed * Redesign products collaboratively with the team, translate designs into clear specs, and build with the development team **Customers and team** * Work directly with new and existing carrier clients when technical context is needed * Mentor assigned team members and attend meetings as needed Technical Qualifications **Required** * Hands\-on production experience with Classic ASP/VBScript, plus ASP.NET, React and C\#,GitHub * Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, jobs, and database design * SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Integration Services (SSIS) for reports and automated data imports * JavaScript, jQuery, and React for front\-end work * RESTful API design and integration * SSO implementation and certificate management (SAML, Shibboleth, or similar) * IIS and Windows Server administration, including SFTP * Full software development life cycle: requirements, specs, development, testing, deployment, and support * Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues quickly **Preferred** * Node.js or other modern React frameworks * Experience modernizing or rewriting legacy applications * Web application firewall (WAF) configuration, MFA, and penetration test remediation * Guidewire integrations * P\&C insurance or claims industry experience, especially total loss taxes and fees or state regulatory rules The Successful Candidate The right person is accurate, transparent about status, and disciplined about process, because our carrier clients depend on calculations and compliance data being right the first time. * **Accurate and honest about status.** You report exactly where work stands, including what is not done or not yet validated. You never present something as complete before it is. * **Respects the QA process.** Every fix goes through QA before anyone tells a client it is resolved. You keep incidents assigned and tracked through resolution. * **Flags blockers early.** If testing is incomplete or something is blocking a release, you say so the same day rather than leaving it for someone to discover. * **Precise with regulated logic.** You treat tax, fee, and compliance calculations as near\-zero\-error work and test against every affected state, client, and vehicle type. * **Documents as you go.** You comment code to our standard, write clear specs and procedures, and turn undocumented knowledge of state rules and client setups into written reference material. * **Security\-minded.** You handle credentials, certificates, and server access carefully and raise anything that looks wrong, such as unexpected remote access or unfamiliar IPs. * **Responsive with clients and vendors.** You engage directly with client questions and vendor escalations instead of passing them along, and you write in plain, direct language that leaves a clear paper trail. * **Applies feedback.** You take feedback, change how you work, and do not repeat the same issue. * **Flexible and organized.** You shift priorities when a production issue lands and still manage scope and timelines on longer projects. * **Curious about AI and automation.** You are comfortable using AI tools in development and interested in our work on automated reporting, natural language queries, and AI\-assisted workflows. * **Lives our core values:** Excellence, Challenging Goals, and Kindness. Work Requirements This role must be US\-based and available during US business hours, because production issues and client escalations need same\-day response. * Must reside and work in the United States; some client contracts require US\-based development * Available during core US business hours for incidents, vendor calls, and client escalations * Able to respond to production issues, such as a 500 error at 2:00 PM, the same day * Willing to pass a background check and follow our data access, credential, and security policies, since the role involves sensitive client data and production system access Benefits and How to Apply * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off * Holiday Paid time off * Fully remote work Send your resume to Info@ClaimToolkit.com. Strong candidates will be invited to a conversation and a real\-world business and technical skills test. Pay: $96,700\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * Bereavement leave * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid jury duty * Paid time off * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Column** ---------------- For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve. At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology\-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. As an FDE, you'll work with customers to understand their problems in depth and help them build new products on Column's APIs. What you learn in the field will feed directly into how our engineering team improves the platform. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll get deep exposure to the full banking stack, from our APIs down to the Federal Reserve. This role is based in our Presidio office in San Francisco, with frequent travel to customer sites in the US and abroad. You will report directly to William, the CEO. Read more about Life @ Column and our hiring process here. **What you'll do:** * Work directly with our partner’s engineering teams to design, build and launch products with Column's state\-of\-the\-art banking stack * Act as the technical owner for strategic customers from onboarding to launch, unblocking them on architecture, ledgering, reconciliation and edge cases in money movement * Write production\-quality code, that speeds up integrations and grows into reusable product * Turn patterns from the field into product and platform improvements, working closely with engineering to shape our APIs, docs and developer experience * Advise customers on how to build safe, compliant and resilient financial products in a regulated environment * Represent Column in conversations with customer executives and engineering leaders, and build trusted, long\-term relationships **What we're looking for:** * Need to be fluent in either Spanish, French or Russian. * Strong engineering fundamentals, ideally with experience in backend systems, APIs or infrastructure * Product thinking: you look past the immediate ask to the underlying problem and the best solution, for the customer and for Column * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. You can explain complex systems clearly to an engineer or an executive * Executive presence and the confidence to lead high\-stakes customer conversations * Strong project management skills. You can run several customer engagements at once and keep each one moving * A self\-starter mindset. You're comfortable with ambiguity and with building process where none exists yet * Experience with payments, banking or financial infrastructure is a plus **What you’ll get from us:** ---------------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents! * Comprehensive family planning and fertility benefits via partnership with Carrot, including reimbursement of up to $20,000 in qualified expenses * Up to $2,000 (post\-tax) monthly rent subsidy for employees living within 2 miles of Column’s office * FSA and HSA account options to enable use of pre\-tax money for medical and dependent care expenses * 401k plan, including self\-directed brokerage options * Flexible time\-off policy \- take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge * Sabbatical Program \- Reach your 5\-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest \- with full salary and benefits * 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers * Up to $4,500 in annual reimbursements for backup childcare * Catered lunches and dinners for SF employees * Commuter benefits, including paid transportation to\-and\-from the office * Regular team building events, including annual offsite **Pay transparency:** --------------------- Compensation packages at Column include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers. jobs.title: Upholstery Technician III
jobs.description: **About Comlux America** Comlux America is a world\-class VIP aircraft completion and refurbishment center located in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company designs, engineers, and installs custom luxury interiors and advanced aircraft systems for airliner\-derivative business jets. Comlux also offers scheduled and unscheduled maintenance services. Specializing in highly customized aircraft, Comlux transforms aircraft into personalized flying environments that reflect exceptional craftsmanship, precision engineering, and uncompromising safety. **Role Description** Under minimal supervision, the Upholstery Technician III performs advanced upholstery fabrication and installation for VIP aircraft completion projects. This role is responsible for sewing, foam fabrication, pattern alignment, and upholstery of aircraft seats, trim components, panels, and carpeting while ensuring all work meets engineering specifications, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. The Technician III serves as a senior technical resource within the upholstery shop, supporting production efficiency, troubleshooting complex upholstery challenges, and assisting in the development of junior technicians. **Essential Job Functions** * Prepare upholstered surfaces for foam and covering using various hand tools in accordance with approved company procedures. Clean adhesive residue from panels and remove materials from parts as required. * Perform advanced sewing operations and modifications to seat covers, curtains, cushions, and other upholstery components using industrial sewing machines and specialized upholstery tools. * Fabricate and upholster aircraft interior components including seats, cushions, trim panels, and soft goods in accordance with engineering drawings and design specifications. * Interpret complex material specifications and engineering drawings to ensure upholstered components meet design requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations. * Identify material requirements and request supplies in a timely manner to maintain continuous production workflow. * Ensure all regulatory documentation and installation records are properly completed in accordance with the Comlux Repair Station Quality Manual (RSQM) and other applicable quality standards. * Follow all departmental safety guidelines and ensure proper use of tools, equipment, and personal protective equipment. * Maintain a strong working knowledge of company installation procedures, process specifications, and Internal Operating Procedures (IOPs). * Provide guidance and technical support to Upholstery Technician Trainees, Technician I, and Technician II team members as needed. * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while supporting efficient shop operations. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience** * High School Diploma or GED required. Relevant trade school or vocational training preferred. * Advanced knowledge of aircraft upholstery fabrication processes within a corporate aviation or aircraft completions environment. * 6\+ years of upholstery, sewing, or aircraft interior fabrication experience preferred. * Ability to read, write, speak, and understand the English language. * Ability to read and interpret blueprints and engineering documentation. **Required Skills and Abilities** * Advanced knowledge of upholstery fabrication techniques including foam shaping, sewing, pattern alignment, and leather installation. * Strong understanding of RSQM procedures and FAA regulatory requirements related to aircraft interior fabrication and installation. * Working knowledge of computers and software systems utilized by Comlux. * Strong craftsmanship and attention to detail required for high\-end VIP aircraft interiors. * Ability to mentor junior technicians and support team productivity. * Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with production teams, supervisors, engineering, and quality personnel. **Work Environment** This position is based in an aircraft hangar environment and may involve: * Exposure to varying temperatures and weather conditions * Loud noise levels * Use of heavy machinery and specialized tools * Potential contact with chemicals or hazardous materials * Working in confined aircraft interior spaces **Why join us?** Your success is our success. As a LoopTech intern, you will write real code from week one, using modern agentic development tools to move from concept to shipped demo quickly, and you will see your work used by real people inside the organization. This position is a 12\-week paid internship located in Bloomington, Spencer, or Ellettsville Indiana. It is offered for a period extending from mid\-May through mid\-August (exact dates depend on school calendars.) This position includes 401(k) options, an assigned mentor, capstone presentation, and intern events. jobs.title: Lean Engineer
jobs.description: **Date:** Oct 6, 2026 **Location:** Wilmington, NC, US, 28405 **Company:** Corning Requisition Number: 77292 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. **Scope of Position:** Responsible for driving both foundational and transformational competencies within the Lean Organization and across the manufacturing plant. These competencies include but are not limited to Value Steam Mapping, Visual Management, Work Standardization, Gemba Engagement, Kanban, SMED, 5S, Pull Systems, etc. With these core competencies, this role will partner with Operations and the Lean Manufacturing Supervisor to improve plant performance in Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Morale, and Innovation. The intent of this role is to decrease overall manufacturing cost, increase operational efficiencies, and drive waste from the production processes in conjunction with the strategy of the Lean Organization. **Day to Day Responsibilities:** * Directly responsible for performing work in a safe manner and maintaining a safe work environment. This includes being responsible for their own safety, as well as that of others that may be at the facility, whether working, visiting, or apart of the Lean Organization. This individual will be responsible for observing safe work practices and being proactive at reporting and fixing any unsafe conditions. • Continuously developing lean skills individually, as a part of the Lean Organization, and within the plant as a whole. This includes learning and occasionally teaching current lean principles/methodology in order to overcome obstacles and start establishing a lean culture at the plant. This individual will work to become a trained lean facilitator, able to facilitate Kaizen events at the plant directly linked to both the foundational and transformational competencies. • Planning and facilitating 3\-4 Kaizen events per year. This could include workshops focused on Value Stream Mapping, Kanban, SMED, 5S etc. with oversight and help from the Lean Organization. Each workshop will have an agenda, deliverables defined and managed, and outcomes/next steps delivered to leadership. This individual will be responsible for the follow\-up after each event to ensure actions identified are being deployed across the site. • Tracking cost savings per each Kaizen event and working with the appropriate resources to quantify and ultimately realize lean cost savings. This will require partnership with both Engineering and Finance in order to complete. Each Lean Engineer is expected to save $250K annually as a result of all the projects identified and executed after each Kaizen event. • Supporting the site’s 5S program in conjunction with participation in routine Gemba performance audits with leadership. In addition, this individual will provide support as required to the plant’s iKaizen program in order to challenge the norm and try new and innovative ideas in order to promote lean thinking/methodology. • Owning one of the plant’s Value Stream Maps including both current state and future state upkeep, along with creating a cadence for routine review and updating within the Lean Organization and cross\-functionally with plant resources. This individual will be responsible for working the Engineering to have projects identified on the VSM be incorporated into the plant’s cost reduction portfolio with resourcing identified and managed. • Planning and implementing workplace flow/layout improvements in addition to analyzing new equipment installations, existing equipment movements, and equipment modifications in accordance with lean teachings and methodologies. This individual will also be r workstation changes. • Partnering with plant process engineering to establish the A3 process and subsequent deployment in order to drive root cause understanding of critical production issues. In addition, this individual will also be responsible for leading 5 PDCA’s every year, while maintaining the rigor of lean thinking, identifying root cause, and clearly demonstrating fundamental understanding of the issues identified. • Identifying and horizontally deploying benchmark opportunities at the division level and across the sister sites in partnership with the Lean Manufacturing Supervisor. Travel expected from this is less than 10% in order to facilitate best practice migration. **Travel Requirements:** \< 10% **Required Education:** BS Degree (Industrial Engineering Strongly Preferred) **Required Years and Area of Experience:** * 2 to 5 Years of Lean Engineering Experience **Required Skills:** * Demonstrated progressive roles in lean manufacturing coupled with the ability to articulate real lean tool application with demonstrated results. • Ability to support the Lean Organization’s vision and strategy, in order to promote culture change while acting as an agent of change for lean thinking and methodologies. • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to present ideas, opinions, and data to gain understanding consensus, and support. • Knowledge of manufacturing methods, systems, and production processes. • Process/results oriented with organizational and attention\-to\-detail abilities. **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $86,197\.00 \- $118,521\.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. **A job that shapes a life.** **Corning offers you the total package.** Your well\-being is our priority. jobs.title: Sr DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior DevOps Engineer supports Credit Union of Texas's vision to be the trusted financial partner for our members and our community by building and owning the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) on Azure DevOps. The role modernizes and standardizes the SDLC for existing applications, implements CI/CD and multi\-environment (Dev, UAT, Prod) strategies, and makes the Node.js application code changes needed to support them. The role establishes secure secrets management, artifact management, static and dynamic application security testing (SAST with JFrog and DAST with Invicti), code quality and test coverage gates (SonarQube), Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and observability practices (Datadog APM and Logs) that make releases repeatable, traceable, and audit\-ready. Once the foundation is in place, the Senior DevOps Engineer contributes to Node.js development and onboards new applications onto the standardized SDLC. The role uses CUTX\-approved AI tools under defined governance, with mandatory human review of any AI\-assisted code or configuration before it reaches production. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **CI/CD, Source Control \& Release Management** * Design and implement CI/CD pipelines (YAML) in Azure DevOps for existing and new applications. * Manage Azure Repos, including branching strategy, branch policies, pull request workflows, and code review gates. * Design and implement multi\-environment strategies (Dev, UAT, Prod) with automated promotion, including the infrastructure and application changes required to support them. * Set up release strategies such as approvals, environment promotion, and rollback. * Implement feature flags using Azure App Configuration to reduce release risk. ### **Security, Secrets \& Code Quality** * Implement and standardize secrets management using Azure Key Vault and Managed Identity across applications, including the Node.js code changes needed to load secrets and configuration securely at runtime. * Establish secure secret lifecycle practices, including rotation and access controls. * Implement static application security testing (SAST) using JFrog Advanced Security, with critical and high findings blocking merges and releases. * Integrate SonarQube for code quality and unit test coverage analysis (coverage thresholds, bugs, code smells, duplication, and maintainability), with quality gates enforced on every pull request and pipeline run. * Integrate Invicti for dynamic application security testing (DAST) against deployed applications in Dev and UAT, with critical and high findings blocking promotion to Production. * Coordinate triage and remediation of SAST, DAST, dependency, and secret scanning findings with development teams and Information Security, and track them to closure in Azure Boards. * Implement dependency, vulnerability, and secret scanning (such as JFrog Xray, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps, or Gitleaks) with results enforced in pipelines. * Enforce code consistency standards with ESLint and Prettier in pull request checks. ### **Infrastructure, Artifacts \& Containers** * Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) for repeatable environment provisioning. * Set up and manage JFrog Artifactory for package and artifact management, including npm and Docker registries. * Containerize applications with Docker where appropriate, and support a future move to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). ### **Testing, Monitoring \& Observability** * Build automated testing into pipelines, including unit tests (Jest) and end\-to\-end tests (Playwright or Cypress). * Set up monitoring and observability with Datadog APM and Datadog Log Management across all environments, alongside Azure Monitor and Application Insights for Azure platform metrics. * Instrument Node.js applications with the Datadog APM tracer and structured logging, correlate traces with logs, and build dashboards, monitors, and alerts for service health, performance, and release impact. ### **Node.js Development \& Application Onboarding** * Make code changes in Node.js applications to support DevOps practices such as configuration management, health checks, logging, and automated tests. * Contribute to Node.js feature development and bug fixes as DevOps priorities allow. * Onboard new applications onto the standardized SDLC process. ### **Governance, Documentation \& Collaboration** * Set up Azure Boards for work tracking, with work items linked to commits, pull requests, and releases for end\-to\-end traceability and audit readiness. * Document pipelines, environments, runbooks, and processes in the Azure DevOps Wiki, and train team members on them. * Coordinate with Application Development, IT Operations, Information Security, and Compliance to align SDLC standards with enterprise priorities and control requirements. **Performance Outcomes \& KPIs** ============================= or log and data analysis. **Compliance \& Regulatory Responsibilities** ============================================= ### **Enterprise Compliance Obligations** The Senior DevOps Engineer is responsible for all enterprise compliance obligations applicable to a CUTX team member, including BSA/AML, OFAC, USA PATRIOT Act/CIP/CDD, GLBA and the Safeguards Rule, Fair Lending laws (ECOA/Reg B, Fair Housing Act), UDAAP, Information Security and Acceptable Use, and the CUTX Code of Conduct. ### **AI\-Specific Compliance Obligations** The Senior DevOps Engineer is responsible for the CUTX Generative AI Usage Policy (TRAIGA / HB 149\-aligned), the CUTX AI Playbook (including Tier 2 obligations applicable to this role), and Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (TRAIGA / HB 149\) requirements applicable to the role. ### **Role\-Specific Compliance Obligations** * CUTX Change Management, Release Management, and Secure SDLC standards covering approvals, segregation of duties, testing, and rollback. * Gramm\-Leach\-Bliley Act (GLBA) and the Safeguards Rule, and NCUA Part 748 information security program requirements, as applied to systems, pipelines, and environments that handle member data. * FFIEC IT Examination Handbook expectations for development, acquisition, and operations, including change traceability and audit evidence. * CUTX Information Security, Access Management, and Secrets Management policies, including least\-privilege access and credential rotation. * CUTX Vendor and Third\-Party Risk Management requirements for DevOps, cloud, artifact and security testing (JFrog, Invicti), code quality (SonarQube), and observability (Datadog) tools. * CUTX Data Governance and Data Classification policies as applied to non\-production environments, code repositories, and logs, including masking of member NPI and secrets before logs and traces are sent to Datadog. **Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements** =============================================== This role is performed primarily on\-site at the CUTX Corporate Office in the Dallas–Fort Worth, TX area, with hybrid eligibility subject to manager approval and CUTX policy. The work environment is office\-based with no significant hazardous or unpleasant conditions. Occasional after\-hours or weekend work may be required to support production releases, maintenance windows, or incident response. Essential physical activities include the ability to remain stationary at a workstation for extended periods; operate a computer, telephone, and standard office equipment; perform frequent repetitive motions of the hands, wrists, and fingers (keyboard and mouse use); communicate clearly by phone, email, video, and in person with technical and business partners; and read, analyze, and interpret detailed written and on\-screen information. The role requires the ability to apply reasoning to problems involving many variables and to communicate complex technical concepts in plain language. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role, consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and CUTX policy. **Acknowledgement \& Disclaimer** ================================= This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required, and CUTX reserves the right to modify, add to, or remove duties at any time as business needs require. Employment with CUTX is at\-will. This job description does not constitute an employment contract. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software EngineerAbout the Team** CuraFi is building AI\-native infrastructure for healthcare operations. We work on complex, high\-impact problems across clinical workflows, healthcare data, automation, and decision support—using AI to turn traditionally manual, fragmented processes into scalable software systems. Our engineering team operates like an early\-stage startup team: small, highly technical, and deeply involved in the product. Engineers work across application development, AI systems, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment rather than being limited to a narrow part of the stack. We care about moving quickly without creating fragile systems. The problems we solve often begin loosely defined, involve messy real\-world data and workflows, and ultimately need to operate reliably at significant scale. **About the Role** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who has helped build and scale software **during a period of rapid company growth.** The ideal candidate has worked at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup and has personally taken products or services from **0 to production to meaningful scale**. You should be comfortable owning a system end\-to\-end: understanding the problem, designing the architecture, building the application, deploying it, operating the infrastructure, and improving it as usage grows. This is not a role where requirements are handed down and engineering simply implements them. We want someone with strong technical intuition who can look at an ambiguous problem, determine what should be built, identify the right abstractions, and ship quickly. You will work heavily on the infrastructure and AI pipelines behind CuraFi's products, including distributed processing systems, healthcare integrations, AI agents, document intelligence, APIs, and production LLM applications. **In this role, you will:** * Own critical products and services end\-to\-end across architecture, development, deployment, infrastructure, monitoring, and scaling. * Design and operate distributed systems and asynchronous processing pipelines handling large volumes of healthcare data and workflows. * Build production AI systems using LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, document intelligence, and custom AI pipelines. * Develop infrastructure for LLM\-powered applications including evaluation, prompting, tool use, guardrails, observability, and reliability. * Build document processing and LLM/OCR pipelines capable of transforming complex healthcare documents into structured, actionable data. * Design high\-performance APIs and integrations with healthcare systems, external vendors, and third\-party platforms. * Build systems that remain reliable as workloads increase by orders of magnitude. * Make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance speed of development with long\-term scalability. * Experiment aggressively with new AI models, frameworks, coding tools, and infrastructure—and develop strong opinions about what works in production versus what does not. * Debug difficult issues across application code, distributed workers, databases, infrastructure, networking, and third\-party systems. * Work directly with product, operations, customers, and other engineers to turn real\-world workflow problems into scalable software. * Help establish the technical patterns, infrastructure, and engineering culture that CuraFi will build on as the company grows. **Your background looks something like:** * **5\+ years of software engineering experience** is ideal, with significant experience building production systems. * Strong startup experience, particularly at an early\-stage or rapidly scaling technology company. * Experience helping a product or platform move from **0 → 1 and then from 1 → scale**. * A track record of owning production services end\-to\-end, including architecture, implementation, deployment, infrastructure, monitoring, and ongoing operation. * Strong Python experience and a deep understanding of backend engineering. * Strong knowledge of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, queues, workers, concurrency, failure handling, and system reliability. * Experience designing and operating systems on AWS. * Experience building production APIs and complex third\-party integrations. * Experience building AI\-powered applications using modern LLMs. * Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, or experience building comparable orchestration systems directly. * Experience with retrieval systems, embeddings, vector databases, or platforms such as Pinecone. * Experience building document intelligence, OCR, multimodal, or LLM\-based extraction pipelines is highly valuable. * Practical understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, evaluations, guardrails, context management, and production LLM reliability. * Experience with voice AI agents or real\-time AI systems is a plus. * Strong SQL and relational database fundamentals. * Strong intuition around system architecture and an ability to recognize when something should be simple versus when additional infrastructure is justified. * Comfort working in an environment where requirements may be incomplete, priorities can change quickly, and engineers are expected to exercise judgment rather than wait for detailed specifications. * High curiosity around new developer and AI tooling. We want engineers who actively experiment with the latest coding agents, models, frameworks, and infrastructure and understand how to use them to dramatically increase engineering velocity. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who has **actually built and scaled systems in a startup environment**, experienced the technical problems that emerge as a product grows, and helped establish the engineering foundation needed for the next stage of the company. **About CuraFi** CuraFi builds software and AI systems that help healthcare organizations automate complex administrative and clinical workflows. Healthcare infrastructure is fragmented, operationally intensive, and filled with problems that require combining software engineering, AI, domain knowledge, and systems thinking. We believe many of these workflows can be fundamentally redesigned using modern AI. We are building the technical foundation to make that possible. CuraFi is an equal opportunity employer. We value people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are committed to building an environment where exceptional people can do their best work. Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day\-to\-day preventive and corrective maintenance, painting, and housekeeping for assigned properties **Job Description** Important Education * High School Diploma of GED Equivalent * Graduate of apprentice program or trade school preferred Important Experience * 5\+ years of related work experience in operating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems in a commercial property setting Essential Functions and Responsibilities * Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s) * Maintain heating equipment, chillers (air and/ or water cooled), DX units, pumps, cooling towers, fan coil units, VAV, and air distribution systems, etc. * Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings * Verify field conditions and perform any necessary repairs or adjustments * Monitor Energy Management * Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors and other general repairs, adjustments and installations about the property * Perform repairs to plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valve assemblies, lavatories, etc.) * Perform preventive maintenance duties in accordance with C\&W standards, building protocol, manufacturer recommendations and industry best practices, including changing filters, cleaning coils, flushing condensers, punching tubes, greasing fan, pump and motor bearings as required, inspecting and adjusting belts, replacing motor bearings, aligning pulleys and shafts, monitor directed. * Inspect engine room equipment, fan room equipment, cooling tower, all motors, house pumps, electric rooms, back\-up generator, fire pump(s), sump pump(s), and ejector pumps. Replace lamps, light fixtures, reinstall or replace signage, verify rooms are clean and clear of obstructions and debris * Check for properly operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About DAT** DAT Freight \& Analytics is an award\-winning employer of choice and a next\-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million\+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 10/31/2026 **The Opportunity** DAT Solutions is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the first engineer in a new function within our Integrations organization: platform and developer experience for third\-party integrators. Our integrations teams connect DAT to the systems brokers, shippers, and carriers run their businesses on, from TMS platforms to partner APIs. Today, no one owns the experience of building on DAT from the outside: the SDKs, documentation, observability, and tooling integrators depend on. You will. You will report to the Engineering Manager of Integrations, work alongside our inbound and outbound integration teams, and partner closely with Product, Customer Support, and Engineering across the organization. The function starts small, and its size and shape will grow with the impact you demonstrate. **Candidate profile** You are a Staff Engineer who builds. Hand you a problem no one at DAT has solved yet and you stand up a proof of concept in days, put it in front of real users, and let what you learn decide what happens next. You are pragmatic: you would rather deliver customer value in weeks than polish something no one asked for. You are comfortable with ambiguity and limited direction, and you do your best work partnering across teams to turn a promising idea into something that ships. You understand your customers, including the brokers and integrators who increasingly build with AI coding assistants, and you design for how they actually work. Key Measures for Success: * Working proofs of concept delivered early, with the ones that prove out taken to production * Third\-party integrators, including those building with AI coding assistants, can build, test, and troubleshoot against DAT APIs without engineering hand\-holding * Documentation, API specifications, and examples that consistently produce good results when integrators use AI tools * One or more SDKs that reduce the effort for partners to integrate with DAT * Production\-grade API logging and monitoring that gives Product, Engineering, and Customer Support a shared, trustworthy view of integration health * Light, practical guidelines applied to our customer\-facing APIs, starting with new integration surfaces such as shipment ingest * Effective knowledge\-sharing and mentorship across engineering teams **What You'll Do** * Build proofs of concept for developer experience and platform capabilities that have not been solved at DAT before, and take the ones that prove out to production * Execute against our established architectures, refining them where they need it, and partner across Integrations, Product, Support, and Engineering to drive impact * Design, build, and maintain SDKs and developer tooling in TypeScript, treating integrators as customers * Build documentation, OpenAPI specifications, and examples that work well when integrators use AI coding assistants, and learn how our customers actually use AI so you can make them successful * Design and build API logging and monitoring that gives teams visibility into how integrations behave in production * Help shape lightweight governance for our customer\-facing APIs (consistency, versioning, authentication, error handling, and deprecation), applied through an abstraction layer between our internal services and integrators * Anticipate and communicate roadblocks before they require escalation, and align stakeholders across teams on shared direction * Reduce toil and improve the reliability, cost, and performance of our integration services * Use AI\-assisted development in your own work and share what works with your teammates * Write unit, integration, and functional tests, jobs.title: AI Product Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Remote (North America; San Francisco or Austin preferred) · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $140K–$180K base \+ competitive equity ### **About the Company** Our client is an early\-stage, venture\-backed AI infrastructure company that helps enterprises trust their voice AI agents. Their platform covers testing before launch, adversarial stress\-testing, and monitoring of live calls in production. They already serve enterprise customers in regulated industries such as healthcare, financial services, and telecom, and revenue has grown quickly over the past year. You'll sit with the technical teams who use the platform, figure out what they actually need, and then build and ship it yourself. The team ships several times a day, the founder still writes code, and there are no handoffs between the person who hears the problem and the person who solves it. **What you'll be doing** * Working closely with enterprise engineering teams to uncover gaps, then scoping and shipping the fix yourself * Taking features from first conversation through prototype, launch, and iteration, across both frontend and backend * Acting as a hands\-on technical partner during pilots and after the sale * Turning one\-off customer solutions into reusable parts of the platform * Using AI coding tools as a normal part of how you build, so you can move at startup speed **Tech stack:** TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, Codex, LiveKit, WebSockets, Pipecat, Temporal, AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Figma, Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs ### **Requirements** * Up to about 3 years of experience in a role that mixes coding with customer contact, such as product engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or running your own startup * Something you built and shipped that real people used, whether at work, as a founder, or as a side project * Time spent at a startup, founder\-led company, or fast\-moving team where you owned work from start to finish * A degree from a top\-tier computer science or engineering program (our client recruits from a defined list of leading universities) * AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex are part of your everyday workflow, and you can explain concretely how they change the way you plan and ship * Solid TypeScript and Python, with the range to work across APIs, data, and user interfaces to deliver a complete feature * Strong ownership and clear writing: you start with whatever context is available, move quickly, and keep everyone updated on progress and next steps * An entrepreneurial streak, such as founding something, applying to an accelerator, or growing a side project with real traction * Willingness to travel roughly 10 to 20 percent of the time for customer visits, conferences, and team offsites ### **Nice to Haves** * Some experience working with enterprise customers, or a clear interest in growing into that kind of work ### **Why Join** * Work at the infrastructure layer of voice AI, one of the fastest\-growing areas in applied AI * A company with real customers, real usage, and real revenue, not a pre\-product bet * A small, senior\-leaning team where more than half the people have founded companies * Genuine ownership from your first week and direct influence on the product roadmap * Competitive salary and equity at a company early enough for that equity to matter ### **Details** * **Location:** Remote within North America (San Francisco or Austin preferred) * **Work policy:** Remote\-first, with 10 to 20 percent travel * **Compensation:** $140,000–$180,000 \+ equity * **Visa sponsorship:** Open to visa transfers (for example H\-1B transfer or OPT); unable to sponsor new visas * **Employment type:** Full\-time

The employee must be capable of lifting and/or moving up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Employee must be physically fit enough to free climb 250 ft multiple times a day while wearing 25\+ lbs of climbing gear under extraordinary weather conditions. Must be capable of rescuing team mate anywhere in tower in the event of emergency. Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions. **DESCRIPTION OF TASKS**: * Provide preventative and corrective maintenance on Mitsubishi 2\.4 wind turbines per DWT instructions * Complete all relevant paperwork, including work order cards, checklists, AWPs etc. * Ensure all health and safety procedures are followed * Assist with the replacement of major turbine components e.g. generators and gearboxes * Assist in all areas of site operations * Provide safe access and egress to all people in the work party * Adhere to general Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) practices * Comply with Deutsche\-Windtechnik Policies and Procedures and customer site rules * Report all incidents and occurrences as per Deutsche Windtechnik Health and Safety policy * Perform routine preventive maintenance on wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems (under direction and supervision, if needed) * Assist with wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems troubleshooting and repairs * Recognize occurrences of wind turbine error codes and appropriately report the problem * Assist with removal and installation of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components * Perform wind turbine controller maintenance * Complete required reports and other paperwork, some of which require computer entry * Assist with high\-voltage system maintenance and repair * Maintain adherence to company policies, safety standards and good housekeeping practices * Maintain proper care of company tools and vehicles **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS****:** * High school graduate / GED * Associate degree preferred (not required) * 1\-2 years of experience in wind energy, or with electrical, mechanical and technical equipment * Valid driving license (NON CDL / CDL) * Must be able to pass a physical exam and drug/alcohol screening **EQUIPMENT, MACHINES, TOOLS USED****:** Electrical Testing Equipment, torque wrench, crane rigging, Scada systems, computer, computer software, scanner, printer, telephone, copier **DESCRIPTION OF WORK ENVIRONMENT****:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; particulate matter and outside weather conditions. The employee can be exposed to risks of electrical hazards. The employee is occasionally exposed to hazardous chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION****:** This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position.
