jobs.title: Senior Electrical Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. **We want people who are passionate about optimizing and troubleshooting data center hardware at mega\-scale so our customers don't have to worry!** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Reporting to the Director of Datacenter Engineering, you will lead design, deployment, and monitoring of next\-generation power infrastructure in high\-density datacenter environments. The ideal candidate will be eager to face new challenges as DigitalOcean continues to scale its data center footprint and explore new technologies to bring to our customers. **What You'll Be Doing:** ------------------------- * Act as primary SME for all power\-related engineering topics at DigitalOcean * Act as secondary SME for all cooling\-related engineering topics at DigitalOcean * Evangelize power distribution and efficiency technologies throughout the Infra organization and company * Develop and maintain standards and practices for DigitalOcean datacenter facilities * Inform facility design requirements with best practices for medium\- and low\-voltage power distribution, redundancy topologies, and high\-density rack power delivery * Liaise with colocation facility engineering teams regarding electrical system designs * Liaise with vendor hardware engineering teams regarding hardware electrical design requirements * Lead selection of rack power distribution systems (busway, PDUs, rack\-level power shelves) during the hardware design, ensuring designs not only meet our current needs but can scale with us * Develop power monitoring tooling and systems to aggregate electrical monitoring information (branch circuit, PDU, and rack\-level) and provide alerting capabilities * Coordinate with operations on monitoring thresholds, failure modes and alerting * Assist in troubleshooting cause of failures and work to prevent them in the future * Work closely with Infra teams such as DC Operations and Machine Design to ensure facility readiness for next\-generation solutions **What We'll Expect From You:** ------------------------------- * Technical Degree (BS Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or Power Systems Engineering) or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating power infrastructure at scale (including experience with utility service entrances, medium\-voltage switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, ATS/STS, busway, PDUs, RPPs, and rack\-level power distribution) * An in\-depth understanding of facility power topologies and technologies (N, N\+1, 2N, and distributed redundant designs; 415/240V and 480V distribution; high\-voltage DC and rack\-level power shelves; etc.) * Strong understanding of power quality, load management, and selective coordination principles in mission critical environments and knowledge of best practices around electrical monitoring and alerting * Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, UL) and arc flash safety practices * Clear communication and collaboration across key stakeholders * An insatiable passion for constant improvement **Compensation Range:** ----------------------- * $130,000 \- $160,000 * This is a onsite role JR: 2026\-7652 *\#LI\-Onsite* **Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean** -------------------------------------------- * **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting\-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions. * **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high\-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000\+ courses to support their continued growth and development. * **We care about your well\-being.** Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences. * **We reward our employees.** The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program. * **DigitalOcean is an equal\-opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. **Application Limit:** You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180\-day period. This policy promotes better role\-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

jobs.title: z/OS Automations Scheduling Support Technician
jobs.description: Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is seeking a highly skilled **z/OS Automations Scheduling Support Technician** to provide advanced automation, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for IBM z/OS mainframe environments. This position is responsible for identifying opportunities to improve manual processes through automation, supporting enterprise job scheduling and monitoring solutions, implementing software upgrades, and ensuring the stability, security, and performance of mission\-critical mainframe systems. The successful candidate will work closely with system programmers, engineers, government personnel, and technical teams to develop automated solutions, manage system resources, support disaster recovery activities, maintain documentation, and ensure compliance with Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), U.S. Cyber Command, and organizational policies and procedures. **Responsibilities:** * Provide the analytical ability to identify problem areas in manual processes and develop automated solutions. * Utilize IBM System z/OS automation, job scheduling, system monitoring and alerting products from vendors to include BMC Software, CA Technologies, and IBM. * Provide customer support (internal and external) on questions and incidents relating to automation on the mainframe systems, to include changes, upgrades, new and discontinued features, and known problems. * Ensure that all system resources required for automation are available for successful implementation. * Ensure shared resources and the tools used to manage resource sharing are properly configured. * Develop test plans, test cases, and test data for each release test effort. Test plans will include security compliance, functional, integration, performance, and regression testing to detect and resolve flaws that may impact the security, integrity, and stability of the automation. * Coordinate with other system programmers and managers whenever a change in automation interfaces with another mainframe component that and may require changes to, or have an impact on, that component. * Ability to work in a team environment and share developed solutions for approval and implementation. * Adhere to and participate in this organization’s Change Management and CAB policies and procedures. * Provide support using standard tools (currently BMC Control Products Suite) for scheduling to include building, maintaining, and scheduling batch processing (to include complex system abend (error) recovery techniques). Provide real\-time accurate monitoring and troubleshooting of multiple mainframe systems and applications. * Use government documented processes and procedures to download and install application releases. * Develop and deliver detailed documentation, using government specified documentation software and processes. This documentation shall include details of download requirements, installation dataset names and configuration specifications used to implement or install the software or hardware. * Utilize government specified tools to create, submit, and update change and incident requests. The change or incident requests will conform to government documented requirements for change requests, incident requests and service requests, including implementation/upgrade start and end dates, specification of systems affected, installation and verification plans, back out procedures, specification of tasks required to be performed by other teams, and ASI requirements required for mission partner coordination. * Properly handle documents according to appropriate regulations and guidance including, classification level. * Complete required annual DISA and DoD training by government specified deadlines. * Use government documented processes and procedures to request and download required software, software patches and documentation. * Create, execute, and debug JCL to use IBM system utilities (including IEBCOPY, IEBGENER, and IDCAMS) to create and manipulate datasets and files on the IBM z/OS mainframe platform. * Adhere to DoD and U.S. Cyber Command Directives, and local policies for security access, processes, and regulations. * Exhibit effective and professional interpersonal skills to include written and oral communications. * Submit WARs. * Review \& update all SOP/TTP’s to reflect process, technology, organization changes, etc. Develop and coordinate changes to the author, team/technical lead or section supervisor and ensures new documentation is relayed to team. * Attend and participate in meetings, provide technical expertise to respond to questions, issues, and concerns. * On the job, provide support, train, counsel, and mentor government employees, junior technicians, and engineers within the teams. * Plan, create, open, update and close change and incident management tickets using government approved software and processes. The tickets shall include implementation schedules, affected systems, affected software or hardware components, test plans, back\-out plans, and required CRQ/ASI information as documented. * Participate in regularly scheduled CAB meetings to obtain final approval for implementing application release upgrades. * Use Information Technology Infrastructure Library processes and procedures to document implementation of application software implementations and upgrades using government specified processes and procedures. * Provide required support for disaster recovery COOP exercises. This includes creation, interpretation, and updating documentation of COOP/disaster recovery processes and procedures to perform tabletop simulations and actual recovery of IBM Mainframe platforms. * Create and provide installation/upgrade status reports to the government. * Comply with requirements of 8570 and 8140, including Computing Environment certification and Security\+, A\+, or equivalent as specified in the DoD order **Qualifications:** * Years of Experience: 3 years * Education Level: Associates degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mat * Clearance Requirements: Secret * Certification Requirements: IAT\-I **About Us** Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is a Navajo Nation–owned family of companies that provides government agencies and commercial organizations with high\-quality IT, professional, environmental, and research and development services. DDC is dedicated to empowering the Navajo Nation and the communities we serve. **Benefits** Eligible full\-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, retirement savings with company match, and paid time off. Additional benefits include voluntary supplemental benefits, access to an employee assistance program, and educational assistance with tuition reimbursement. **Equal Opportunity \& Compliance Statement** This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60\-1\.4(a), 60\-300\.5(a), and 60\-741\.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or for inquiring about, discussing, or disclosing information about compensation, or any other basis prohibited by law. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Dragonfly Health \- A great place to land** Dragonfly Health is the leading care\-at\-home data, technology and service platform, and the industry’s first scale durable medical equipment (DME) and pharmacy solution. Built on a 20\-year history, Dragonfly Health uses advanced technology and robust analytics to manage DME and pharmaceutical services as part of a single, efficient solution for caregivers, patients, and their families. We serve over 145,000 patients every day in all 50 states. Here, you are an integral part of a team that is transforming the future of hospice and post\-acute healthcare. This is where innovation, collaboration and compassion thrive, allowing us to carry out our work at the highest level to serve our patients at a time in their life when they need us most. We offer a dynamic and inclusive workplace where you'll have the unique opportunity to shape the future of healthcare alongside a passionate and talented team. We believe in empowering our employees to grow both personally and professionally, providing ample opportunities for career advancement, continuous learning, and skill development. #### **Dragonfly Health is our name for a reason.** The dragonfly is symbolic of the transformational impact we’re making on the industry, our people, and the lives we touch. We are a guiding force for what’s ahead, delivering more than equipment and medications, but also comfort and peace of mind. We are agile and adaptable, able to quickly and easily pivot from one point to the next, ready for whatever situation or patient need that arises. #### **Whatever it takes. Wherever it takes us.** ### **What we offer** * Competitive Compensation * Comprehensive Benefits Package (Health, Dental, Vision, PTO, Sick Time, 401k w/match, etc.) * Growth Opportunity and Career Advancement * Agile and Adaptable team culture * Innovative and revolutionary technology solutions * A higher calling to provide quality patient care **See how Dragonfly Health is transforming the world of hospice and post\-acute care. (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dfhealth\_see\-how\-dragonfly\-health\-is\-transforming\-activity\-7204921020292476928\-Ut\_7?utm\_source\=share\&utm\_medium\=member\_desktop)** ### **What you will do** * Lead technical design and development for complex software features, products, and improvements. * Contribute throughout the application lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and maintenance. * Lead smaller projects or serve as a significant technical contributor on larger initiatives. * Troubleshoot complex software issues and deliver complete, well\-designed solutions. * Serve as a subject matter expert for key systems and help shape engineering practices and technical direction. * Mentor engineers through code reviews, cross\-training, and knowledge sharing, supported by clear technical documentation. * Collaborate across teams to communicate technical decisions and project progress while ensuring quality, security, and regulatory standards are met. ### **What we look for** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 7 or more years of software development experience; a master’s degree and 1–2 years of project leadership experience are preferred. * Strong experience with an object\-oriented language, common web development patterns such as model\-view\-controller, and enterprise software development on Agile teams. * Strong relational database expertise, including design, programming, and performance tuning, plus experience with Entity Framework or a similar framework; Microsoft SQL Server preferred. * Experience designing secure applications, solving difficult technical problems independently, and making sound design decisions. * Strong communication and technical leadership skills, with the ability to mentor engineers, influence across teams, and manage competing priorities. * Basic understanding of durable medical equipment and hospice operations, with a commitment to patient confidentiality and HIPAA compliance. * Preferred experience includes JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React, cloud platforms such as AWS, scripting tools, Xamarin mobile development, or benefits, transaction processing, or financial services systems. ### **Why Senior Software Engineers are important** Your technical decisions will influence how our software performs, evolves, and supports the business. jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dynamo Technologies is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer to join our team in a hybrid capacity (2–3 days per week onsite). This role is ideal for a proactive problem\-solver who thrives in complex enterprise environments and is passionate about designing, implementing, and supporting secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for the provisioning, installation, configuration, operation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions across on\-premises and government cloud environments. This role will ensure that system hardware, operating systems, software systems, and related procedures adhere to organizational values and regulatory requirements. process improvement/efficiencies. * Maintain and oversee data backup solutions to ensure mission objective are met. * Research, build, and implement file sharing technologies to meet customer requirements. * Troubleshoot and advise on advanced storage issues/deficiencies. * Perform routine equipment checks and preventative maintenance. * Perform storage analysis, capacity planning, and and backup technologies. * Two (2\) years hands\-on experience working with Department of War (DoW) IT systems. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with enterprise SAN (Storage Area Network) management to include capabilities and technologies such as: Fiber Channel zoning, iSCSI, FCoE (Fiber Channel over Ethernet) unified fabric, HBA/CNA (Host Bus Adapter/Converged Network Adapter), jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer – AI, Automation \& Databricks** **Location:** Houston, TX **Work Arrangement:** Houston\-based / Onsite as required **Experience:** 8\+ years preferred **Employment Type:** Contract / Full\-Time, based on project requirement **Job Summary** We are looking for a highly experienced and innovative **Senior Data Engineer** to assess, modernize, and optimize enterprise Data Engineering processes while driving the adoption of **automation, Artificial Intelligence, and Agentic AI**. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands\-on Data Engineering expertise with a proactive problem\-solving mindset. This individual will evaluate existing engineering processes, identify opportunities for AI and automation, develop Proofs of Concept (POCs), and help transition successful ideas into production\-ready solutions. The role requires deep experience with **Databricks, AWS Redshift, modern Data Engineering architectures, AI\-enabled engineering practices, and AI solutions across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, challenging existing approaches, proposing innovative solutions, and collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities** * Assess existing **Data Engineering platforms, workflows, pipelines, architecture, and operational processes** and identify opportunities for optimization. * Design and implement improvements to enhance data pipeline performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency. * Identify opportunities to introduce **automation and AI capabilities** across Data Engineering processes. * Develop **Proofs of Concept (POCs)** for AI\- and automation\-driven ideas and evaluate their technical and business feasibility. * Drive successful POCs through implementation and production adoption in collaboration with engineering, architecture, security, and business teams. * Design and implement solutions leveraging **Agentic AI, Generative AI, and AI\-assisted Data Engineering**. * Identify opportunities to apply AI throughout the **Software Development Life Cycle**, including: * Requirements analysis * Solution design * Code generation and optimization * Data pipeline development * Automated testing * Data quality validation * Documentation * Monitoring and observability * Incident analysis and troubleshooting * Build and optimize scalable Data Engineering solutions using **Databricks**. * Design, develop, and optimize enterprise data workloads using **AWS Redshift**. * Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines supporting large\-scale structured and unstructured data environments. * Evaluate existing engineering practices and proactively recommend improvements rather than relying solely on predefined requirements. * Identify repetitive or manual engineering activities that can be automated through scripts, workflows, AI agents, or orchestration platforms. * Partner with Data Engineers, Data Architects, Data Scientists, AI/ML teams, application teams, and business stakeholders. * Translate complex technical opportunities into clear business value and build stakeholder alignment around proposed solutions. * Establish reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, accelerators, and best practices. * Conduct technical evaluations of emerging AI and Data Engineering technologies and recommend appropriate adoption strategies. * Support troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of complex Data Engineering and platform\-related issues. * Document technical designs, architecture decisions, POCs, implementation approaches, and operational procedures. **Required Technical Skills** * Strong hands\-on experience in **Data Engineering** within large\-scale enterprise environments. * Advanced experience with **Databricks**. * Strong experience with **AWS Redshift**. * Strong understanding of: * Data lakes and lakehouse architectures * Data warehouses * ETL/ELT architecture * Distributed data processing * Data pipeline orchestration * Data quality and governance * Performance optimization * Hands\-on experience with **Apache Spark / PySpark**. * Strong programming experience with **Python**. * Strong SQL development and query optimization skills. * Experience working with AWS Data and Analytics services. * Experience designing and supporting scalable cloud\-based data platforms. * Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps principles within Data Engineering environments. **AI \& Automation Experience** Candidates should have practical experience applying AI beyond traditional analytics or machine learning use cases. Preferred experience includes: * **Agentic AI / AI Agents** * Generative AI applications within Data Engineering * LLM\-based engineering solutions * AI\-assisted code generation and review * Automated pipeline troubleshooting * Intelligent Data Quality validation * AI\-assisted data transformation and mapping * AI\-driven monitoring and anomaly detection * Automated documentation and metadata generation * AI\-enabled SDLC processes * Prompt engineering and LLM integration * Development of AI/automation POCs * Integration of AI solutions into production engineering workflows Experience with AI development frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, or similar technologies** would be advantageous. **Required Professional Skills** * Strong analytical and **problem\-solving capabilities**. * Demonstrated ability to independently identify technical and process improvement opportunities. * Strong **innovation mindset** with a track record of proposing and implementing new ideas. * Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments without requiring detailed direction. * Strong communication and jobs.title: Principal Scientist, AI / ML
jobs.description: At Edwards Lifesciences, the Advanced Innovation \& Technology (AI\&T) teams harness imagination, courage, and resourcefulness to think beyond what’s currently possible and create solutions for patients many years into the future. As part of AI\&T, we're building an AI Center of Excellence (COE) focused on applying the power of AI to help patients live longer, healthier lives. As we expand our focus across the structural heart disease journey, AI is creating new opportunities to better understand and improve patient care. Our teams are applying AI to support clinical decision\-making, identify patients earlier, develop digital solutions that complement our therapies, and help employees work more efficiently so they can focus on work that matters most. We're building an AI COE that collaborates across our innovation\-focused teams throughout our global organization, helping accelerate innovation and build AI capabilities that create lasting impact for patients, clinicians, and employees. Together, we're committed to applying AI responsibly and thoughtfully while keeping patients at the center of everything we do. This is a rare opportunity to help define how AI is applied across the structural heart disease journey while shaping the next generation of therapies, digital solutions, and patient experiences. We’ll give you the tools and resources you need to create groundbreaking innovations that shape the future of structural heart technology. **How you will make an impact:** As a Principal Scientist, you will help define the scientific and technical direction of AI across the structural heart disease journey. This role requires deep expertise in machine learning and scientific leadership, with the ability to evaluate new technologies, incubate novel capabilities, and guide teams developing AI\-enabled products in regulated healthcare environments. * Lead the design and development of scalable AI solutions that address complex business problems in partnership with business subject matter experts, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams. * Lead the development of domain\-specific foundation models across structured and unstructured clinical and procedural datasets, including natural language, medical imaging, and waveforms. * Drive research and experimentation in generative AI, multimodal AI, representation learning, self\-supervised learning, agentic systems, and advanced machine learning techniques. * Ensure models are developed with appropriate rigor for generalizability, safety, fairness, robustness, and real\-world performance. * Identify, evaluate, and incubate new technology opportunities, including simulation, computational modeling, digital twins, physics\-informed AI, scientific machine learning, and next\-generation foundation models. * Deliver written quarterly technology\-scouting positions that inform real investment decisions. * Set scientific standards for the broader science group and provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and data scientists. * Partner with engineering, quality, clinical, and regulatory teams to support development of AI\-enabled products and digital solutions. * Collaborate on model evaluation, validation, risk management, and deployment strategies for regulated healthcare applications. * Assess operational feasibility by evaluating problem definitions, analyses, requirements, solution development, and proposed solutions. * Build and maintain robust data pipelines to train, test, and evaluate large language models (LLMs) and traditional machine learning models; engineer solutions using AI/ML frameworks and libraries. * Stay current with generative AI and traditional AI/ML research and trends and incorporate relevant advances into product offerings. * Improve and optimize model performance to ensure robustness, scalability, and efficiency. * Partner closely with AI Evaluation, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Software Engineering teams to support verification, validation, risk assessment, and regulatory documentation activities. * Rigorously evaluate models for systemic bias and stand up MLOps frameworks to monitor performance drift or shifts across different datasets. * Ensure code and model development are well documented and follow Edwards engineering practices. **What you’ll need (Required):** * Bachelor’s degree plus 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with demonstrated success working with cross\-functional IT and/or business teams on enterprise\-level, complex, or novel system implementations. * Proven experience designing, training, and validating machine learning models end to end. * Deep technical breadth across at least two of the following: natural language processing/agentic AI, computer vision, time\-series and signal modeling, or computational modeling and simulation. **What else we look for (Preferred):** * MS or PhD (preferred, but not required) in computer science, machine learning, biomedical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry depth. * 10 to 15 years in applied machine learning or AI research, with a track record of shipping models into production, not just publications. * Proficiency with common ML and DL libraries (e.g., scikit\-learn, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras), NLP/LLM libraries and APIs (e.g., Hugging Face libraries, LangChain or LlamaIndex, frontier model APIs, cloud and data platform APIs), and computer vision libraries (e.g., OpenCV, scikit\-image, PIL, torchvision). * Senior individual\-contributor technical leadership: provide influence on technical direction and provide mentoring without direct people leadership. * Prior experience in a cardiovascular, structural heart, or broader medtech environment. * Experience deploying AI/ML models to production systems, not just research models. * Experience in a leadership or senior technical role driving AI/ML strategy. * Experience with modern deep learning model architectures, such as convolutional neural networks (including U\-Nets), transformers (including large language models and vision transformers), diffusion models, and graph neural networks. * Experience with learning paradigms and system designs, such as generative AI, foundation models, self\-supervised learning (e.g., masked autoencoders and contrastive learning), multimodal learning, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic systems, and physics\-informed machine learning. * Experience with cloud computing environments (particularly Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure), as well as remote and distributed computing. * Strong technical programming skills, particularly in Python; experience with R, SQL, Julia, Rust, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Java, C\+\+, or similar languages is also valued. * Experience working with data platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, and/or Palantir. * Experience supporting development of regulated software, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), or AI\-enabled medical devices. * Familiarity with design controls, verification and validation activities, risk management, and Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP). * Experience with version control systems such as Git and agile development methodologies. * A peer\-reviewed publication record or equivalent recognized technical standing. * Relevant experience and training in the technologies used for development. * Excellent analytical, organizational, time management, information\-seeking, and attention to detail skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and relationship management skills, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives. * Ability to manage multiple tasks, competing priorities, and long\-term goals in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to interact professionally with colleagues at all organizational levels. * Ability to follow all company requirements, including applicable health and safety protocols, and take appropriate measures to prevent injury, protect the environment, and prevent pollution within the scope of the role. Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $132,000 to $186,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

frameworks. * Experience with cloud computing environments (particularly Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure), as well as remote computing and distributed computing. * Proficiency in Python; jobs.title: Transmission Line Design Engineer - New Grad - Civil - Reno
jobs.description: **Transmission Line Design Engineer – Entry Level (Reno, NV)** ENTRUST Solutions Group is seeking a Transmission Line Design Engineer new grad to join our team in Reno, NV. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and analyzing transmission line structures, conductors, and foundations, and supporting the construction of transmission lines that deliver electricity from power plants to homes and businesses. You'll start on projects in northern Nevada and grow into work for utility clients across the United States, learning the broader U.S. grid along the way. You will work closely with a diverse team of experienced engineers and PEs who will train you, along with project managers and stakeholders, to ensure safe and efficient delivery of power. This role is a great fit for December 2026 and May 2027 graduates. **You'll make periodic field visits to project sites, so you must live in the Reno area.** **Why Transmission Line Engineering?** The U.S. power grid is one of the most stable and in\-demand fields in engineering, and it's only growing. Much of the country's transmission infrastructure is decades old and due for replacement. At the same time, electricity demand is rising fast, driven by data centers, AI, and electrification. Utilities need engineers who can design the lines that make that growth possible, and that need isn't going away. Transmission line engineering is a unique, specialized niche within civil engineering, and it tends to pay well compared with many other civil disciplines. You'll also pick up a working knowledge of electrical engineering, and you may be surprised how familiar it feels. Electricity flowing through a line behaves a lot like water flowing through a pipe, so the hydraulics and fluids concepts you learned in school carry over. **Responsibilities:** * Design and analyze transmission line systems, including structures, conductors, and foundations. * Prepare detailed engineering drawings, material lists, calculations, specifications, and reports. * Conduct site visits and inspections to ensure compliance with design standards and safety regulations. * Collaborate with utility clients, project managers, contractors, and other engineers to ensure successful project execution in Nevada and across the U.S. * Utilize advanced software tools for modeling and simulation of transmission line performance (PLS\-CADD and PLS\-POLE – we'll train you). * Stay up to date with industry trends, standards, and best practices. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (completed, or expected by May 2027\). * EIT or plans to pass the FE exam within the first year * Comfortable working outdoors and traveling to project sites * Valid driver's license **Preferred Qualifications:** * Structural or geotechnical coursework * Internship or co\-op experience in civil, structural, or utility work * Any exposure to transmission line design and analysis software (e.g., PLS\-CADD, PLS\-POLE). **What We Offer:** * A supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages innovation. * Opportunities for professional growth and career development. * Hands\-on mentorship from licensed PEs and a clear path to your PE license. * Experience with utility clients across the U.S. and a broad understanding of the national grid. * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including generous paid time off, 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, and flexible work schedules. **Why Join Us?** At ENTRUST Solutions Group, a Leidos company, we are driven by a commitment to innovation, technical excellence, and delivering the critical infrastructure that powers and connects communities. Together with Leidos, we are building a scaled, end\-to\-end energy and infrastructure organization focused on modernizing the grid, improving reliability, and helping utilities and network providers meet rising demand. As an ENR top ranked firm, our team of more than 5,000 professionals brings deep technical expertise and advanced technology across electric, gas, and telecommunications infrastructure. We solve complex challenges for clients across North America and expanding markets, helping them strengthen reliability, expand capacity, and adapt to evolving infrastructure needs. We foster a culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are expected, and where people are empowered to challenge convention, think boldly, and make an impact. Whether you are looking to grow your expertise, lead transformative projects, or help shape the future of infrastructure, you will find opportunities to thrive here. If you are ready to outthink the status quo, tackle meaningful challenges, and build what is next, we would love to hear from you. **Explore More Opportunities:** Not quite the right fit? Check out all our openings at ENTRUST Solutions Group Careers (https://entrustsol.com/careers/). To learn more about ENTRUST Benefits and Culture, please visit our company LinkedIn page and follow us at: https://www.linkedin.com/company/entrustsolutionsgroup (https://www.linkedin.com/company/entrustsolutionsgroup) *ENTRUST Solutions Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.* *Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. ENTRUST does not accept unsolicited headhunter or agency resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with ENTRUST Solutions Group.* *\#LI\-GP1* #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Civil Engineering Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Process Excellence
jobs.description: ### **Senior Director, Process Excellence** * JR\-163861 * Hybrid * Toronto * Dallas * General Management * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. **Job Summary** A lot of companies are still working out what AI means for how work gets done. At Equinix, this role sits at the center of that question. In this role, you’ll help decide how the company reimagines its most critical value streams leveraging AI, and how its leaders build the management habits that make the changes stick. The Senior Director, Process Excellence guides how Equinix reimagines some of its most critical value streams for AI transformation. Forward\-deployed engineers build and deploy the solutions. This leader facilitates the work that comes before and alongside them: bringing business leaders and engineers into the same room to examine how work flows today, decide what the future flow should look like, and place AI and human judgment where each adds the most value, so the redesign starts from outcomes and decisions rather than from tools. The role also develops the management practices / operating system that put continuous improvement principles to work, drawing on lean principles, along with the toolset that supports them, in partnership with HR. In selected areas of focus, this leader coaches parts of the organization directly on building the operating system that sustains a culture of continuous improvement. You’ll work with business leaders, people team, and our Digital and Innovation Organization, with visibility to senior leadership. **Responsibilities** Reimagining Critical Value Streams for AI Transformation * Facilitate working sessions with business leaders and forward\-deployed engineers to examine how work actually flows, find the structural bottlenecks, handoffs, and rework, and define the future flow before solutions are built * Bring Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream thinking together with process and process mining, so the redesign is grounded in how work runs today and aimed at measurable gains in speed, quality, cost, and decision\-making * Help business leaders design for decisions and outcomes rather than tasks, build intelligence into core workflows, and place AI, automation, and human judgment where each adds the most value * Advise senior leaders on where AI applies and where it does not, and challenge designs that only speed up an existing process * Connect business leaders, the Digital and AI organization, and change efforts so that opportunities move from identification to deployment and adoption * Promote always\-on visibility into how redesigned processes perform, so gains are sustained and drift is caught early * Establish a consistent approach across the enterprise to prioritizing, framing, and launching value stream redesigns Management Practices / Operating System * Develop the Equinix management practices / operating system that builds from some of the best and enforces continuous improvement principles into daily use, including visual management, structured problem solving, performance management, and standard work * Build, with partners, the toolset that supports those practices, including standards, templates, and routines that teams can adopt and adapt * Work with HR so the practices reinforce the leadership expectations set for the company, and so the language, learning experiences, and capability pathways are consistent * Help create the shared language and mindset that make continuous improvement part of how the company operates * Coach selected parts of the organization on best practices for building the operating system that drives continuous improvement, with hands\-on enablement in priority areas so teams and leaders can apply the practices and the redesign approach themselves * Decide what is standard across the enterprise and what can flex by region or function, and set a deliberate path for starting the practices where they will take hold * Embed process excellence disciplines at scale, and build communities of practice in process redesign and AI\-enabled improvement so the capability spreads beyond this team * Assess how mature the practices are across the organization, establish feedback loops on adoption and effectiveness, and refine the system based on what is learned **Qualifications** Required * 12–15\+ years leading enterprise\-level operational excellence, process excellen xperience partnering with HR on capability programs * Experience in technology, services, or infrastructure environments * Lean Six Sigma, change management, or comparable jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend/Kotlin (REMOTE)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **Overview** As a Backend Engineer at Fanatics Core, you'll design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, high\-quality systems to deliver exceptional customer experiences. We own the Fanatics App, the brand\-forward application of Fanatics that encompasses elements of all of our different brands and businesses. We own the Fanatics App, the brand\-forward application of Fanatics that encompasses elements of all of our different brands and businesses. The Fanatics App brings together Free to Play games, live events, ecommerce, and new product experiences to deliver a new Sports platform. Fundamentally, we are one team in everything we do from the user experience to coding and architecture. In order to deliver on our Customer Promise, we use best in class technologies; thus allowing platforms to be as up to date as possible so that we can rapidly deliver and innovate in this exciting new market. Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans. **Responsibilities** * Develop, test, document, and deploy high quality software into production * Build features and tools that you and your team use * Participate in the on\-call rotation when needed to troubleshoot software issues * Escalate when tasks or projects hit roadblocks * Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge * Contribute to team planning and design discussions, building more expertise around design approaches * Impact software quality and customer experience of product features * Improve testability, operational excellence metrics, and team documentation * Help your team define and adhere to the principles, guidelines, and best practices of our engineering strategy * Develop a fundamental understanding of our industry, product, feature set and roadmap * Work closely with our product team and other internal stakeholders to make technology decisions that grow and improve our products * Help to onboard and mentor junior engineers and interns * Remain current on the latest technologies and trends in software development * Must be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team\-building activities **Required Qualifications** * **5\+ years of experience** building highly scalable, performant and evolvable backend distributed systems; proficiency in Spring with Kotlin and/or Java is a plus. * **Demonstrated ability** to drive best practices in backend development and mentor others in effective coding and architectural strategies, such as clean code, hexagonal/layered architectures, domain driven design and other design and architectural patterns * **Knowledge of observability practices**, including logging, monitoring, and tracing in distributed systems. * **Expertise in Agile software delivery**, with a track record of modeling and driving process improvements across teams, and ability to collaborate cross\-functionally across diverse teams within large enterprise environments, driving alignment and shared success. * **Excellent communication skills**, capable of conveying complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including engineers, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Team\-first mentality**, with a willingness to do what it takes to get the job done and a desire to strive for better. * **Thrives in a high\-growth** environment where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Strong Experience** in the sports industry, gaming and content delivery * **Highly effective** with Kotlin, Java and/or Go * **Expertise in messaging technologies** such as Kafka or Amazon SQS, with a solid understanding of event\-driven architectures. * **Comfortable working with** Cloud Native and Infrastructure as Code, like Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform * **Ability to work in diverse** codebases, both legacy and greenfield, in different languages and environments *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

Farther's founders are leaders and innovators from the private wealth industry who possess a unique blend of traditional wealth management, fintech, and technology production expertise. We're backed by top\-tier venture capital firms, fintech investors, and industry leaders. Joining Farther means joining a collaborative team of entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping their clients and our teammates achieve more. If you're the type who breaks through walls to get things done the right way, we want to build the future of wealth management with you. ### **The Role** As an Agentic Engineer at Farther, you will build agentic solutions that change how our business runs. You will work with Farther's proprietary data model and our many vendor integrations to design, ship and run AI agents that take on real operational work in a regulated wealth management environment. This is not a build\-it\-and\-hand\-it\-off role. You will sit with operations teams, advisors and other business partners to understand how they actually work. You will find the few features that decide whether a tool gets adopted, and you will turn them into scalable, well\-built systems. Then you will own the rollout: monitoring, integrations, user training and ongoing iteration until the solution is a trusted part of how Farther works. You need both sound engineering and architectural judgment and real business judgment: knowing what to build, what to leave out, and what "done" means to the people using it. ### **Your Impact** * Partner directly with business stakeholders to find high\-value workflows and turn their needs into clear, prioritized agentic solutions * Design and build production agents that reason over and act on Farther's data model and vendor integrations (custodians, CRM, planning and other third\-party systems) * Make architectural decisions that favor scalable, strategic solutions over one\-off fixes, using strong software engineering practices (testing, code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code) * Build and maintain the integrations that connect agents to internal services and external vendor platforms * Own production readiness: set up monitoring, alerting, logging and evaluation so agent behavior is observable, reliable and safe * Lead complex rollouts to business\-facing users * Train and support users so they can confidently use agentic tools in their daily work * Track adoption and business impact, and feed what you learn from real usage back into the product roadmap * Set guardrails and access controls suited to a regulated financial environment ### **The Ideal Match** * 5\+ years of professional Software engineering experience using Python, SQL, HTTP, AWS * A track record of designing systems that scale * Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, and a workflow built around using them effectively * Professional experience building AI Agents, (Claude Managed Agents or Anthropic Claude Agent SDK preferred) * Deep understanding of cloud and serverless architectures (AWS Bedrock AgentCore preferred). Alternates include GCP, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Azure AI Foundry and LangGraph Cloud / Crew AI * Experience supporting Operations functions and teams * A strong ownership mindset: you care about adoption and outcomes, not just shipping code * Strong business judgment: you can separate the must\-have features from the nice\-to\-haves and explain the tradeoffs clearly * Experience working one\-on\-one with demanding users and turning their feedback into product decisions * A history of carrying complex, business\-facing applications through rollout, not just building them * Excellent communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences ### **Technical Stack** * AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, Step Functions, EventBridge, API Gateway, CloudWatch) * Python * Infrastructure as code (AWS CDK) * AI coding tools, MCPs, LLM APIs and agent frameworks * REST APIs and event\-driven architectures * Observability tooling ### **Bonus Points** * Wealth management, financial services or capital markets background * Experience with custodial or vendor financial data * Experience building production AI agents * Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool integrations for LLMs * Familiarity with compliance, auditability and access control requirements in regulated environments * Experience working with a data knowledge graphs ### **Why Join Us** * Learn \& grow through book clubs, seminars, and peer learning sessions * Competitive comp package that rewards impact * Work alongside some of the brightest minds in fintech * Ground\-floor opportunity at a fast\-scaling startup * Chart your own growth path as we expand * Full health benefits \+ 401(k) matching \& Roth IRA options * Unlimited PTO * An amazing collaborative atmosphere between product, design, and engineering to solve hard problems together **Ready to disrupt wealth management? Let's talk!**

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer - Associate
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond When you join the Federal Reserve—the nation's central bank—you’ll play a key role, collaborating with leading tech professionals to strengthen and protect our economic, financial and payments systems. We invest in contemporary and emerging technology each year to support the Federal Reserve and our economy, and we’re building a dynamic and diverse team for our future. We invite applications for AI Solutions Engineer \- Associate The AI Solutions Associate Engineer role is ideal for early\-career professionals looking to build a career in supporting the development and maintenance of AI/ML solutions using Generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI frameworks, combined with Infrastructure as Code and automation practices. The engineer will contribute to building and supporting scalable, secure AI\-powered systems for the Federal Reserve System under the guidance of senior team members. Infrastructure Platforms \& Operations: You will be joining The Infrastructure, Platforms \& Operations portfolio. This business line supports the strategic direction and product delivery for System IT infrastructure and operations, as well as the alignment of technology to business strategies. The team serves as the business partner for secure and reliable IT products, services, and operations. This position does not sponsor employment visas. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents with at least three years of legal residency. There are three (3\) vacancies for this job profile, candidates will be selected based on the needs of the position and the strength of the candidate pool.**AI/ML Solution Development** * Work under close direction and guidance; follow established methods and policies. * Contribute to RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows to support business use cases * Write automation scripts using Python to help streamline AI model deployment, data pipelines, and operational processes * Assist in building and deploying GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions leveraging AWS Bedrock and related AI/ML services, under guidance from senior engineers * Support configuration of AWS infrastructure for AI workloads including compute, storage, networking, and security using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles * Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning using GitLab or similar tools **Application Development \& Support** * Assist in developing user interfaces using React for AI front end, monitoring solutions, and administrative applications * Help troubleshoot and resolve routine to moderately complex AI infrastructure and application issues * Code, test, debug, and document AI/ML pipeline components and infrastructure enhancements * Produce ad\-hoc queries, reports, and simple automation tools as requested by technical teams and business management * Support system health checks and basic troubleshooting to help ensure reliability of deployed solutions **Collaboration \& Process Improvement** * Work as part of an Agile team, contributing to AI capabilities that support business processes and decision\-making * Participate in design reviews and team discussions, raising questions and sharing observations * Support change and problem management activities using standard tools, following FRIT change management policies and procedures * Assist with analysis of business requirements as they relate to AI solutions * Help document AI solution details, runbooks, and operational procedures following technical writing best practices **Minimum qualifications:** 0 to 3 years of direct relevant work experience in AI/ML engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering **OR** a bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred. Information technology Interns with a BA degree and a strong technical foundation, from their internship experience, and relevant coursework in AI/ML are encouraged to apply **What we are looking for:** * Foundational knowledge of Generative AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), and prompt engineering * Basic exposure to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and vector databases * Basic understanding of Agentic AI concepts and orchestration patterns * Working knowledge of Python for scripting and automation * Basic proficiency with Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools * Familiarity with core AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, VPC, IAM) * Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as GitLab * Basic knowledge of React for frontend development * Understanding of version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows * Basic knowledge of SQL queries and data analysis techniques * Certification related to Information Technology or AI/ML preferred (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terra  AI technologies and staying current with industry trends * Basic understanding of risk management principles in decision\-making, particularly regarding responsible AI use **In addition to meeting the above requirements the following are nice to have but not required:** * Coursework, projects, or internship exposure to AWS Bedrock or GenAI/RAG applications * Exposure to AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) * Basic knowledge of vector databases and embedding models * Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, ECS, EKS) * Exposure to API development and RESTful services * Familiarity with Agile methodologies * General familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts (e.g., logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards) and related tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or similar platforms **Additional Information:** ***The full salary range for the Associate Engineer job profile:*** ***$76,000\-$95,800\.00\-$124,500\.00\.*** The candidate’s new job title and associated pay range will be determined by the employing District, and they will be subject to the employing District’s people policies and practices. As a Federal Reserve System National Business Line, it is standard practice to post System IT positions in multiple Districts to provide transparency and equitable opportunities. Internal candidate(s) selected for this position will remain employed by their current employing District and serve as an employee of System IT\*. * Current remote employees will not be guaranteed to keep their remote status with their employing bank. The selected candidate will reside within a reasonable commuting distance, as defined by the employing Reserve Bank, and will work full\-time onsite. * Eligible Locations for Hire: Boston, MA\- New York, NY\- Philadelphia, PA\- Cleveland, OH\- Richmond, VA\- Atlanta, GA\- Chicago, IL\- St. Louis, MO\- Minneapolis, MN\- Kansas City, MO\- Dallas, TX\- San Francisco, CA **OR** * The following Reserve Bank locations are preferred due to the concentration of System IT team members in these locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Kansas City, Minneapolis, New York, Richmond, and San Francisco. (example for limited posting locations) **Screening:** This position has additional screening requirements due to the information accessed while performing the job. These additional screenings would be initiated at the time of offer acceptance and could take up to a couple of months to be completed. You can begin work before the screening is completed; however, continued employment is contingent on acceptable screening results. The areas screened may include education/employment verification, criminal history, credit history, and reference checks. **Our total rewards program offers benefits that are the best fit for you at every stage of your career:** * Comprehensive healthcare options (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * 401(k) match, and a fully funded pension plan * Paid time off and holidays * Annual educational assistance * Professional development programs, training and conferences * And more… *The Federal Reserve Banks are committed to equal employment opportunity for employees and job applicants in compliance with applicable law and to an environment where employees are valued for their differences.* **Full Time / Part Time** ------------------------- Full time**Regular / Temporary** ----------------------- Regular**Job Exempt (Yes / No)** ------------------------- Yes**Job Category** ---------------- Information Technology Family Group**Work Shift** -------------- First (United States of America)*The Federal Reserve Banks are committed to equal employment opportunity for employees and job applicants in compliance with applicable law and to an environment where employees are valued for their differences.* Always verify and apply to jobs on Federal Reserve System Careers (https://rb.wd5\.myworkdayjobs.com/FRS) or through verified Federal Reserve Bank social media channels. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Fellow** ---------------- We believe that the act of making should be meaningful and fulfilling, done with intention and precision. Fellow makes beautifully functional tools for any kitchen, designed in San Francisco and used around the world. When the simple motions of life become small moments of joy, that's Everyday Magic.™ ***This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office and requires regular in\-office presence in accordance with company policy.*** **Who You Are** --------------- **Fellow** is looking for a **Senior Firmware Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable UX and communication firmware for our IoT platform. You'll build the embedded systems that let customers interact with Fellow's connected products, making sure our hardware devices, mobile app, and cloud backend work together seamlessly. A successful candidate will have deep experience with real\-time operating systems, have shipped connected consumer products, and care as much about how a device feels to use as how efficiently it runs. This is a rare opportunity to shape the on\-device experience of beautifully designed products used by coffee lovers around the world, as part of a small, agile team that owns the connected experience across on\-device firmware, backend systems, and mobile apps. Reporting to the Director of Firmware and Software, you'll serve as the connective tissue between product design, hardware engineering, and app development. You'll turn new product ideas into reliable, high\-performance firmware. You bring strong technical judgment, a high bar for quality, and the instincts to ship on time in resource\-constrained environments. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll help shape firmware architecture, and you'll also be the one writing, testing, and debugging the code. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Develop embedded firmware using FreeRTOS that powers on\-device GUIs, control systems, and connectivity to mobile applications * Architect and optimize firmware for resource\-constrained environments, with a focus on efficiency, low power use, and stability * Lead firmware development that brings new product experiences to life, delivering high performance and reliability * Partner closely with product designers, hardware engineers, and app developers to imagine new product experiences and make sure on\-device interfaces work smoothly in real time * Drive system optimization for real\-time responsiveness, efficient memory use, and low power consumption * Set and uphold a high bar for reliability by testing and debugging firmware thoroughly with industry\-standard tools and meeting performance benchmarks * Maintain and improve the connectivity between hardware devices, the mobile app, and the cloud backend * Champion AI, automation, and new ways of working to make firmware development, testing, and release more effective **Qualifications** ------------------ * 6\+ years of experience in embedded firmware development, focused on real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and connected consumer products * Deep expertise in FreeRTOS or other RTOS environments, with a strong understanding of multitasking, scheduling, and system performance optimization * Strong knowledge of microcontroller platforms (ARM Cortex, STM32, etc.) and peripheral interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART) * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems development * Experience working with on\-device GUIs and integrating firmware with mobile applications * Strong debugging skills and experience with tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers * Familiarity with embedded development tools (version control, CI/CD) and OTA firmware update processes * Excellent communicator and collaborator who works well across hardware, software, and design teams * Scrappy and agile, able to deliver on big expectations with limited resources * Ability to travel up to 10% ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with MQTT or other IoT communication protocols * Familiarity with wireless communication protocols (BLE, Wi\-Fi) for IoT devices * Experience with GUI development frameworks for embedded devices * Experience with control systems and sensor integration (a plus, not required) * Familiarity with testing and validation for IoT hardware devices * Experience with mobile app deployment, managing updates, and mapping compatibility between on\-device firmware and new mobile app capabilities * Knowledge of security practices for IoT devices and systems, including encryption, secure boot, and TLS/SSL protocols **Why You'll Love This Role** ----------------------------- * A creative, fast\-moving environment where ideas turn into action * Competitive compensation including employee equity plan * Generous paid time off plan * 401k with company contribution after 6 months of employment * Medical/dental/vision insurance * Better Yourself Wellness credit \& Better Your Community donation matching * Monthly Fitness Stipend * Summer Fridays * Paid Parental Leave * Generous discount on Fellow products * Best coffee anywhere The salary range for this position is **$195,000–$215,000 plus 10% bonus \& equity**. We intentionally publish salary ranges to promote transparency and set clear expectations. Final compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills, expertise, scope of previous work, demonstrated impact, and internal equity. As a result, not every candidate will be hired at the top of the range. *Our highest goal at Fellow is creating a safe, inclusive, and rewarding environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and thrive. We are committed to building diverse teams and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *Fellow is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.*
