jobs.description: **Hanson Values** Integrity \| Commitment \| Quality \| Relationships \| Innovation If you’re looking for a firm that encourages innovative thinking and challenges you every day, with an opportunity to learn and advance, a career at Hanson is right for you. The belief in sustainability within our company’s practices creates a focus on client success and partnerships that are important to our communities and our environment. We are seeking a skilled and motivated **Civil Engineer** to join our aviation practice. In this role, you will contribute to the design, and delivery of aviation and civil site infrastructure projects across the U.S. and internationally. You will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to provide high\-quality, technically sound designs that support safe, sustainable, and efficient aviation facilities. At Hanson, we foster innovative thinking, value sustainability, and prioritize client success while making a positive impact on our communities and the environment. As leaders in aviation civil engineering, our professionals serve as responsible stewards of public transportation resources while enhancing the surrounding environment. **A Day in the Life of an Civil Engineer:** * Perform detailed engineering calculations using advanced software to support analysis and design efforts. * Prepare and coordinate aviation civil construction documents—including drawings, specifications, technical reports, cost estimates, and implementable schedules—in accordance with industry standards and best practices. * Conduct site investigations and field reconnaissance to collect existing physical data to promote informed design decisions. * Collaborate with senior engineering staff on complex technical challenges and project solutions. * Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior designers and engineers. * Coordinate with internal teams, external clients, and construction contractors to achieve project objectives. * Stay current with FAA criteria, emerging technologies, and industry regulations to improve deliverable quality and efficiency. * Support additional project\-related tasks as assigned to meet client and project needs. **Requirements:** **Education and Licensure:** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field. * Possess a Professional Engineer (PE) license, and the ability to acquire additional registration in the State of the office assigned, through comity, within six (6\) months. * Minimum of five (5\) years of civil engineering project experience. **Technical Qualifications:** * Proficiency in CAD software, including AutoCAD and Civil 3D – including modeling * Experience using design tools relevant to aviation and civil site infrastructure. * Working knowledge of FAA Advisory Circulars and applicable aviation design standards and airspace considerations preferred * Practical knowledge of drainage calculations and related design standards. * Proficiency with airfield lighting and navigational aid layout, and fundamental knowledge of electrical features preferred * Ability to produce accurate, high\-quality engineering drawings and construction documents within assigned timelines and established budgets. **Professional Skills:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Public speaking experience is a plus. * Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and dynamic project environments. * Proactive, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple technical challenges and deadlines. * Experience with or exposure to interfacing with the Federal Aviation Administration and/or a State Aviation or Aeronautic Office preferred Salary Range: $93,995 \- $122,012 **Benefits** ============ Our focus on people means we offer a generous benefits program to help you create a solid foundation for health and security throughout your career, including: * **Competitive compensation** ---------------------------- * **Performance bonuses** ----------------------- * **401(k) with matching contribution** ------------------------------------- * **Employee Stock Ownership Plan** --------------------------------- * **Comprehensive health \& well\-being plans** --------------------------------------------- * **Financial wellness plans** ---------------------------- * **Work\-life balance programs** ------------------------------- Want to know more? Visit our benefits page for all the details. **Culture** =========== We understand that selecting a job is about more than the day\-to\-day tasks. It’s important to feel like you belong and safe to grow and progress along your career path. You’ll find that at Hanson. We have an inclusive, diverse workforce awaiting to connect with you and numerous opportunities to cultivate your career, including: * **Monthly educational webinars** -------------------------------- * **Leadership training** ----------------------- * **Lunch \& learn development sessions** --------------------------------------- * **24/7 access to thousands of skill\-building courses** ------------------------------------------------------- * **Mentorship opportunities** ---------------------------- * **Award\-winning internship program** ------------------------------------- * **Employee recognition** ------------------------ * **And so much more!** --------------------- **AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EEO — EMPLOYER** **We do not accept unsolicited resumes** from recruiters or agencies/staffing firms. **Resumes** are only accepted from recruiters and agency/staffing firms if a signed agreement is in place at the inception of the recruiting effort and authorized for a specified position.

jobs.title: Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer
jobs.description: **What You'll Be Doing** ======================== **Job Scope:** Generally be responsible for performing all aspects for complete designs of small and large electrical and instrumentation engineering assignments using theoretical knowledge and practical design methods. This work will be performed under general supervision. **Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:** * Familiarity with and utilizing department design and drafting standards. * Familiarity with project scope, specifications and design criteria upon assignment to a project task team. * Recognize and communicate scope and design changes promptly. * On\-site assistance during startup. * Producing estimate level preliminary designs and material take\-offs suitable for the level of the estimate being performed on a project. * Producing detail design calculations and sketches for materials of construction associated with the project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by others and efficient use by drafters/designers for preparing drawings and as a deliverable when required. * Producing designs with efficient use of construction materials with an overall emphasis on ease of construction and completed product meeting the expectations of the client. * Checking calculations made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, conformance to codes, specifications, design criteria and conformance to good engineering practice. * Assisting the drafting group in resolving routine layout and detailing problems. It is your responsibility to furnish sufficient sketches and details necessary for completion of engineering drawings. * Consulting with design leaders from other disciplines to ensure the smooth flow of vital information necessary for the scheduled completion of the project. * Advising the senior engineer concerning design or scope changes, which have been identified. * Assisting other engineers in developing and assembling scopes, drawings and specifications into a “package”, enabling electrical/instrumentation purchase inquiries to be issued for procurement of materials or subcontract pricing. * Reviewing and checking vendor drawings and other discipline drawings for electrical/instrumentation input. * Developing construction specifications. * Reviewing fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for conformance to engineering drawings and specifications. * Performing fieldwork necessary to gather field data, check tie\-ins and provide construction support. * Provide technical guidance to less experienced drafting and engineering personnel in the department. * Knowledge of the discipline specific methods, practices and techniques required to engineer, design and construct process and manufacturing projects. * Applying advanced engineering techniques and analysis to complex designs. * Produce installation details, motor control center single lines, electric room layouts, motor control elementaries, connection diagrams, cable schedules, control panel layouts and grounding, lighting, power and instrumentation plans under general supervision. * Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the simplest, most efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand. * Developing small work sharing packages for interoffice execution support. This position offers a highly competitive compensation package, including paid time off, health insurance benefits, and matching retirement contributions. **Ideal Background** ==================== **Education:** Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university is required. **Registration:** Professional Engineering registration is highly preferred. **Experience:** This position requires 3\+ years of relevant industrial experience in electrical and instrumentation engineering. **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Knowledge and application of the current version of the National Electrical Code (NEC). * Familiarity with specifications and installation details of construction bulk materials and equipment. * Ability to perform lighting level calculations. * Ability to size wire, conduit and overcurrent protection for both lighting and power applications. * Ability to perform voltage drop calculations. * Ability to route conduit and cable tray. * Ability to calculate tray and conduit fill. * Ability to determine motor control center loading. * Ability to create accurate electrical installation documents from the information found on vendor equipment drawings. * Ability to determine load center unit substation loading. * (Instrumentation) Ability to size control valves using appropriate software. * (Instrumentation) Ability to develop specifications and data sheets for instrumentation, analyzers, control systems and actuated valves. * (Instrumentation) Familiarity with standards that apply to instrumentation and controls (ISA). * Ability to develop equipment specifications for equipment such as motor control centers, variable frequency drivers, induction and synchronous motors, load center unit substations. * Knowledge and understanding of schedule constraints and information requirements for the production of all electrical deliverables. * Ability to develop a construction cost estimate, a detailed engineering schedule and a man\-hour budget for a small project or an area for a larger project. * Ability to determine construction material quantities. * Knowledge and application of company engineering design and CAD drafting standards. * Working knowledge of CAD software, either AutoCAD, Microstation or both. * Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. * Good presentation skills. * Virtual team skills and cross divisional relationships are developed and able to provide interoffice execution support with general supervision. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time. . **Hargrove Culture** ==================== We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company\-wide level. We know that each person on our team contributes to the success of our company by pairing expertise and passion to meet and exceed the needs of the clients we serve across the globe. Our safety culture protects and promotes the well\-being of every person who works with us and every person touched by our work. As a 100% Teammate owned company, we proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package including, paid holidays, personal paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and other benefits to eligible Teammates. **Equal Opportunity Employment Statement** ========================================== Hargrove is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sexual identity, marital or family status), disability, military service or obligations, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Hargrove is a drug\-free workplace. The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Process Engineer V
jobs.description: **What You'll Be Doing** ======================== **Job Scope:** Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and process engineering designers when functioning as a Lead Engineer. As Lead Engineer, responsibilities include total delivery of the process engineering deliverables and services on time, within budget and meeting quality expectations. Duties may include performing advanced engineering work serving as a technical specialist for complex engineering assignments. Work at this level requires extensive progressive experience in chemical/biochemical/petroleum and process design engineering and involves utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under general supervision. **Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:** * Promoting the culture of working safely and applying safety related concepts into process design. * Reviewing and approving all process engineering deliverables. * Validating professional service estimates at the beginning of a project, then tracking changes as projects progress. * Producing professional service estimates in accordance with the Hargrove standards for project deliverables, project studies and estimates, project change notices and for the development of new work through proposal efforts. * Establishing the design criteria for projects while incorporating client requirements and applying applicable state, local and federal standards and codes. Ensuring that any requirements for permitting have been established and communicated to the project team. * Supports efforts to develop process engineering standards, specifications, guidelines, and procedures. * Understanding and familiarity with project scope and deliverables. Initiating timely project change notices when deviations are made from your scope that affect schedule, deliverables or cost of the work. * Planning and organizing the work of the project team for large capital projects and multiple medium/small capital projects. Capable of clearly communicating the plan to the team, the project leadership team, and the client. * Maintaining control of a large capital project or multiple medium/small capital projects by tracking and maintaining performance budget progress, schedule commitments, and quality standards. Understanding and utilizing the project tools in place for project control. * Delegating work to engineers and designers in proportion to their technical skills and experience, then following up for support to ensure efficient progress and quality. * Consulting with design leaders from other disciplines to ensure inter\-disciplinary alignment on projects. * Producing estimate level preliminary designs suitable for the level of estimate being performed on a major capital project. * Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the most ideal and efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand. * Familiarity with and utilizing industry and department standards, procedures, and guidelines. * Producing detail design calculations and drawings for the project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by others. Efficient use of drafters/designers in the development of drawings. * Producing project designs that are optimal and efficient with an overall emphasis on ease of construction, operability, and maintenance. The completed design should meet the specifications and expectations of the client. * Checking calculations, reports, and studies made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, as well as conformance to codes, specifications, design criteria and good engineering practices. * Producing equipment and construction specifications. * Monitoring drawings in progress to ensure conformance to design calculations and specifications. * Assisting the designers in resolving routine layout and detailing problems for a major capital project. Ensuring that sufficient information and details are provided for completion of engineering drawings. * Reviewing and checking vendor information and other discipline information needs for process engineering input. * Develop bid packages for procurement of equipment, materials or services on major capital projects. * Participate in professional society meetings to make new business contacts and keep current with new developments in the industry. * Participate in sales activities including pre\-bid meetings, client presentations, scope review meetings, and proposal development. * Travel as required for client presentations and project related tasks. * Actively participates in the mentoring of less experienced process engineers. * Responsible for reviewing resumes, conducting interviews, and completing interview evaluations for process engineering candidates. * Ability to identify and develop work sharing packages for interoffice execution support. Provide leadership to ensure communication and execution of work within scope, schedule and budget. **Ideal Background** ==================== **Education:** Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Biochemical, or Petroleum Engineering from an accredited university is required. **Registration:** Professional Engineering registration or CPIP certification is highly preferred. **Experience:** This position requires 15 years of relevant industrial experience in chemical, petroleum, or biochemical process design engineering. **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Ability to train others in process safety as well as site safety requirements. * Knowledgeable in many aspects of process safety and how to incorporate these aspects into process design. * Familiarity with specifications and installation details of equipment, instrumentation, and piping. * Ability to create accurate process engineering documents from the information provided in vendor equipment data and drawings. * Ability to accurately estimate completion of assigned tasks. * Ability to assist in the development of a detailed engineering schedule and a man\-hour budget for the process engineering portion of major capital projects. * Experienced in estimating and scheduling professional service hours and assessing the progress and quality of process engineering work. * Develop design criteria and scope of work for major capital projects. * Complete understanding of the skills and experience required to perform process engineering and design functions. * Knowledge and application of company engineering design and CAD drafting standards. * Knowledge of CAD software such as AutoCAD or Microstation. * Ability to lead a small team on a major capital project to deliver on their commitments. * Ability to deliver convincing presentations of Hargrove Engineers \& Constructors services to existing and new clients. * Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Harris Computer Corporation family, delivers health IT solutions that support caregivers around the world. These include the Sunrise™, Paragon Daneli, TouchWorks EHR, Altera Opal, Ventus, HealthQuest™ and dbMotion™ solutions. At the intersection of technology and the human experience, Altera Digital Health is driving a new era of healthcare, in which innovation and expertise can elevate care delivery and inspire healthier communities across the globe. A new age in healthcare technology has just begun. **Position Summary** As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer at Altera, you will be a pivotal technical leader, providing strategic guidance and deep technical expertise to Hosted clients. This role is crucial for ensuring the successful implementation and ongoing operations of complex projects, serving as the primary technical liaison between hosting, development, and client teams. An ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in systems engineering, a strong architectural mindset, and a passion for mentoring, driving quality, and delivering exceptional client satisfaction within a dynamic healthcare IT environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide continuous technical guidance and support to clients, ensuring their ongoing success. * Collaborate closely with internal technical teams to facilitate the successful implementation and integration of proposed solutions. * Partner with business stakeholders and Technical Account Managers (TAMs) to translate jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Sound like your next move?*** You’re a **Senior Electrical Engineer in Greenville, SC** ready to do work that actually makes an impact * You enjoy tackling complex challenges and bringing thoughtful solutions to Healthcare design projects * You’re confident owning your work—from developing detailed plans to running calculations and building accurate cost estimates * You’re known for being organized, detail\-driven, and someone your team can always count on * You’re looking for more than just a job—you want **growth, ownership, and real career momentum** At HEAPY, you won’t just design systems—you’ll help shape environments that truly matter. If the idea of growing your expertise while contributing to critical healthcare spaces excites you, this might be exactly what you’ve been looking for. ### **Key Responsibilities** The Senior Electrical Engineer independently performs a variety of assignments involving the application of standard electrical design engineering techniques for a small project or selected segments of a larger project. This person must be capable of exercising independent judgment in evaluating, selecting, and applying standard design engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria to make minor design adaptations and modifications. This position requires the colleague to set assignments that have clear and specific objectives and require the investigation of a limited number of variables.### **Qualifications** This position normally requires a 4\-year engineering degree from an ABET\-accredited program and typically 10\+ years’ related experience (or equivalent working knowledge/experience/advanced degree in engineering) related to electrical engineering systems in the Built Environment. This includes considerable experience in utilizing various computer software packages and automated electrical engineering and design equipment. An incumbent in this position should be in possession of a Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Certification and be working toward Professional Engineering (PE) Registration. PE registration would be attained within the first 2 years of attaining this position level. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * Maintains clear knowledge of HEAPY Corporate Vision, Mission, and Core Values and demonstrates awareness of how those objectives relate to all position responsibilities. * Approaches all assigned tasks as an opportunity for growth and experience, modeling the way for other team members. * Continually advances technical education and personal development aligned with OKRI goals. * Responsible for the design engineering services following with Corporate Vision, Mission, and Core Values as well as Corporate ISO Systems View(s), and related professional standards, client requirements, and corporate objectives. * Collaborates with more experienced engineering colleagues to prepare basic plan details and outlines, cost estimates, and perform calculations in support of broader engineering activities involving the design of electrical equipment, components, or systems. * Lays out full plan designs, plan details and outlines, identifies quantities of materials, cost estimates, and performs calculations for a detailed segment of a project. * Prepares technical specifications for review and approval. * Evaluates vendors’ bids and drawings to ensure compliance with specifications. * Reviews and approves electrical design drawings for assigned segment of project. * Assists with development of design guides, guide specifications, and design control procedures when directed by Practice Technical Leader. * Prepares technical reports such as life cycle cost analysis, facility conditions assessments, and other engineering guidance for clients. * Performs field tests \& measurements, collects field data, as necessary. * Aids and support to proposal teams or proposal managers as requested. * Collaborates with and supports Design Engineers / Designer I \& II colleagues on their technical development and professional growth. * Collaborates with field observation colleagues to perform field observations and tests, measurements, collect field data, and prepare field reports and related documentation. * Other duties as assigned. ### **HEAPY Benefits** * **Built for People, Not Just Projects** – a collaborative, colleague\-first culture where you can do your best work * **Thrive with HEAPY Benefits** – premium medical, dental \& vision coverage designed with you in mind * **Invest in Your Future** – 401(k) with competitive contributions to help you plan ahead * **Be Rewarded for Your Impact** – 10–15% annual bonus potential tied to company performance and your contributions * **Own Your Time** – open PTO and paid sick time that gives you the flexibility to recharge when you need it * **Wellness Week** – we hit pause the final week of the year so you can rest, reset, and reflect * **Feel Your Best** – annual wellness benefit bonus focused on your overall well\-being * **Grow with Purpose** – annual professional development stipend to support your career goals ### **About HEAPY** Colleagues are at the center of everything we do at HEAPY. By engineering more sustainable, resilient buildings, our colleagues are creating healthy environments that inspire and have a positive impact on the community. In this way, HEAPY creates high\-performance buildings to help clients achieve not just their goals for form and function, but also around sustainability commitments, recruitment, retention, productivity, and occupant wellness. Our *Colleague First* approach encompasses how we invest in our colleagues here at HEAPY, as well as the way we engage with clients. Through active listening, creative collaboration, and support that extends throughout a building’s life cycle, we are creating a more rewarding engagement. Our national portfolio speaks to the HEAPY team’s MEP engineering, technology engineering, commissioning, and construction administration expertise. But what truly sets us apart is the belief that continually investing in our colleagues is good for our clients, our communities, and our company. HEAPY’s *Colleague First* culture reflects an environment in which people feel heard and respected, one where we take pride in delivering upon the core values of our organization. This support enables our colleagues to better guide clients through challenging design decisions and build the trust that enables unparalleled engineering solutions.

jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking an energetic and highly skilled Lead Full Stack.NET Developer with a strong background in AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Models (LLMs). In this pivotal role, you will lead the development of innovative, scalable software solutions that leverage cutting\-edge artificial intelligence technologies. Your expertise will drive the design, implementation, and maintenance of complex systems, ensuring high performance, security, and usability. Join us to shape the future of intelligent applications and deliver impactful solutions that empower users worldwide. **Duties** * Lead the architecture and development of full\-stack applications utilizing.NET technologies, including ASP.NET Core and WCF, ensuring robust system design for scalability and performance. * Develop and optimize backend systems with a focus on developing APIs, microservices, and distributed computing architectures to support AI\-driven features. * Integrate AI models, including LLMs, RAG techniques, and other machine learning frameworks into existing platforms to enhance functionality. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams using Agile methodologies to deliver high\-quality software within SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) processes. * Design intuitive UI/UX interfaces using front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript to create seamless user experiences. * Implement cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS or Azure for deployment, scalability, and maintenance of applications. * Conduct system design sessions utilizing UML diagrams and system modeling tools to ensure clear architecture planning. * Perform unit testing, debugging, code reviews, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices using tools like GitHub, TFS, Jenkins, or similar platforms. **Skills** * Extensive experience with full\-stack development using.NET technologies including ASP.NET Core, WCF, MVC architecture, and Entity Framework. * Strong proficiency in front\-end development with React.js, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3 for building dynamic web interfaces. * Deep understanding of AI/ML integration techniques involving LLMs (Large Language Models), RAG methodologies, Python\-based ML frameworks, and related AI tools. * Proven ability in designing distributed systems and scalable architectures leveraging microservices patterns on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * Expertise in database design and management with relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) as well as NoSQL databases like MongoDB. * Knowledge of RESTful API development and integration for seamless communication between front\-end and back\-end components. * Familiarity with version control systems such as GitHub or SVN; experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles including OOP (Object\-Oriented Programming), UML modeling, system security best practices, and SDLC processes. * Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams to deliver iterative improvements in fast\-paced environments. * Ability to troubleshoot complex issues through debugging tools in Visual Studio or Eclipse; experience with shell scripting (Bash) is a plus. Join us if you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology through innovative AI solutions! We value proactive problem\-solvers who thrive in collaborative environments and are eager to lead projects that make a real difference worldwide. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to influence the future of intelligent systems while working alongside talented professionals committed to excellence in software development. Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

This role involves operating and maintaining a variety of machine tools to produce parts that meet strict specifications and tolerances. The Machinist will collaborate closely with engineers and production teams to interpret blueprints and technical drawings, ensuring that all products are manufactured to the highest standards. Additionally, the role requires troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise during the machining process, thereby minimizing downtime and maintaining production efficiency. Ultimately, the Machinist will play a key role in supporting the overall operational goals of the organization by delivering high\-quality components that enhance product offerings in the retail sector. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Strategist (NYC)
jobs.description: **Grab your cape, become a SuperHyro!** Hyro, the leader in Responsible AI Agents for Healthcare, enables health systems to safely automate workflows and conversations across their most valuable platforms, services, and channels \- including call centers, websites, SMS, mobile apps, and more. Hyro's clients, which include Intermountain Health, Baptist Health, and Hackensack Meridian Health, benefit from AI agents that are fully HIPAA\-compliant, fast to deploy, easy to maintain, and simple to scale \- generating better conversations, successful patient outcomes, and revenue\-driving insights. **What Are We Looking For?** Most AI deployments stall after go\-live. *Your job is to make sure ours don't*. Health systems are under pressure to do more with less, and Hyro's responsible AI Agents are already handling millions of patient conversations. But launching an AI Agent is only the beginning. The real value comes from what happens next: expanding into new workflows, earning trust across departments, and proving measurable impact to leadership. That's where you come in. As one of Hyro's first Forward Deployed Strategists, you'll embed with our most strategic health\-system customers and own their adoption journey from the core deployment to a full, measurable AI program. You'll be part strategist, part technologist, and part change agent, and you'll help write the playbook for a function that doesn't exist anywhere else at Hyro yet. Requirements: * 5\+ years in a customer\-facing role such as product management, solutions engineering or pre\-sales, or technical consulting, ideally serving US healthcare or health\-system customers. * A solid grasp of enterprise AI systems, APIs, cloud technologies, or deployment architectures. You don't need to write production code, but you can hold your own with engineers and explain it to executives. * A product mindset: you can articulate why a specific capability matters to a specific user in a specific workflow. * A track record of building trust fast and moving stakeholders from "interesting" to "let's do it." * Willingness to travel to client sites regularly (approximately 25%). **Advantages:** * Experience at a healthtech company or with health\-system customers * Hands\-on experience with ML, AI, or NLU products **This is a hybrid role, with at least three days per week in our NYC office. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.** The salary range for this NY\-based position is $110k – $170k annually, exempt,based on experience, qualifications, and skills. Compensation for candidates outside New York may vary with local cost of labor. Responsibilities: * Partner strategically. Be the dedicated, embedded expert for a portfolio of strategic health\-system accounts and the person their leadership calls first. * Drive adoption. Own each client's roadmap from the core package into advanced capabilities, with demos and working sessions that rally everyone from frontline staff to the C\-suite. * Translate between worlds. Turn clinical and operational needs into deployment plans, and bring the customer's voice to Engineering, Product, and Sales. * Get ahead of risk. Spot stalling adoption or at\-risk signals early and act before they become problems. Benefits \& Perks: * Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave * Company\-wide long weekends every quarter * Hybrid, dog\-friendly NYC office * Work\-from\-anywhere up to 2 weeks a year * Employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision * 401(k) with company match * MealPal subscription for monthly lunches * Home office equipment coverage Equal Opportunities: ***Hyro is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire talented people regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.title: GenAI Developer Sr I
jobs.description: IT accelerates the success of IDEXX employees and customers by providing scalable and innovative solutions and leadership. We are a global organization that supports all technology needed to deliver products and solutions to customers enabling them to focus on delivering high quality patient care. We strive to provide exceptional customer service and experience in the most efficient means possible, requiring alignment and cross\-functional communication. As a **GenAI Developer Sr I,** you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of complex applications — including reports, n\-tier web applications, and cloud\-native solutions — using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, and set technical direction for incorporating modern generative AI capabilities across the organization. The Enterprise Technology department builds the platforms and applications that power IDEXX's business, including next\-generation applications that incorporate modern AI and generative AI capabilities. In this role, you'll own advanced RAG architecture, MCP and agent integration strategy, and prompt engineering and evaluation practices, while mentoring other engineers, championing secure and compliant development, and driving technical decisions on ambiguous, high\-impact problems. **In this role, you will:** * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of complex applications — across frontend and backend, including reports, n\-tier web applications, and cloud\-native solutions — leveraging AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to increase team velocity and quality. * Define and evangelize best practices, standards, and reusable patterns for using AI coding tools across the development organization. * Establish and lead adoption of spec\-driven development practices — defining how engineering work is decomposed into clear specs and plans so it can be reliably chunked, sequenced, and orchestrated through AI coding agents such as Claude Code, rather than relying on ad hoc prompting. * Architect and lead implementation of advanced RAG solutions, including retrieval strategy, chunking, embeddings, and evaluation of retrieval quality across vector store technologies. * Design and oversee integration of MCP servers, tools, and other agent\-enabling protocols across applications and internal microservices, evaluating new integrations for security, reliability, and maintainability. * Design and lead development of multi\-step and multi\-agent systems, establishing patterns for orchestration, tool use, and safety guardrails across frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, the Anthropic Agent SDK, and AutoGen/CrewAI. * Own advanced prompt engineering strategy, including prompt design, versioning, red\-teaming, and human\-in\-the\-loop review; help introduce automated evaluation frameworks (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval) where none exist today. * Own observability and cost/token monitoring for AI features in production, establishing logging, tracing, and dashboards to track output quality, latency, and drift, and communicating cost tradeoffs to stakeholders and leadership. * Champion secure development and data privacy practices, ensuring AI integrations are reviewed for risks such as prompt injection and tool misuse, and maintaining working awareness of relevant compliance and responsible AI considerations (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA\-adjacent requirements, export controls, fairness, and explainability). * Mentor GenAI Developer I and II engineers, lead design and code reviews, and elevate the team's overall technical capability. * Partner with product, architecture, and security teams to evaluate emerging GenAI technologies, models, and vendors, and make build\-versus\-adopt recommendations — maintaining awareness of the landscape even though vendor/model evaluation is not a primary duty. * Drive technical decision\-making on complex, ambiguous problems with significant organizational impact, including production\-readiness decisions around CI/CD, containerization, and infrastructure as code. * Lead Agile ceremonies and cross\-functional collaboration with product and design; represent the team in architecture reviews, technology governance forums, and stakeholder/leadership presentations. **What You Will Need to Succeed:** ---------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\-7\+ years of professional software development experience, including prior senior or lead responsibilities. * Demonstrated full\-stack expertise across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web technologies. * Extensive hands\-on AWS experience, with practical experience across Azure and/or GCP. * Deep experience with relational and NoSQL databases; practical experience with data warehousing/analytics platforms. * Proven track record architecting RAG solutions and vector\-database\-backed retrieval at scale. * Demonstrated experience leading multi\-agent system design using one or more orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Anthropic Agent SDK, AutoGen/CrewAI, or similar). * Demonstrated experience applying spec\-driven development practices to direct AI coding agents, including decomposing complex work into chunked, orchestrated plans and establishing this as a standard for a team. * Advanced prompt engineering experience, including designing evaluation methodologies, red\-teaming, and human\-in\-the\-loop review processes. * Strong understanding of secure development practices, data privacy principles, and AI\-specific risk considerations. * Demonstrated mentorship, technical leadership, and stakeholder/leadership communication experience. **It would be a plus if you had any of these things…** * Experience introducing automated LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval) in an organization where none previously existed. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to regulated industries (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA\-adjacent requirements, export controls). * Experience evaluating and providing informed recommendations on emerging LLM models and vendors. * Cloud certification(s) in AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Production experience with CI/CD, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code. **What you can expect from us:** * Base annual salary target starting at $120,000, with flexibility based on experience * Opportunity for annual cash bonus * Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One * 5% matching 401k * Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more! **Why IDEXX?** We’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve, we follow our Purpose and Guiding Principles to help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, to ensure safe drinking water for billions, and to help farmers protect livestock and poultry from diseases. We have customers in over 175 countries and a global workforce of over 10,000 talented people. So, what does that mean for you? We enrich the livelihoods of our employees with a positive and respectful work culture that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you will be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement. Let’s pursue what matters together. *IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.* *\#LI\-EV1*

IMEG is hiring a Mechanical Engineering New Graduate in Charlotte, NC. This entry\-level role offers hands\-on design, analysis, and project execution experience, with opportunities to grow your expertise from day one. jobs.title: General Maintenance Assistant
jobs.description: **Handyman** **Hourly Wage** ISS offers full\-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, as well as a comprehensive leave program based on employment status. The hourly pay range for this position is **$17\.00 per hour**\- **$17\.00 per hour**. **I. SUMMARY** A Handyman will support the “Manager” in a safe, efficient, and professional manner with preventative, corrective, and general maintenance for the Client. Other duties include, but not limited to, daily assessments of systems, maintaining a clean working environment, and other various duties as assigned by the Manager, while adhering to all HS\&E standards. The Handyman is responsible for performing preventative maintenance in accordance with the CMMS schedule, assisting other maintenance personnel with repairs to electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems, general facility and grounds infrastructure, and providing general laborer support. The Handyman is also responsible for following all processes to support client satisfaction. The Handyman is an entry level, general labor position **II. ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **Position Duties / Responsibilities** **% Time Spent** **Completes HS\&E training as scheduled; Follows HS\&E procedures; Demonstrates safe work practices; Exhibits HS\&E best practice culture; Reports unacceptable HS\&E conditions immediately** * Performs general handyman tasks around the facility including door repairs, setups, light mechanical, light plumbing repairs, paint, patch, light bulb replacement, and other general laborer tasks as directed by the Manager 35% * Resolves client customer work order requests on computer\-based work order system 25% * Assists tradesmen with repair, adjustment and maintenance of HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing systems and associated equipment as directed by the Manager 15% * Performs and documents maintenance and repairs in a timely and accurate manner 10% * Complies with departmental policy for the safe storage, usage, and disposal of hazardous materials. Maintains a clean and safe workspace 5% * Performs manual labor tasks such as loading, unloading, lifting, and moving materials 5% * Performs general building rounds and is responsible for reporting conditions observed 5% **III. QUALIFICATIONS** **Minimum Requirements** Education (HS Diploma, Under/Graduate Degree, etc.) * High school diploma or equivalent * Must be 18 years of age Business Experience (Work/related experience) * 0\-1 years in Facility Maintenance or related field Licenses/Certifications * Valid state driver’s license with clean MV record (if operating moving vehicles) * Any trade certificate (desired) Language and Interpersonal Skills * Ability to read, write, and communicate in English required * Works and participates well as a team member * Communicate well with others; clearly write and speak to clients, superiors, coworkers * Good organization skills; disciplined approach to daily activities; takes a sense of pride in all aspects of the job * Presents self in professional manner: neat appearance and grooming. * Able to produce a quality work product in a prompt, safe and efficient manner * Ability to work without supervision and appropriately with multiple deadlines * Maintain a good attendance record, including notification in the event of tardiness and absence * For internal candidates, must constantly receive a “meets expectations” job performance review Technical Qualifications \& Skills * Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. * Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations * Ability to calculate figures and amounts **IV. COMPETENCIES** * Computer Software: Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Internet Explorer – general experience * Ability to communicate well with customer, manager, and coworkers * Strong customer service skills * Competency with basic hand tools * Competency with basic power tools **V. SUPERVISORY/MANAGEMENT SCOPE** * Identify if the position has management responsibilities by the following definitions: * Manage/Supervise TS Members \- Has direct reports, manages/supervises TS resources * Manage Process/Project – If the job oversees work process and/or workflow but does not directly manage/supervise * Individual Contributor – If there is no management responsibility. * Manage Team Members * Manage Process/Project * Individual Contributor The Handyman may not work independently and must work under the direction/oversight of local (Lead Building Engineer, Chief Engineer, or FM), Regional, or Country TS and Account Managers (dependent on space type, scope of work, and dispersion of ISS organizational managers). The Handyman does not supervise other ISS TS personnel or third\-party vendors. **VI. Physical Demands** While performing the duties of this job, the Handyman is regularly required to stand at eight\-hour intervals with occasional scheduled breaks, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, and talk or hear. The individual frequently is required to climb stairs and ladders. The individual must regularly lift and/or move up to 70 pounds, at higher than chest level and be able to tolerate adverse working conditions due to climate and tolerate extreme temperature changes. **HSEQ Compliance:** All employees must adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ) policies and procedures to ensure a safe and compliant work environment. This includes following safety protocols, maintaining environmental responsibility, and upholding quality standards in all tasks. Employees are expected to actively participate in HSEQ training and report any potential hazards or compliance concerns. **To Executive Search Firms and Staffing Agencies: ISS Facility Services / Guckenheimer does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We encourage diversity and inclusion in their broadest terms, including ethnicity, race, age, gender, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, language, culture, and educational background. We look to lead our industry by example and to positively influence the market wherever we operate.* Employment with ISS/Guckenheimer may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and, where appliable, a drug and/or alcohol screening, in accordance with applicable laws and Company requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Software Engineer II is an early\-career role for engineers who build and maintain Windows desktop applications in C\# and .NET. Engineers in this role work on their own on well\-defined features. They apply sound engineering principles to deliver reliable, performant, and maintainable desktop software. A Software Engineer II owns their technical decisions and shares responsibility for the quality of the product. That means writing tests, reviewing code, and working closely with QA to find and fix defects. Compared to a Software Engineer I, this role comes with more skill, more independence, and more responsibility. Engineers at this level also start mentoring and leading within their team. This position prepares engineers for senior engineering and technical leadership roles. **Development** * Write clean, well\-structured, testable, and maintainable C\# code that follows team coding standards. * Build desktop features on their own using WPF (and WinForms or WinUI where applicable), following MVVM and other established patterns. * Take ownership of well\-defined features or areas of the codebase, with little guidance. * Help design new features and refactor legacy desktop code, including migrating from .NET Framework to modern .NET. * Write responsive UI code that uses async/await correctly and keeps long\-running work off the UI thread. * Integrate the desktop client with backend services by consuming RESTful APIs and handling JSON and XML data. * Work with local and remote data stores using SQL, Entity Framework, or other data\-access approaches used by the team. **Quality** * Write and run unit, integration, and UI automation tests (for example xUnit or NUnit, Moq, FlaUI or WinAppDriver). * Diagnose crashes, memory leaks, and performance problems using the Visual Studio debugger, profilers, and dump analysis. * Work with QA to reproduce, triage, and fix defects, including ones that appear only in specific customer environments. * Use root cause analysis to fix the underlying cause of problems and to improve team processes. **Delivery** * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that build, test, sign, and package desktop releases. * Support installer and deployment work (for example MSIX, WiX, or ClickOnce) and the auto\-update mechanisms used by the team. * Take part in agile ceremonies: stand\-ups, backlog refinement, planning, and retrospectives. **Collaboration** * Review code and give constructive feedback, and mentor more junior developers. * Build strong working relationships with developers, product managers, QA, UX designers, and automation engineers. * Identify and raise risks, blockers, and technical debt early. * Keep team documentation for assigned features up to date. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the team. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent ability. * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET (.NET 6\+ and/or .NET Framework 4\.x). * Hands\-on experience building Windows desktop applications with WPF, WinForms, or WinUI. * Solid understanding of MVVM, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and common design patterns. * Working knowledge of asynchronous programming, threading, and UI responsiveness in desktop applications. * Experience consuming RESTful services and working with SQL, JSON, and XML. * Proficiency with Visual Studio, Git, and CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps preferred). * Experience writing automated tests and debugging production issues. * Strong written and verbal communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage day\-to\-day development tasks on their own with moderate supervision. * Commitment to continuous learning and a growth mindset. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience migrating applications from .NET Framework to modern .NET. * Familiarity with Windows platform APIs, P/Invoke, or COM interop. * Experience with desktop installers, code signing, and update or distribution mechanisms. * Experience with performance profiling and memory analysis tools (for example dotTrace, dotMemory, PerfView). * Exposure to cloud services (AWS or Azure) that support desktop clients. Experience with graphics, drawing, or document\-heavy desktop applications. * \#LI\-LM03 \#LI\-Hybrid For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster. At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed. For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best\-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture. We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations. **Verisk Businesses** Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision Claims Solutions — supports end\-to\-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day\-to\-day workflows the most efficient Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end\-to\-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events. Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement Life Insurance Solutions – offers end\-to\-end, data insight\-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group. Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. We offer a competitive total rewards package that includes base salary determined based on role, experience, skill set, and location. jobs.title: HPC System Architecture
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The HPC System Architect is the senior technical lead responsible for defining the next generation of Intel's leading\-edge high\-performance computing systems. Reporting directly to Nic Dube, Corporate Vice President and General Manager of Data Center Systems and Solutions, this position owns forward\-looking HPC system architecture from concept through committed definition. You will work directly with Intel's CPU and GPU teams to architect the systems that follow today's products \- shaping silicon requirements, and defining system\-level architecture for the large\-scale, scale\-out clusters that characterize production HPC. The role spans full\-system definition: compute node design, memory and I/O balance, scale\-out fabric and topology, and the software stack that determines delivered application performance at scale. You will engage directly with the customers that set the leading edge of HPC \- DOE national laboratories and their exascale and post\-exascale programs, financial services institutions, oil and gas operators, and major academic and government research computing centers \- translating their workload and facility requirements into system architectures Intel can build, and Intel's roadmap into system concepts they can commit to. Responsibilities Own system\-level architecture for next\-generation HPC clusters: node definition, CPU and GPU configuration, memory bandwidth\-to\-capacity balance, I/O and parallel storage architecture, and scale\-out fabric and topology. Define scale\-out interconnect architecture \- fabric selection, network topology, bisection bandwidth and blocking ratios, collective and communication performance, and resilience at thousands\-of\-node scale. Partner with the CPU and GPU teams to define product requirements for future HPC systems, bringing system\-level and workload evidence into silicon definition while requirements remain open. Build performance models that project delivered application throughput at scale on unreleased silicon and use them to drive configuration and roadmap decisions. Lead architecture co\-design and benchmark definition with leadership HPC customers, including acceptance criteria for standard and customer\-proprietary application suites. Drive HPC requirements into Intel's CPU, GPU, platform, and software roadmaps across DCG and the product and design organizations. Evaluate emerging technologies for next\-generation HPC systems, including advanced memory, Ultra Ethernet and other scale\-out fabric standards, optical interconnect, and heterogeneous accelerator integration. Produce reference architectures and system specifications that platform teams, OEM and ODM partners, and system integrators can build to. Grow and lead HPC architecture capability within the team, providing technical direction and mentorship to architects and engineers. Successful Candidate Profile Deep expertise in HPC system architecture at cluster scale, spanning CPU and GPU configuration, memory subsystem design, scale\-out interconnect, and parallel storage. Demonstrated experience defining systems around unreleased silicon and influencing CPU or accelerator requirements from a system and workload perspective. Fluency with HPC workload characteristics and performance analysis, including quantitative reasoning about scaling behavior, communication patterns, and bottlenecks at scale. Working knowledge of the HPC software stack \- MPI, OpenMP, GPU programming models, schedulers, and math and communication libraries. Proven credibility with sophisticated technical customers in high\-stakes procurement and co\-design settings. Strong understanding of the competitive HPC landscape, including alternative CPU and accelerator architectures, fabric options, and system vendor positioning. Excellent written and oral communication skills, effective with both deep technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Comfort with high ambiguity and a track record of driving clarity in undefined technical areas. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for customer engagements and technical conferences. **Qualifications:** ------------------- ***Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 10\+ years of experience in HPC, data center, or server system architecture, design, or engineering. 5\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing or externally\-facing technical role. Demonstrated experience defining or deploying large\-scale compute clusters. ***Preferred Qualifications*** Master's degree or PhD in a relevant technical discipline. Experience defining next\-generation systems in partnership with CPU or GPU product and design teams. Experience supporting DOE national laboratory or comparable large\-scale public\-sector HPC procurements. Domain experience in a definitional HPC vertical: financial services, oil and gas and seismic processing, weather and climate, computational chemistry or biology, or manufacturing and CAE. Hands\-on experience with scale\-out fabrics including InfiniBand, Ultra Ethernet, or other high\-performance interconnect. Experience with system\-level performance modeling and workload characterization at scale. Experience with converged HPC and AI system design. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, California, Santa Clara **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- This role is a Position of Trust. Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass an extended Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, SEC sanctions, and additional criminal and civil checks. For internals, this investigation may or may not be completed prior to starting the position. For additional questions, please contact your Recruiter. **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. reports, and technical documentation. * Work with geology and surveying teams to ensure mine plans accurately reflect current geological models and surveyed conditions. * Support reconciliation of duties and responsibilities represent the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all\-inclusive.* **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Relevant coursework in mine design, ventilation, drill and blast, geotechnical engineering, mineral processing, geology, surveying, and engineering economics is preferred. * 0–2 years of relevant mining or engineering experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Internship, co\-op, summer placement, or university project
