jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Rocketlane** -------------------- Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company redefining how professional services teams deliver customer projects. We recently raised **$60M in Series C funding led by Insight Partners**, bringing our total funding to over $105M from top investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, along with super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg. Our mission? To move the professional services industry from tracking work to *executing it*. With **Nitro**, our agentic execution platform, we've built the industry's first AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and surfaces delivery risks \- directly inside customer project workflows. We're a team of 200\+ passionate folks building a product that services teams love, and we're just getting started on the Outcome Era. **What will you do? (Role Overview)** ------------------------------------- As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** on Rocketlane's AI Implementation team, you will own the technical success of our strategic customers as they adopt **Nitro AI agents**. You'll embed with customer teams \- running discovery, designing agent workflows, configuring integrations, engineering prompts, and shipping production\-grade apps and agents that drive measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll understand customer workflows, orchestrate agents, write code debug live issues, and translate what you learn in the field into product improvements that shape the future of Nitro. If "professional services consultant" feels too removed from the keyboard and "pure product engineer" feels too removed from the customer, this role is built for you. You'll be a founding member of our AI\-first Professional Services org \- someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving puzzles, and is energized by seeing their work live in production within weeks, not quarters. **What You'll Be Responsible For** ---------------------------------- ### **Customer\-Embedded Agent Deployment** * Own end\-to\-end deployment of Nitro AI agents for enterprise customers \- from discovery and solution design to configuration, go\-live, and ongoing optimization. * Lead technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (Services leaders, IT, Operations, Revenue teams) to map business workflows to Nitro agent capabilities. * Design agent architectures that solve real delivery problems: migration agents, workforce agents, documentation agents and custom workflows tailored to each customer's environment. * Build and deploy custom integrations between Nitro and customer systems (CRM, HRMS, ERP, Finance tools, data warehouses, internal APIs). ### **Hands\-On Engineering** * Write production\-grade code/ scripts to extend, customize, or integrate Nitro agents into customer workflows. * Engineer prompts, design evaluation frameworks, and tune agent behavior for customer\-specific data, terminology, and edge cases. * Build data pipelines and connectors to feed agents with the right context \- SOWs, project history, customer communications, and structured delivery data. * Debug live agent behavior in customer environments, perform root\-cause analysis on complex system interactions, and ship fixes fast. ### **Trusted Technical Advisor** * Serve as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts throughout their Nitro implementation journey. * Guide customers toward best\-practice implementations \- and push back when needed. Your job is to advise, not just execute requirements. * Translate customer pain into clear problem statements, then into shipped solutions. Our model is simple: spend time understanding customer workflows, then build agents. ### **Product Feedback Loop** * Be the voice of the customer inside Rocketlane. Surface patterns, edge cases, and feature gaps to our Product and Engineering teams. * Prototype and validate new agent capabilities in the field before they become full product investments. * Contribute to internal playbooks, reusable agent templates, and scaled enablement content so every FDE engagement makes the next one faster. ### **Pre\-Sales \& POC Support** * Partner with Sales and Solutions teams on high\-stakes enterprise deals \- building rapid POCs, running technical validations, and proving the business case for Nitro. * Represent Rocketlane's technical depth in customer executive conversations, demos, and architecture reviews. **Must\-Have Skills** --------------------- ### **Engineering \& Technical Depth** * **3–5 years of hands\-on software engineering/product management experience**, with the ability to write production\-grade code in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. * Strong command of **REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/auth flows, and enterprise integration patterns** \- you can read API docs, test endpoints, and ship integrations without hand\-holding. * Good understanding of **data modeling and ETL** \- comfortable working with messy enterprise data and shaping it for production use. * Comfortable with modern cloud, DevOps, and integration tooling (Postman, AWS/GCP, Docker, iPaaS platforms like Workato/Boomi/Make). ### **AI \& Agent Engineering** * **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI agent frameworks** \- prompt engineering, agent orchestration and evaluation/guardrails. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar) to move faster and build utilities that make deployments scalable. * Strong intuition for when to use an agent vs. deterministic automation, and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that customers trust. ### **Customer\-Facing Instincts** * 1\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role \- Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or similar at a B2B SaaS or AI company. * Proven ability to drive enterprise deployments end\-to\-end with minimal supervision, including discovery, solutioning, and leading technical conversations. * Excellent written and verbal communication \- you can sit in a room with a VP of Services and earn their trust, then turn around and write clean technical documentation. * Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders ### **Problem\-Solving \& Ownership** * **Bias toward action and ownership.** You see a problem, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket. * Strong first\-principles thinking \- you can decompose a messy customer problem into a solvable, shippable plan. * Thrives in ambiguity. Comfortable operating without a playbook, because you're often the one writing it. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** ------------------------- * Experience with **Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools** \- Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA, Kantata, etc. * Background in **Professional Services, Customer Success Engineering, or technical implementation** at enterprise SaaS companies. * Prior exposure to building or deploying **agentic AI systems** in production at an AI\-native or AI\-forward company. **You Should Apply If You:** ---------------------------- * Want to be at the frontline of deploying real, production AI agents that change how businesses operate \- not just build another chatbot. * Love owning customer outcomes end\-to\-end and thrive on the blend of engineering and customer conversations. * Get energized by solving puzzles in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written. * Are driven by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales \- and want to help define what "Forward Deployed Engineer" means at Rocketlane. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- At Rocketlane, we're all about building a great product *and* a great place to work. Here's why you'll actually look forward to Mondays: * **Impact and ownership:** You won't just be another cog in the machine; here, you're more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen. * **Work with the best:** We're a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes. * **Celebrate wins:** Whether we're hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big. * **Learn and grow:** We're all about learning \- and not just the latest SaaS trends. You'll grow your career, pick up new skills, and work on problems that most engineers only read about. * **Front\-row seat to the AI era:** You'll build with frontier models, deploy real agents into real enterprises, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes in weeks. * **Best\-in\-class benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and benefits designed to support you and your family.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer – AGV & Automation Systems
jobs.description: Position Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and dynamic Field Service Engineer to serve as the technical face of our company for our US\-based clients. In this role, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and preventative maintenance of our advanced AGV and automation systems. Because our global engineering and manufacturing hubs are closely integrated, this role requires bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese. You will act as a critical technical bridge between our US clients and our overseas engineering teams. Additionally, this role involves initial and ongoing technical training, which will require international travel to our facilities in China. Key Responsibilities \- System Deployment: Lead the on\-site installation, integration, and commissioning of AGV systems, robotics, and automated material handling equipment at client facilities. \- Troubleshooting \& Maintenance: Perform complex electromechanical troubleshooting, diagnostics, and preventative maintenance to ensure maximum system uptime and reliability. \- Client Support: Conduct comprehensive user training for client operators and maintenance staff; serve as the primary on\-site technical contact during deployment. \- Cross\-Border Collaboration: Communicate technical feedback, bug reports, and hardware/software issues clearly to our R\&D and engineering teams based in China. \- Documentation: Generate detailed, accurate service reports, expense reports, and site\-acceptance testing (SAT) documentation in a timely manner. \- Continuous Improvement: Participate in rigorous technical training sessions (both in the US and internationally) to stay current on product updates and new automation technologies. Required Qualifications \- Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. (Please note: We are unable to provide employer sponsorship for this role). \- Language Skills: Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written) is required to collaborate effectively with our global engineering teams and navigate technical documentation. \- Education \& Experience: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related technical field; OR equivalent combination of education and hands\-on field service experience. \- Technical Skills: Proven experience troubleshooting complex electrical, mechanical, and software issues. Familiarity with industrial automation components, such as PLCs, sensors, servos, and motor controls. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints. Travel Requirements Must possess a valid driver's license and a valid passport. Willingness to travel extensively within the US and the ability to travel internationally to China for periodic, immersive technical training. Preferred Qualifications \- Previous experience specifically working with Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), or automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS). \- Experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks) or network configuration (Wi\-Fi, Linux\-based systems). \- Strong customer\-facing skills with a proven track record of managing on\-site client relationships during high\-pressure system rollouts. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product Platform Security
jobs.description: **About the Team \& Role** -------------------------- The Platform Security Engineering team builds the security features and frameworks that every Rubrik product runs on protecting **hundreds of petabytes of data across thousands of enterprise customers globally**, from encryption and certificate management to access control and platform hardening at scale. We're a small team with massive impact: the problem space covers the entire Rubrik portfolio, from performant core backend architecture to the AI\-powered engineering workflows we and the rest of Rubrik now build with daily. This is a strong opportunity for new grads and early\-career engineers who want real ownership on security\-critical systems. You'll help solve problems like: * How do we roll out post\-quantum cryptography across the backup data path before it's an industry requirement? * How do we let customers manage sessions and access against compromise, at enterprise scale? * How do we build an access control engine that holds up against dynamic, customer\-defined policies unique to a data management platform? * How do we secure the AI agents and agentic developer workflows that are now embedded in how Rubrik engineers ship code? You'll work alongside experienced engineers and deeply technical managers who will mentor you as you grow, on a roadmap with genuine business impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Security feature development** * Design and steer AI to write clean, well\-tested code in Go, Scala, or Python for scalable, secure platform services. * Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. * Identify attack surfaces and build solutions to harden Rubrik products. * Triage, debug, and drive product/system issues to resolution with clear ownership. * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of your daily engineering, while learning to treat AI\-generated code as untrusted input that gets the same security scrutiny as any other contribution. **Security code and design reviews** * Review code and design docs from other teams to flag security concerns before they ship. * Help extend our review practices to cover AI\-powered features and AI agents as they become part of Rubrik's product surface. * Contribute to secure coding guidelines and evangelize them across engineering. **Team collaboration** * Partner with Product Management, UI/UX, docs, InfoSec, and support to turn security requirements into shipped features. * Participate in planning, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. **How We Build and Secure with AI** ----------------------------------- AI isn't a side note for this team, it's part of the job on both sides: * **As builders:** you'll use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your normal workflow, the same way the rest of Rubrik engineering does. * **As security engineers:** you'll help define what "secure" means for AI\-generated code, AI\-powered features, and autonomous agents acting inside Rubrik's infrastructure, an active, fast\-moving part of our roadmap. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0\-2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, and bootcamps count). * Strong fundamentals in at least one language (Go, Java, Python, C\+\+, or similar) and in data structures, algorithms, and testing. * Genuine interest in security, curious about how systems break and motivated to build things that don't. * A proactive, self\-directed learning style; comfortable asking questions and diving into ambiguity. **Preferred** * Coursework, personal projects, or internships in cybersecurity, cryptography, or systems security. * Comfort with Linux/Unix, Git, and basic networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar). * Interest in open\-source security tooling or the broader security community. **What Makes a Great Candidate** -------------------------------- Beyond the qualifications above, the traits that predict success on this team: * **Thinks critically** \- can analyze problems and reason through potential security implications, not just implement what's asked. * **Collaborates well** \- enjoys working with others and learning from teammates across disciplines. * **Pays attention to detail** \- understands that small details matter in security. **Growth \& Mentorship** ------------------------ You'll be paired with senior engineers who invest directly in your growth. Over time, expect to build real depth in: * Applied cryptography, secure protocol design, and threat modeling. * Distributed systems, API design, and system\-level security testing. * Security code review — spotting vulnerability patterns in both human\- and AI\-written code. * Technical co -------------------- The best entry point into security engineering we know of: direct ownership on mission\-critical production systems that safeguard **Fortune 500 enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide**, mentorship from veteran security architects, and a forward\-looking roadmap spanning post\-quantum cryptography to AI agent security that puts you at the absolute forefront of enterprise security engineering. The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $131,400—$197,200 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The candidate should have strong experience working with high\-volume data processing, cloud\-based data platforms, modern lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, performance optimization, and production\-grade engineering practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently owning complex data\-engineering components, contributing to technical design and architecture decisions, troubleshooting production issues, and providing technical guidance to other engineers. **Key Responsibilities:** **1\. Data Pipeline Engineering** * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable **ETL/ELT data pipelines**. * Develop production\-quality data\-processing solutions using **Python and PySpark**. * Build reusable frameworks and components for ingestion, transformation, validation, and publishing of data. * Process large structured, semi\-structured, and distributed datasets. Implement incremental and batch\-processing patterns where appropriate. * **2\. Snowflake Development** * Design and develop scalable data solutions using **Snowflake**. * Develop complex SQL transformations, data models, views, and reusable data structures. * Optimize Snowflake workloads for performance, scalability, and cost. * Implement appropriate data\-loading and transformation patterns between AWS data platforms and Snowflake. Troubleshoot performance and data\-quality issues across Snowflake workloads. * **3\. dbt Development** * Build and maintain transformation pipelines using **dbt**. * Develop modular, reusable, maintainable dbt models. * Implement dbt tests and documentation. * Follow appropriate development practices for source, staging, intermediate, and business\-layer transformations. Support automated deployment and CI/CD practices for dbt projects. * **4\. Apache Iceberg / Lakehouse** * Design and implement data\-lake and lakehouse solutions using **Apache Iceberg**. * Build scalable table structures for large analytical datasets. * Work with partitioning, schema evolution, incremental processing, and table\-maintenance strategies. * Integrate Iceberg\-based datasets with Spark and AWS\-based data\-processing services. Ensure efficient storage and query patterns for high\-volume datasets. * **5\. AWS Data Engineering** * Design and implement cloud\-native data solutions on **AWS**. * Build data\-processing workloads leveraging services such as **S3, Glue, EMR and Lambda** where appropriate. * Implement secure access patterns using AWS IAM. * Monitor data workloads and troubleshoot operational issues. Participate in designing scalable, reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient cloud data architectures. * **6\. Performance \& Scalability** * Diagnose and optimize **Spark/PySpark jobs**, SQL queries, Snowflake workloads, and data pipelines. * Identify bottlenecks involving compute, storage, partitioning, data skew, transformations, and queries. Design solutions capable of supporting increasing data volumes without unnecessary infrastructure cost. * **7\. Data Quality \& Governance** * Implement automated data\-quality checks across ingestion and transformation layers. * Establish proper logging, monitoring, exception handling, and reconciliation mechanisms. * Follow organizational standards for data security, governance, lineage, and access controls. Ensure production pipelines are reliable, auditable, and maintainable. * **8\. Engineering Best Practices** * Write clean, modular, reusable, testable, and maintainable code. * Perform code reviews and enforce engineering standards. * Implement unit, integration, and data\-validation testing. * Use Git\-based version control and CI/CD practices. Create and maintain appropriate technical documentation. * **9\. Senior\-Level Responsibilities** * Independently drive technically complex data\-engineering requirements from design through production deployment. * Participate in solution design and architecture discussions. * Evaluate alternative implementation approaches and recommend appropriate solutions. * Troubleshoot complex production and performance issues. * Mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers. * Collaborate with Architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, QA, DevOps, and application teams. * Translate business/data requirements into scalable technical solutions. Identify technical risks and proactively recommend improvements. * **Core Skills Expected** A strong candidate should demonstrate **deep hands\-on capability**, not merely theoretical exposure, in the following areas: **Area** **Expected Capability** **Python** Advanced, production\-quality data engineering development **PySpark** Large\-scale distributed processing, optimization and troubleshooting **Snowflake** Development, modeling, optimization and performance tuning **dbt** Models, tests, macros, documentation and deployment practices **Apache Iceberg** Lakehouse/table design, partitioning, schema evolution and optimization **AWS** Hands\-on cloud data platform development **SQL** Advanced SQL, query optimization and analytical processing **Data Engineering** ETL/ELT, batch/incremental pipelines, data quality and orchestration **Data Architecture** Data Lake, Data Warehouse and Lakehouse concepts **Engineering Practices** Git, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production support **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. * Strong experience delivering **enterprise\-scale cloud data platforms**. * Experience migrating legacy data workloads to modern AWS/Snowflake architectures. * Experience working with very large datasets and distributed processing. * Knowledge of data security and governance practices. * Experience working in Agile delivery environments. * AWS and/or Snowflake certification is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A\-player who loves a fast\-paced, high\-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year. This role supports end\-to\-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run\-of\-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite. You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best\-in\-class events. This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara's main production vendor and venue partners. * Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers. * Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met. * Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue. * Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules. * Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 3\+ years of experience in event management/production * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is required. * This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. * Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently. **An ideal candidate also has:** * Strong communication, negotiation, and budget\-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization * Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality. * Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks. * Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A\-player who loves a fast\-paced, high\-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year. This role supports end\-to\-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run\-of\-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite. You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best\-in\-class events. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. jobs.description: Job Description: **Schneider Electric** has a meaningful opportunity available for a **Senior Firmware Engineer** for our **Power Products** division in the greater Raleigh, NC area. You will work for a company consistently rated by Fortune as one of the “Great Places to Work”, by Glassdoor as the 11th spot on the “Best Place To Work” and by TIME as the “Most Sustainable Company in the World.” **Job Description:**We are seeking a motivated Senior Firmware Engineer to join our mission\-based R\&D team focused on power electronics, protection, control, and conversion of AC, DC, and hybrid systems. We pioneer technologies, incubate new markets, and influence industry standards by conceiving and developing products and systems, and delivering industry certified solutions. Our team is developing and implementing the next generation of electrical distribution technologies to enable a safer, more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy future. **Responsibilities:** * Specify, design and develop firmware for **solid\-state circuit breakers, hybrid protection systems,** **Fault Managed Power Systems (****FMPS****)****,** **and advanced power conversion products.** * Own the product development lifecycle from concept and architecture through requirements, design documentation, implementation, validation, certification, and commercialization * Design and implement firmware for protection, sensing, fault detection, interruption, current limiting, communication, and control functions using simulation and modeling * Develop and implement algorithms for analog, digital, and mixed\-signal electronics designs with emphasis on reliability, validation, manufacturability, and EMC performance. * Collaborate with electronics, software, systems, mechanical, manufacturing, and certification teams while contributing to innovation: intellectual property, technical publications, and standards activities (External) English Qualifications: **Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field, and 5\+ years of experience in firmware or software product development; jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Category:** ================= Global IT **Job Family:** =============== Software Development \& Engineering **Job Description:** ==================== The Principal Software Engineer is the senior technical leader and supply chain domain expert on the US Supply Chain Fusion Team, acting as a critical technical bridge between supply chain business operations and core IT solutions. This role powers the IT solutions behind demand planning, procurement, inventory management, warehousing, distribution, and manufacturing logistics. The Principal Software Engineer spends roughly half of their time on technical strategy, architecture, governance, and Agile leadership, and half on highly complex technical execution across production support and projects. As AI capabilities mature, the role is increasingly hybrid, combining engineering, business analysis, and deep domain expertise. The position works within an Agile Fusion Team alongside the Digital Product Manager, Digital Product Owner, and IT Global Delivery Leader. **Hybrid** : This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule (Monday\-Friday) located at our Home Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The hybrid work schedule is 3 days/week onsite at Home Office and 2 days/week from home. **Relocation Benefits:** Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for this position. **About our Green Bay, WI Home Office:** You’ll find lots to love in our beautiful home office in downtown Green Bay, Wisconsin. Our jeans\-friendly environment has indoor and outdoor collaboration spaces, state\-of\-the\-art R\&D and sensory labs, culinary kitchens, a pilot plant, innovation center and more. Take advantage of outdoor workspaces. Sample and provide feedback on new products from our R\&D team. Enjoy free coffee, soda and popcorn. Take a short walk to restaurants, breweries, the YMCA and a weekly farmer’s market on the scenic Fox River. You can even see Lambeau Field from our top floor. **What You'll Do** ================== **Supply Chain Solutions \& Domain Leadership** ----------------------------------------------- * Supply Chain Domain Expertise: Serve as the go\-to expert on supply chain business processes and documentation across demand planning, procurement, inventory management, warehousing, distribution, and manufacturing logistics; translate business needs into technical solutions and explain technical impacts in business terms. * End\-to\-End Visibility: Design systems that increase operational visibility across inventory tracking, raw material procurement, cold\-chain logistics, and order fulfillment. * Data \& Analytics Integration: Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to integrate operational data into advanced analytics and AI/ML workflows (e.g., predictive maintenance, demand forecasting, routing optimization). * Vendor \& System Integration: Interface with external software vendors and internal enterprise systems to address product defects, implement platform upgrades, and manage custom API/interface developments. **Technical Strategy \& Architecture** -------------------------------------- * Strategic Influence: Initiate, lead, recommend, and implement technical strategies for supply chain systems; work with architects to implement technical architecture roadmaps and standardize and modernize solutions (Cloud, AI, automation); present complex technical information to non\-technical business partners and senior leadership; and create key decision documents. * Architectural Alignment: Participate in Centers of Excellence (COEs) and submit new architecture needs to the Architecture Review Board (ARB). Enterprise Governance \& Audits: Establish, document, and govern software engineering standards, guidelines, and patterns; measure, monitor, and execute audits to ensure compliance, including IT general controls, audit trails, data privacy, and food safety requirements where applicable. * **Delivery \& Operational Excellenc** **e** ------------------------------------------- * Agile Accountability: Own effort estimates and well\-defined tasks for user stories; serve as the point of accountability for team\-wide testing quality and release deployment success; and establish CI/CD standards and release governance. Supports both Agile projects and Waterfall (EPM) enterprise initiatives. Production Support Strategy: Govern Tier 3 support (including 24x7 on\-call) for supply chain applications; prevent issues through root cause analysis, proactive monitoring, observability, and application health checks; and own the application lifecycle roadmap (patching, upgrades, decommissioning, archiving, purging) and disaster recovery readiness. * **Leadership \& Talent Developmen** **t** ----------------------------------------- * Talent Development: Mentor engineers at all levels, lead design and code reviews, develop technical training for Global IT partners, research and educate on emerging technologies, and  luding data modeling and relational/non\-relational data structures. * Experience with system integration protocols (REST/SOAP APIs, event\-driven architecture, messaging queues). **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and analytical toolsets (e.g., Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Azure/AWS/GCP cloud services). * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing. * Experience in food manufacturing or cold\-chain environments. **Core Expectations** --------------------- * Growth mindset and change agility. * Customer and partner focus, including emotional intelligence and addressing conflict respectfully. * Ability to travel up to 5% (within and outside the US). * Participation in the 24x7 Tier 3 on\-call rotation. **Eligible partners will receive:** =================================== * **Get not one, but TWO retirement benefits.** When you join our employee\-owned company, you’ll be part of our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) from day one. In addition to an 8% 401(k) match into the ESOP, Schreiber will contribute an extra amount – about 8% of your earnings – toward your retirement every year. That’s a company contribution of around 16% in retirement savings annually. That’s hard to beat! * **Earn bonus pay.** You’ll have an opportunity to earn incentive pay twice a year when we meet our company goals. * **Ready to make a move?** Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for a U.S. Salaried position. * **Childcare costs** . Get up to $5,000 annually to help you with the cost of childcare. Monthly contributions toward childcare expenses, including independent babysitters. * **Earn extra money for taking care of yourself.** Eligible partners can earn a Wellness Incentive and receive an employer‑funded Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) to use on fitness, mental health, and other lifestyle expenses. * **Pursue development that’s relevant to your role, career goals and the company.** Plus, we offer tuition reimbursement if you want to further your education to grow in your role at Schreiber. * **Get access to medical, prescription drug, dental and vision benefits** starting day one. This includes an onsite nurse and mental health counselor. * **Experience caring like you’ve never experienced it before.** We have a program that’s completely organized by and for other partners who need extra help. It’s called Partners Helping Partners. We have hundreds of examples of partners organizing fundraisers to help out others going through a hard time. * **Benefits that support your whole life.** Visit Schreiber – Care for you to see everything Schreiber offers to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. For positions that require any amount of travel: Valid driver's license, auto insurance (at least state minimum\- more might be required), acceptable driving record per Schreiber Foods discretion, and vehicle that will ensure applicant can meet the travel necessities of the position are required. Schreiber requires that an employee have authorization to work in the country in which the role is based. In the event, an applicant does not have current work authorization, Schreiber will determine, in its sole discretion, whether to sponsor an individual for work authorization. However, based on immigration requirements, not all roles are suitable for sponsorship. Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. **Want to be alerted of new openings?** Sign in and click the cloud in the upper\-right corner to view your profile. From there you can setup **Job Alerts** .

This role works closely with customers, product management, and development teams to define integration requirements, validate solutions, and ensure successful deployment within electric utility and industrial automation environments. Knowledge of software development principles, scripting, databases, and power system integration solutions is beneficial. **A typical day as a Product Engineer might include:** * Develop and maintain an in\-depth understanding of specific product line(s), product applications, competition, and markets. Analyze competitor products and prepare technical product comparison reports. * Serve as primary technical contact to sales, marketing, operations, and others as required for in\-service product support. * Participate in specifying product requirements, and work closely with Product Managers to ensure product features and functionality meet the customer/market needs. * Work with development engineers and product managers to prioritize development activities to meet customer needs while accomplishing objectives. * Prepare product documentation including data sheets, flyers, instruction manuals, guideform specifications, release notes, and service bulletins. * Perform product validation testing and approve validation results. * Participate in industry technical meetings and conferences. Prepare and present technical product presentations. * Maintain an end user system operational understanding of how specific technology families are used and have a clear understanding of the functional priority. * Assist with developing and creating concept documents or drawings associated with new product ideas to be developed within R\&D. * Understand. Create. Simplify. * Other duties as assigned. **This job might be for you if:** * B.S. degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering field * 2\+ years of working knowledge of electric power or industrial system integration and automation practices and philosophies * 2\+ years of technical marketing experience * Excellent technical and marketing presentation and writing skills * Knowledge of product life cycle planning and market positioning * Willing to travel up to 25% * Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills * Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities * Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment * Background check results satisfactory to SEL * Negative drug test result(s) **It is a plus if you have:** * Project management and/or project technical leadership * Experience with electric utility relays and telecommunications * Experience with software development, programming, or database technologies. * Specifying graphical user interface **About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories:** SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. ### **About Our Team** Our iOS Engineering team plays a pivotal role in enhancing the experience of our 2 million subscribers through two key iOS apps: Everand and Scribd. The Everand app is a gateway for our users to access an expansive library of over 7 million titles, including ebooks, audiobooks, podcasts, and magazine articles, offering a Netflix\-like experience. Meanwhile, the Scribd app provides access to an extensive collection of over 100 million user\-uploaded documents, including PDFs and other formats. The Growth organization drives user engagement and business impact across the customer journey. The Retention \& Monetization team focuses on conversion flows, subscription management, and retention experiences that maximize long\-term value for our users. On mobile, that means we own how people start, manage, and keep their subscriptions: paywalls, in\-app purchases, plan changes, cancellation and save flows, and the experiments behind them. Our work ties directly to revenue and retention. ### **About the Role** We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join our Growth Retention \& Monetization team. You will be the iOS technical owner for the team across the Everand and Scribd apps, and lead the subscription, paywall, and retention features that drive revenue. You will build in\-app purchase flows with StoreKit, ship A/B experiments, and partner with backend, web, and Android engineers on shared subscription systems. You will also improve app stability, pay down technical debt, and mentor the engineers around you. ### **What We're Looking For** * A passionate iOS engineer who takes pride in writing clean, maintainable, and scalable Swift code. * A technical owner who sets direction, breaks large projects into clear steps, and unblocks others. * A collaborator who communicates early and often with cross\-functional partners to align on goals and tradeoffs. * A pragmatic problem\-solver who balances technical rigor with business impact. * An engineer who cares deeply about users and turns that care into the features they build. ### **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience shipping iOS apps to the public, including consumer apps at scale. * Strong proficiency in Swift, with deep experience in SwiftUI and UIKit. * Comfort working in a mature codebase that still has Objective\-C. * Experience building in\-app purchase or subscription features with StoreKit, and knowledge of the App Store rules that apply to them. * Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL a plus). * A track record of addressing technical debt and migrating code to newer technologies without slowing delivery. * Excellent communication skills and ability to lead technical initiatives in a collaborative environment. ### **Technical Skills** * **Primary:** Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit * **Secondary:** Objective\-C * **Payments:** StoreKit and StoreKit 2, App Store subscriptions * **Testing:** XCTest, XCUITest (or similar) * **API Integration:** RESTful APIs, JSON, GraphQL * **Tooling:** Xcode, Git, and iOS CI/CD ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with subscription systems, payments, or retention features such as paywalls, trials, cancellation and save flows, or win\-back. * Experience with experimentation platforms (Statsig or similar) and product analytics. * Familiarity with web technologies (JavaScript, JSON, REST) or backend frameworks such as Ruby on Rails, to support cross\-stack collaboration. * Exposure to Auth0 or similar authentication frameworks. * Interest in cross\-platform collaboration with Android and web teams. At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $151,500 \[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $221,500 \[maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $124,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $221,000 \[maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $159,000 CAD\[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $198,500 CAD\[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job\-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package. **Working at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- **Are you currently based in a location where Scribd, Inc. can employ you?** Employees must have their **primary residence in or near** one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance: **United States****:** Atlanta \| Austin \| Boston \| Dallas \| Denver \| Chicago \| Houston \| Jacksonville \| Los Angeles \| Miami \| New York City \| Phoenix \| Portland \| Sacramento \| Salt Lake City \| San Diego \| San Francisco \| Seattle \| Washington D.C. **Canada****:** Ottawa \| Toronto \| Vancouver **Mexico****:** Mexico City **Benefits at Scribd, Inc.** * Scribd Flex (flexible work model) * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support and disability coverage * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbaticals * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Retirement matching and employee equity * Learning and development programs and professional growth opportunities * Wellness and home office stipends * Complimentary access to the Scribd, Inc. suite of products * Enterprise access to leading AI tools **Get to Know Scribd, Inc.** **About Scribd, Inc.** **Life at Scribd, Inc.** *We want our interview process to be accessible to everyone. You can inform us of any reasonable adjustments we can make to better accommodate your needs by emailing accommodations@scribd.com about the need for adjustments at any point in the interview process.* *If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available* *here**.* *Scribd, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, and believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.*

We work in a culture where voices are amplified to drive meaningful change and generate non\-stop impact. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, such as employee\-paid medical benefits, 401k matching, and generous time off, such as for volunteering and even to celebrate your birthday! We provide opportunities for employees to learn and grow while fostering an inclusive work culture, and we have a tremendously diverse workforce that drives our ability to innovate and maintain excellence. Seattle Credit Union is dedicated to helping our members achieve financial prosperity by providing education and banking services that meet their personal goals. We are Inclusive, Inventive and Invested. We are Seattle Credit Union \- we build strong and trusting relationships in service of our Mission. Seattle Credit Union is proud to be intentional in recruiting, hiring, and promoting a workplace that is inclusive. JOB TITLE: **Application Systems Analyst** Department: Information Technology FLSA Status: Exempt We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer that celebrates our collective differences and encourages all to apply, including those with different backgrounds, disability, ages, ethnicities, races, religions, gender identities, sexual orientations, national origins, or veteran status’ protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **ABOUT THE ROLE:** We are looking for an **Application Systems Analyst** who is driven to make a positive impact on the employee experience. You are a strategic thinker with a bias for action. You have a relentless pursuit of excellence while bringing others along. You do not settle for mediocrity and are comfortable with challenging the status quo. If you’re always looking for more efficient and innovative ways of working, are thoughtful, intentional, and collaborative, we would love to talk to you! The **Application Systems Analyst** is responsible for oversight, maintenance, and proactive solution delivery related to our Core System, FISERV DNA. The role provides Core application system expertise, manages Core applications, provides liaison support between customers and Core application vendor provides troubleshooting support for applications, and performs applications upgrades and enhancements. This is an exciting opportunity to bring forth new ideas and see those ideas come to life! **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Create, modify, and update system jobs, schedules, and procedures to comply with new operational solutions. * Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and solutions by combining technical expertise with a solid understanding of basic software design concepts throughout the software development lifecycle. * Determine best solution given requirements for applications. * Responsible for system analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation. * Responsible for identifying areas of improvement in existing code and implementing those improvements. * Responsible for facilitating the effective use of computerized information systems by applying a comprehensive knowledge of technology support, automate and improve existing systems. * Monitor and ensure application bandwidth utilization, performance and stability remains at acceptable levels * Provides application security sufficient to meet the Credit Union’s needs and regulatory requirements * Develops and maintains documentation including but not limited to written and operating procedures * Analyze projects to identify and propose solutions to IT management which may include opportunities to automate functions, streamline data interaction between systems and provide accurate, efficient and effective operations by general Credit Union staff. * Able to self\-direct to automate and improve business processes and interactions with limited guidance. * Participates in discussions with Engineers and technical leaders to help define the team’s technology roadmap and vision. * Installs, tests, and maintains Core related application software, including but not limited to upgrades, patches and critical fixes * Supports cross functional business needs as needed * Troubleshoot server and application issues * Consistently meets deadlines and project deliverables. * Efficiently produces quality work products that align with varying levels of difficulty and turnaround times. * Effectively adjusts to changing and evolving priorities and expectations. * Demonstrates decisiveness, integrity, flexibility, and critical thinking that advances team, department, and organizational success. * Demonstrates excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrates excellent customer service skills to both internal and external audiences. * Demonstrates commitment to SCU Values. * Successfully manages unexpected situations using anecdotal and factual data to resolve challenges optimally. * Establishes and maintains collaborative relationships with all levels of teammates across the organization. * Maintain regular and punctual attendance. * Other duties as assigned **WHAT YOU WILL BRING:** **Required Qualifications:** * Associates degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Fiserv DNA * Two (2\)\+ years’ experience in IT profession * Two (2\)\+ years financial institution experience * Two (2\)\+ years work related skill, knowledge, experience working with Fiserv DNA and Nautilus * Two (2\)\+ years of hands\-on experience administering DNA core system \& automation system or related job automation system. * One (1\)\+ year direct experience as an application analyst or equivalent * Advanced knowledge of Fiserv products * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree * Intermediate Oracle experience * Intermediate SQL experience * Proficient with .NET, C\#, PowerShell, Python * Understanding of relational and non\-relational data modeling and data analysis * Intermediate experience with SOLID design principles, Object\-Oriented Programming and Design, demonstrated through regular communication, usage, and presentation **Working Conditions:** * This is a hybrid role with work performed remotely as well as in an office and/or branch environment in the Greater Seattle area of Washington State. * Team members may attend special off\-hour meetings and seminars. * The nature of work may include prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. **Benefits**: *Seattle Credit Union supports and invests in our employees. We offer many great benefits including zero contribution medical, dental, and vision plans for our employees. Additionally, SCU offers a generous paid time off program as well as a 401k plan with a dollar\-for\-dollar employer match up to 5%.* **To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.** **The compensation range may vary based on the candidate’s geographic location.** **The pay range for this role is:** 68,450 \- 102,675 USD per year(US SCU National)

jobs.title: Product Owner (OmniAnalyst)
jobs.description: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work\-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve. Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies Certified as a Great Place to Work® Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services \& Insurance Product Owner (OmniAnalyst) **PRIMARY PURPOSE:** The Product Owner plays a key role in building our next\-generation, AI\-forward data analytics platform, a tool designed to put trusted, actionable insights into the hands of the people who need them faster than ever before. Partnering closely with the Product Manager, this role translates business needs and product priorities into detailed, actionable requirements and execution plans, refines and manages the product backlog, and ensures delivery drives meaningful business outcomes. The Product Owner may execute delegated Product Manager activities when capacity or capability constraints exist. This role is central to validating delivered functionality, tracking adoption and outcomes, and shaping how AI capabilities such as natural\-language querying, automated insight generation, and intelligent recommendations come to life for users across the enterprise. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Partners with Product Managers on backlog refinement and prioritization for the analytics platform, sequencing work based on user value, data dependencies, technical complexity, and capacity. * Defines development\-ready stories and requirements by breaking down epics and features into user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and documenting data requirements, metric definitions, and high\-level non\-functional requirements such as performance, security, data access, and auditability. * Executes delegated Product Manager responsibilities when PM capacity or capability is limited, ensuring continuity of product execution. * Collaborates with engineering, data engineering, and analytics teams to ensure stories are well understood and aligned with business outcomes. * Validates solutions for business units by participating in and supporting User Acceptance Testing, including verifying the accuracy of data outputs, reports, and AI\-generated insights against source data and defined acceptance criteria. * Provides visibility into delivery and outcomes by tracking and reporting on delivery progress, platform adoption, and user engagement to surface risks, dependencies, and performance insights for stakeholders. * Partners with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and MLOps teams to translate AI/ML and generative AI capabilities into backlog items, defining acceptance criteria that account for model behavior, response accuracy, explainability, data dependencies, and performance thresholds. * Champions the user experience by gathering feedback from analysts, operational leaders, and business users to understand how they find, interpret, and act on data, then turns those insights into product improvements. * Partners with data governance, privacy, and security teams to ensure platform features align with data access controls, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI standards. **ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Raises risks, capacity concerns, and reallocation recommendations to Product Managers. * Supports sprint ceremonies by clarifying requirements and answering questions during delivery. * Supports product demos, walkthroughs, and stakeholder communications, helping business partners see what's possible with AI\-powered analytics. * Serves as a subject matter resource for platform workflows, data sources, and capabilities. * Monitors deployed AI features for performance, accuracy, drift, and user feedback, and works with technical teams to surface retraining, tuning, or prompt refinement needs as backlog items. * Stays current on emerging trends in AI, generative AI, and modern analytics tools, bringing forward ideas that keep the platform ahead of the curve. Performs other duties as assigned. * **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. Equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered. **Experience:** * Five (5\) years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience required. * Experience performing business analysis, requirements definition, or supporting product delivery required. * Experience delivering product capabilities for data analytics, business intelligence (BI), or other enterprise software platforms, whether commercial SaaS or internally built, required. * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or data\-driven product initiatives preferred. * Experience in claims, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated operational environments preferred. Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery teams preferred. * **Skills \& Knowledge** * Strong product and requirements documentation skills. * Ability to translate business needs into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria. * Working knowledge of data analytics concepts such as data models, KPIs and metric definitions, dashboards, and self\-service analytics. * Understanding of how AI\-powered features are evaluated, including accuracy, reliability, and explainability of outputs. * Familiarity with agile delivery practices and backlog management. * Ability to assess scope, dependencies, and delivery complexity. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Experience tracking delivery metrics and supporting OKR reporting. * Ability to understand and communicate budget impacts and delivery trade\-offs. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and AI concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. * Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI to change how people work with data. Ability to meet or exceed performance competencies. * **WORK ENVIRONMENT** When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations. **Mental** **:** Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work\-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines **Physical** **:** Computer keyboarding, travel as required **Auditory/Visual** **:** Hearing, vision and talking As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is ($ 100k\-$130k ) . A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits. \#claimsexaminer \#claims \#hybrid \#LI\-REMOTE Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug\-Free Workplace. **If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.description: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. This role owns the vision, governance, and execution model for the enterprise data supply chain that powers machine learning platforms, feature stores, and production‑grade generative AI capabilities.** **As a senior leader, the Vice President establishes and scales the engineering strategy required to transform legacy and modern data assets into trusted, AI‑ready enterprise capabilities. The role ensures that data and AI engineering investments are aligned to business outcomes, regulatory expectations, and long‑term architectural sustainability across on‑premise and multi‑cloud environments, including Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems.** **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Defines and leads the enterprise strategy for data and generative AI engineering, establishing standards, roadmaps, and operating models that support analytics, machine learning, and AI at scale. * Provides executive oversight for the design, delivery, and operation of enterprise ETL/ELT platforms that integrate legacy on‑premise systems (including mainframe, SQL Server, and DB2\) with modern cloud data and AI platforms. * Establishes governance and accountability for feature stores, analytically optimized datasets, and AI‑ready data products to ensure reproducibility, regulatory compliance, and production reliability. * Sets direction for generative AI enablement, including enterprise approaches for vectorization, embeddings, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and secure consumption of structured and unstructured data. * Owns the enterprise Snowflake strategy, including architectural patterns, performance standards, cost governance, and integration with cloud‑based AI services across AWS and Azure. * Leads cross‑functional collaboration with Technology, Security, Infrastructure, Legal, Risk, and Compliance leaders to ensure data and AI engineering practices meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. * Establishes executive‑level
