jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AppEx
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **About the Team** ------------------ Snowflake engineering takes pride in building highly reliable and scalable products.In the era of autonomous AI agents and continuous deployment, a traditional testing model breaks down under massive PR volume. Our AI pilled engineers treat validation as a scalable, developer\-first platform. The Release Validation Team builds test frameworks that make continuous deployment safe, cost\-efficient, and agent\-friendly. Our customers are Snowflake engineers and their army of agents. How do Snowflake engineers keep their agents running autonomous for hours and days, landing quality PRs with human interventions? They rely on layers of validation that agents can execute in high\-fidelity production simulation. We give Snowflake the confidence to ship at speed without compromising Snowflake’s core brand promise: extreme reliability. **In this role, you will:** * **Lead and grow the team**. Hire, mentor, and develop engineers working on test infrastructure, automation, and developer tooling. Build a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and focus on the customer. * **Set strategy and roadmap**. Define and drive the multi\-quarter vision for release validation: faster signals, fewer blockers, better test quality, and lower cost. * **Own the validation platform**. Be accountable for the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our distributed regression and workload test frameworks, pre\-production environments, and release validation pipeline.. * **Improve test health across the company**. Work with feature teams to reduce flaky, non\-hermetic, duplicate, and low\-value tests, and set standards and incentives that keep them healthy. * **Cut down release blockers**. Lead efforts to improve how failures are traced to their cause, filter out noise from infrastructure problems, and speed up triage so real regressions reach the owning team quickly. * **Drive AI and automation**. Invest in AI\-driven failure analysis and automated routing that remove manual work for engineers across Snowflake. * **Work across teams**. Act as the main partner to Release Engineering and engineering leaders on release quality **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\-5 years of experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers at different career stages. * Experience building and running large\-scale CI/CD, test infrastructure, or developer productivity platforms, ideally for complex distributed systems. * A strong technical background, with enough depth to review designs, make architecture tradeoffs, and earn the respect of senior engineers. * A solid grasp of test strategy: regression vs. workload testing, hermeticity, flakiness, coverage tradeoffs, and release gating. * Experience driving work across many teams and influencing without authority. * A data\-driven leadership style: you set measurable goals and use metrics to prioritize and show impact. * Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives. * BS/MS in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. jobs.title: Founding Customer Operations Lead
jobs.description: ### **Company Background** Specter's mission is to help automate the physical world. Today, we build video sensors with state\-of\-the\-art AI agents that answer any question, anywhere in their environments. Our systems can automatically detect and reason about any physical activity captured on camera, from security incidents (e.g. perimeter intrusion, theft, LPR), to safety monitoring (e.g. PPE detection, injured people), to operational eﬃciency (e.g. material tracking, congestion monitoring). We oﬀer both long range wireless (1km range) and wired sensor variants to suit any deployment. Our co\-founders Xerxes and Philip are passionate about empowering our partners in the fast approaching world of physical AI and robotics. We are a small, fast growing team who hail from Anduril, Tesla, Uber, and the U.S. Special Forces. ### **The Role** Customer Operations is accountable for keeping Specter working for every customer. When we or a customer identify an issue, proactively communicate, triage, and resolve it. One person owns the problem from the first report to resolution. Success is measured by reliability: we catch issues before our customers do and fix them fast. As our Founding Customer Operations Lead, you will partner closely with engineering (fix what breaks, catch it before the customer does), deployment operations (sustain hardware in the field), and deployment strategy (get customers to value, expand, and renew). You’ll also own the customer onboarding experience, giving every Specter user a personalized first impression with the platform. If Deployment Strategy is offense, Customer Operations is defense. We build hardware and software so our support mandate is much more expansive than a typical SaaS company. About half of what breaks is physical: radio links, site power, mothernodes, firmware, weather. The other half is software and ML: missed detections, false positives, software bugs. Our users span a variety of industries and technical ability. Your mission is to deliver a support experience that customers and internal teams love, and build the systems that let us do it without linearly scaling our people. If successful, this operational layer will be the foundation on which we build Specters’ physical AI and robotics platform. ### **Responsibilities** * Own every customer issue from first report to resolution. Acknowledge issues in minutes, triage, loop in the right on\-call engineer or deployment operations lead, keep the customer updated, and close the loop with a root cause. * Catch issues before our customers do. Live in fleet telemetry and PagerDuty. Own the question “why didn’t we catch this first?” and partner with engineering to close these gaps. * Understand the details of our product (platform, ML, firmware, hardware, RF). Know the difference between a radio issue, a site power issue, and a bad prompt. Have intuition around when we deploy our team onsite to address. * Build systems that help us deliver unreasonable hospitality at scale. Meet customers where they are (Slack, Teams, email, text, phone). Remember context from previous interactions. Make our users look good intentionally. Aspire to a “wow, this is beyond what I expected” experience every time. * Do things agentically. We use Pylon for support issues today but there is a lot to be built that helps us scale excellent support without scaling our people. * Reduce noise. Distill repeat issues into product features that engineering can build. jobs.title: Historian 1
jobs.description: **The Department of Natural Resources, Division of** **Parks \& Outdoor Recreation,** **is recruiting for a** **Historian 1 in Anchorage.** **This position is open to Alaska Residents only.** Please check our residency definition to determine if you qualify. **What You Will Be Doing:** This position provides historical assistance to programs administered by the Office of History and Archaeology (OHA), including historic preservation, public education, and geographic name programs. The position requires research\-based knowledge of Alaskan history and its broader role in American and World history. The position will work with local communities on Historic preservation processes and planning, National Register nominations, and incentive programs such as tax credits, heritage tourism, and other history\-related/historic preservation activities. **Mission and Values/Culture:** The Office of History and Archaeology (OHA) is Alaska's primary office with knowledge and expertise in historic preservation, dedicated to preserving and interpreting Alaska's past, and it serves as Alaska's State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO). OHA administers programs authorized by both the National Historic Preservation Act of 1966 and the Alaska Historic Preservation Act of 1971\. The office works with federal and state agencies, tribes, local governments, the public, and educational and not\-for\-profit organizations to identify, preserve, protect, and interpret the state's cultural, historic, and archaeological resources, ensuring that our heritage is passed on to future generations. **Benefits of Joining Our Team:** The position offers the incumbent an opportunity to work with a group of dedicated professionals willing to provide meaningful mentorship. The position helps shape historic preservation policy, offers insight into federal\-state cultural resource programs, and helps local communities preserve Alaska's historic and culturally significant places. While the position requires full\-time presence at OHA, work schedules may be flexible, especially during episodes of inclement weather. **The Working Environment You Can Expect:** OHA is an open office environment in which the incumbent has access to desk space, a personal computer, and software including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, etc. Daily activities include digital scanning, copying, filing, and computer work. The incumbent contributes to in\-person and virtual meetings weekly. Field work may include traveling to cities, towns, communities, and remote locations throughout Alaska to conduct historic preservation planning and field investigations, document historic properties, and prepare reports, including historic documentation for National Register of Historic Places nominations. The position requires being present at historic sites, which may involve exposure to high noise levels, working around moving machinery, and navigating difficult terrain and weather. **We are looking for a candidate who possesses the following position\-specific competencies.** * History and Archaeology: Knowledge of historical events and their causes, indicators, and impact on particular civilizations and cultures, and of preservation and archival techniques. * Oral and Written Communication: Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral and written presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. * Self\-Management: Sets well\-defined, realistic personal goals; shows a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment to completing assignments on time; works with minimal supervision; is motivated to achieve; demonstrates responsible behavior. * Teamwork: Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals. * Public Service Motivation: Shows a commitment to serve the public. Ensures that actions meet public needs; aligns organizational objectives and practices with public interests. **Click here****to learn more about working for the Division of Parks \& Outdoor Recreation.** **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college with a major in history, architectural history, or a closely related field, and one year experience in the collection, synthesis, evaluation and presentation of historical or architectural historic data. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, HR Solutions
jobs.description: Overview: **Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.** With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. **Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies. Responsibilities: **Position Purpose:** The Forward Deployed Engineer, HR Solutions will be a hands\-on business and technical problem solver within the StoneX HR AI Pod, responsible for translating ambiguous HR business problems into clear requirements and practical, production\-ready solutions. Reporting into EIT and embedded within HR, this role will work directly with HR leaders, process owners, and subject matter experts to understand current processes, identify root causes, define business and technical requirements, evaluate solution options, and take the selected solution through deployment and ongoing production support. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in ambiguity, moving between business discovery and hands\-on technical delivery, and selecting the simplest effective approach. Solutions may include process redesign, platform configuration, workflow automation, integration, data, conventional application development, or AI. **Technology Ecosystem:*** **Front\-End:** Microsoft Copilot/Copilot Studio user experiences, HR employee self\-service, chatbots, resource\-library agents, preboarding/onboarding experiences, job description/posting tools * **Back End:** APIs, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, data integrations, workflow automations, enterprise systems, HR systems, Oracle integrations, SQL, data transformation, Python, JavaScript * **Architect:** APIs, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, data integrations, workflow automations, enterprise systems, HR systems, Oracle integrations, SQL, data transformation, Python, JavaScript * **Cloud:** Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud, Azure, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, cloud\-based integration patterns **Primary duties will include:*** Partner directly with HR leaders and process owners to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes. * Identify where AI, automation, data, or traditional technology can improve HR processes and employee experiences. * Lead discovery and translate ambiguous business needs into validated functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, process designs, data and integration requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate the most appropriate technology\-enabled solution with end users, using AI where it provides clear value. * Design, build, and deploy workflow automations, integrations, applications, data solutions, and AI\-enabled capabilities where appropriate. * Analyze current\-state processes, business rules, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and failure points so the solution addresses the root cause rather than automating an ineffective process. * Evaluate solution options and communicate tradeoffs across business value, complexity, risk, cost, maintainability, supportability, and time to value. * Develop solutions using Microsoft Copilot and related Microsoft AI and automation capabilities. * Integrate solutions with Oracle and other HR systems, data sources, APIs, and StoneX platforms. * Take successful prototypes from pilot through production deployment. * Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement for deployed solutions. * Partner with EIT architecture, data, security, and governance teams to ensure solutions meet StoneX standards. * Build appropriate human review, privacy, security, risk, and control requirements into solution design. * Document technical design, integrations, dependencies, support requirements, and lessons learned. * Establish measurable success criteria before implementation and assess results after deployment to determine whether the solution should be improved, scaled, replaced, or retired. **Example HR Pod Use Cases:** * The Forward Deployed Engineer may support initiatives such as: * HR employee self\-service and chatbot solutions * Oracle\-enabled AI and automation * Workforce planning tools and agents * Recruiting and interview scheduling automation * Job description and job\-posting creation * HR knowledge and resource\-library agents * Preboarding and onboarding experiences * HR reporting, analytics, and data automation * HR data quality and audit processes * Workflow redesign and other AI\-enabled HR solutions This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and can be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management deems necessary. Qualifications: **To land this role you will need**:* Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled applications, agents, automations, or workflow solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, or related Microsoft technologies. * Experience integrating applications with APIs, enterprise systems, and data sources. * Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and data integration concepts. * Experience taking technical solutions from prototype through testing, deployment, and production support. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated experience leading discovery with non\-technical business partners and translating ambiguous business problems into functional requirements, technical requirements, process designs, acceptance criteria, and a delivered solution. * Experience with software development practices, testing, documentation, version control, and production support. * Strong judgment related to data privacy, security, controls, and responsible AI use. **What makes you stand out:*** Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or other Oracle platforms. * Experience with Oracle integrations, APIs, or Oracle Integration Cloud. * Previous HR technology, HR systems, or HR process experience. * Experience with SQL and data transformation. * Experience with Python, JavaScript, or another relevant development language. * Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, and cloud\-based integration patterns. * Experience with conversational AI, AI agents, or agentic workflows. * Experience with Power BI or other analytics tools. * Experience working in an agile, product, consulting, or forward\-deployed engineering environment. **Education / Certification Requirements:** \- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Relevant technical, cloud, integration, data, process, or product certifications are a plus, but practical experience translating business needs into production solutions is more important * Commitment to continual professional and technical development **Working environment:** \- * In\-office 4 days a week *Hiring Salary Range $**110K\-130K* *(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities of the applicant, internal equity and alignment with market data.) Subject to business performance and recommendations of management, this role may be eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. This compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.*

jobs.description: **Principal Enterprise AI Architect / Financial Services** ========================================================== **Date:** Oct 5, 2026 **Location:** San Jose, California, United States **Company:** Super Micro Computer **Job Req ID: 30441** --------------------- **About Supermicro:** --------------------- Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. You will work with the customer for discovery, workshops, and proofs of concept. You design the AI factory, stand the first system up with the customer’s team, and stay involved through production handoff. You will package the design so Supermicro can repeat and scale it across thousands of customers. You will work with Supermicro sales, factory engineering, and NVIDIA field architects. Supermicro partners with NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel, and with leading storage and networking companies. Most work on these accounts is NVIDIA\-based — HGX, NVL\-class systems, and NVIDIA software. AMD, Intel, storage, and networking included when the customer’s standard requires it. This position is located in San Jose, CA. Exceptional candidates elsewhere in the United States will be considered if candidate can travel extensively for customer deployments. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** ------------------------------------------ * Forward\-deployed customer architecture Embed with high\-profile Financial Services accounts for discovery and design. Sit with scientists, risk, infrastructure, and security. Analyze the workload on their data and constraints. Produce the architecture and present it to executives and technical teams. Package departmental GPU and HPC nodes, HGX\-class clusters, or rack\-scale NVL systems, including networking, power, and liquid cooling. * Workshop, POC, and production handoff Run workshops from workload and data boundary to architecture, TCO, and operating model. Scope and run the proof of concept on Supermicro hardware, bring\-up, workload, fail\-closed tests. Write the production design Supermicro can build and ship. Bring in AI safety best practices when agents or sensitive data are in scope. Stay involved through first production handoff, then return the repeatable design to scale across similar customers. * Enablement and field leadership Document what worked at the account so the next deal in the vertical does not start from zero. Train sales and field engineers on how these accounts buy and deploy. Represent Supermicro with customers, partners, and at industry events in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Financial Services. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. 12\+ years as a solution architect, data center architect, or consultant, with production deployments you can point to. * Experience designing hybrid AI or HPC estates: private / on\-prem plus public cloud and/or GPU cloud / neocloud. Comfortable working on the customer floor: workshops, lab bring\-up, and POC execution, not only remote design reviews. * Experience taking large GPU/HPC systems from first workshop to production, including networking and data center power and cooling. Working knowledge of NVIDIA data center GPU platforms and software. NVIDIA certification is desirable. * Working knowledge of AMD and Intel server platforms and of major storage and networking products. Experience with regulated data, on\-premises inference, or scientific computing is strongly preferred. Ability to travel to customer sites for multi\-day workshops and POCs. **Salary Range** ---------------- $210,000 \- $255,000 The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Lead
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY: The Full Stack Developer Lead is a working lead who both manages and actively contributes to the Full Stack Developer team. This role is responsible for the team's day\-to\-day management — including assigning and prioritizing work, overseeing performance, and supporting the growth of each team member — while also personally designing, building, and maintaining backend services, APIs, and front\-end applications across Supplylogic's technology platform, including integrations with supplier and partner systems. jobs.title: Site Installation Lead
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking a Site Installation Lead to serve as a field leader within our Site Installations organization. This role is responsible for owning the safe, high\-quality, on\-schedule delivery of Symbotic’s automation installation scope on live customer sites, from mobilization through commissioning readiness. This is not a project coordination role — it is a field leadership role that requires hands\-on execution, decision\-making under pressure, and the ability to lead multi\-discipline, multi\-vendor teams in fast\-paced construction and startup environments. **What we do** The Site Installation team is responsible for delivering Symbotic’s automation systems on customer sites — turning engineered designs into fully installed, commissioning\-ready operations. The organization oversees the full on\-site installation lifecycle, including automation equipment, adapter cells, electrical and controls integration, and coordination with structural, racking, and construction partners. within budget, setting each site up for a successful startup and long\-term performance. **What you’ll do** * Lead the on\-site execution of automation, controls, and adapter\-cell installation from mobilization through commissioning readiness. * Drive safe, high\-quality, on\-schedule installation across electricians, controls technicians, commissioning resources, and third\-party contractors. * Own cell\-level readiness for handoff to commissioning with minimal rework and zero safety incidents. * Serve as the field authority for Symbotic’s automation installation scope on site. * Direct and influence multi\-vendor, multi\-discipline teams without formal reporting lines. * Make real\-time decisions when conditions change, issues arise, or schedules are at risk. * Identify, escalate, and resolve installation\-driven risks impacting schedule, quality, and cost. * Own the cost and schedule impact of field changes, rework, and resource tradeoffs within the automation scope. * Drive contractor performance, productivity, and accountability. * Validate system installation through hands\-on field verification, checklists, and performance testing. * Ensure each adapter cell and automation area is commissioning\-ready with defects resolved and documentation complete. * Capture lessons learned and apply them to future sites. * Partner closely with the Site Installation Manager, Project Management, Engineering, Safety, and Commissioning to ensure overall site success. * Lead automation\-specific kickoff meetings, progress reviews, and recovery plans. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline or related field required. * Minimum of 3 years trade experience in electrical installation, automation installation, industrial automation, robotics/ASRS, or large\-scale capital equipment installations required. * Demonstrated site\-level ownership of live installations that goes beyond participation or coordination * Experience leading electrical, controls, commissioning, and third\-party installation teams * Strong ability to diagnose design vs. process vs. execution issues in the field * Proven ability to make decisions, hold teams accountable, and deliver under pressure * Strong communication skills with engineers, project managers, customers, vendors, contractors and senior leadership **Our Environment** * Hybrid, travel\-based position. Access to major airport preferred. * Travel is required up to 80% of the time. Employee must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. Our main office is in Wilmington, MA. The person taking this position will be required to perform work at our customer installation locations for extended periods of time where equipment is installed and ready for commissioning. * The employee is responsible to own a credit card and manage expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi\-weekly basis. * The employee is frequently required to walk and reach with hands and arms. * The employee is routinely required to work at heights of up to 45 feet and within restrictive areas of 24 inches. to stand; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. * The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Must comply with all safety requirements and protocols, including without limitation Lock out tag out safety protocols and fall protection safety protocols. * Approximately 80% of time will be spent on a construction site with PPE required (hard hat, safety vest, steel toes, eyeglasses, ear protection, fall protection (e.g., safety harness). * There will be steep stairs to climb into the structure. You may be required to routinely walk up and down stairs to navigate the automation structure. * You will regularly be near railings that are high off the ground. Subject to environmental conditions, protection from weather conditions but not necessarily temperature changes. Must be capable of working in temperatures ranging from 105° to 32° Fahrenheit. * \#LI\-JC1 \#LI\-Remote **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. engaging major customers on technical matters, including silicon bring up support and issue escalation **Who You Are** * A leader who applies extensive knowledge of characterization and validation, You are the engineer who gets called when a customer's chiplet link will not train and no one else can figure out why. You do not panic. You methodically work through the protocol stack, the package channel, the firmware state machine, and the on\-die instrumentation until you isolate the variable that matters. You write code that performs reliably in an R\&D lab, including when rapid development is needed to unblock critical debug. You balance speed with sound software engineering, knowing when a focused debug script is appropriate and when the solution requires maintainable, well\-structured code that can evolve over time.Python for automation, C\+\+ for performance\-critical control loops, and you know when to reach for which one. You have architected software frameworks that other engineers depend on, and you take that responsibility seriously because bad infrastructure creates bad data. Working with customers does not intimidate you. You have debugged silicon in someone else's lab, explained what you found to their engineering team, and left them confident that the issue is understood and fixable. At Synopsys, you will set the technical direction for UCIe validation, mentor engineers who want to become you, and solve problems that matter to the future of chiplet\-based systems. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own the post\-silicon electrical validation and characterization strategy for UCIe die\-to\-die interface IP, from test plan definition through silicon sign\-off, determining what gets measured, how it gets measured, and what constitutes a pass * Architect and develop the software solutions the team uses for lab automation, result processing, and silicon debug, spanning Python, C, and C\+\+, including frameworks that handle instrument control, data capture, and automated test execution * Lead complex debug efforts that span circuit design, package and interposer channel behavior, link training firmware, and protocol layer interactions, driving issues to root cause when the failure mode is ambiguous and the data is incomplete * Support customers directly with the bring up and debug of their silicon, including sideband and mainband link training, lane repair and reversal, degraded mode operation, and chiplet interoperability, delivered through on\-site lab visits and remote correlation sessions * Develop characterization methodology for die\-to\-die links where direct probe access is limited, making effective use of on\-die instrumentation, eye margining, built\-in monitors, and traditional bench equipment like oscilloscopes, BERTs, and spectrum analyzers * Design and develop UIs and data presentation tools used for customer evaluations, marketing demonstrations, and internal reporting, ensuring that complex silicon behavior is communicated clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences * Review and approve the work of other validation engineers, provide technical mentorship and coaching to junior and mid\-level team members, and establish the measurement and correlation methodology the broader team adopts **The Impact You Will Have** * Ensure the reliability and performance of Synopsys' UCIe die\-to\-die interface IP, directly contributing to the success of the multi\-die and chiplet\-based systems our customers are building for AI, HPC, and data center applications * Deliver validation results and methodology that have measurable impact on department targets, including silicon sign\-off schedules and time\-to\-market for new IP releases * Establish the technical foundation and tooling that the validation team builds upon, raising the capability and efficiency of the discipline as a whole * Shorten debug cycles on complex, first\-of\-a\-kind silicon issues that would otherwise jeopardize product schedules and customer commitments * Strengthen customer confidence through credible, well\-correlated silicon data and compelling evaluation demonstrations that prove the IP works in real systems * Accelerate customer time\-to\-market by getting their silicon up and runni on validation, characterization, and debug of high\-speed mixed\-signal interface IP; direct experience with UCIe or another die\-to\-die interface is strongly preferred, and high\-speed SerDes experience is applicable * Working knowledge of the UCIe specification, including the PHY and D2D adapter layers, link initialization and training, sideband operation, and standard versus advanced package considerations * Advanced software development capability across multiple languages including Python, C, and C\+\+, with a strong command of software engineering best practices, data structures, and algorithms; experience with software version control systems such as GitLab and with issue and task tracking through Jira andConfluence is a plus * Demonstrated experience architecting complex software projects, including lab automation frameworks and Python UI development, that other engineers depend on * Expert\-level debug experience with high\-speed oscilloscopes, BERTs, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers, and the ability to extract meaningful signal integrity and protocol\-level insights from noisy lab data * Experience supporting customer silicon bring up and debug, including working in a customer lab environment and communicating findings directly to external engineering teams; experience with Signals \& Systems concepts, transmission line theory, and high\-speed link analysis applied to package, interposer, and substrate channels is a plus **Who You Are** * A sophisticated technical professional who applies advanced knowledge and wide\-ranging experience to resolve complex problems in creative and effective ways, not by following a checklist but by understanding the system deeply enough to know where to look * A seasoned lab engineer who is recognized as a go\-to resource for difficult silicon debug, whether the silicon is ours or a customer's, and who can diagnose problems under schedule pressure in an unfamiliar lab without losing your on * A mentor who invests in the growth of junior engineers and elevates the technical standards of the team, not by doing the work for them but by teaching them how to think through the problem * An effective communicator who can convey complex technical information to designers, management, and customers alike, adjusting the level of detail and framing to match the audience without losing the nuance * A collaborative influencer who can justify an approach and gain the cooperation of other groups across the department, even when your recommendation requires them to change their plan **The jobs.title: IT Security Pre-Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** We are seeking an **IT Security Pre\-Sales Engineer** to help customers identify cybersecurity needs and shape practical, scalable solutions. experience in a reseller, VAR, systems integrator, cybersecurity integrator, or technology consulting organization is strongly preferred. * Strong presentation, written communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to communicate with technical teams and executive stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities, work collaboratively across sales and delivery teams, and independently drive technical work in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to travel to customer locations, Technologent offices, vendor events, and industry conferences as required. This is an in\-office position for employees who live within 35 miles of a Technologent office. **Education and/or Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. * 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, technical pre\-sales, solution architecture, consulting, or a related customer\-facing technical role. * Relevant certifications are preferred, including CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security\+, GIAC, Microsoft Security, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Fortinet, Cisco Security, Zscaler, Okta, CyberArk, Splunk, SentinelOne, Wiz, or other relevant cybersecurity manufacturer certifications. jobs.title: Senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer
jobs.description: **Remote — International Hire ONLY \| Contract Full\-Time** **About TNT Growth** TNT Growth is a performance\-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact! **About the Role** We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking \& API Engineer who can independently own complex, production\-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad\-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data\-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid\-media measurement and strong client\-facing communication. This is not a tag\-only or passive back\-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad\-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non\-engineers, this role was designed for you. **What You'll Do** * **Strong Communication** + Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis + Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on + Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours + Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days * **Conversion Tracking Architecture \& Identity** Design, build, and maintain client\-side and server\-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform. * **CRM Integration \& Event Pipeline Management** Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call\-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad\-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead\-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail. * **Browser, Identity \& Cross\-Domain Instrumentation** Implement and debug GTM, server\-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first\-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel. * **Ad\-Platform API \& Payload Engineering** Build platform\-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution\-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics. * **End\-to\-End QA, Reconciliation \& Production Operations** Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad\-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch. * **TypeScript Development** Write clean, well\-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability. * **Data Layer \& Database Work** Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data. * **AI\-Assisted Development \& Tooling** Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed. * **Cross\-Functional Communication \& Ownership** Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non\-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow\-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team. * **Version Control \& Collaboration** Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality. **What We're Looking For** **Required** * Senior\-level, hands\-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly preferred * Hands\-on browser and server\-side instrumentation with GTM, server\-side GTM or equivalent, Google tag and GA4, deterministic dataLayer events, SPAs, redirects, cross\-domain and subdomain flows, embedded forms, and booking tools * Expertise in attribution identity and matchback: GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, first\-party session IDs, cookies or URL propagation, consent state, and CRM persistence * Deep knowledge of ad\-platform payload semantics, including event names, action source, account and action IDs, value and currency, timestamps and time zones, stable event or order IDs, browser and server deduplication, attribution windows, conversion adjustments or redactions, and partial\-acceptance diagnostics * Experience mapping CRM objects and lifecycle stages and integrating systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Attio, GoHighLevel, Typeform, or call\-tracking platforms through webhooks, change data capture, and APIs * Demonstrated ability to prove delivery end to end with synthetic tests, platform diagnostics, source, CRM, database, internal\-reporting, and ad\-platform reconciliation, match\-quality monitoring, alerting, incident response, and written QA evidence * Experience implementing consent\-aware tracking and privacy controls under GDPR, CCPA, and ad\-platform policies, including permitted PII collection, normalization and hashing exactly once, data minimization, and sensitive\-category restrictions * Strong understanding of API client design, REST and webhook integrations, OAuth and secrets handling, change data capture, rate limits, partial failures, and inter\-service communication patterns * Direct production experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, BullMQ, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, deduplication, retries and backoff, dead\-letter handling, replay, and high\-volume backfills * Proficient in TypeScript — clean, typed, testable, and maintainable across API clients, services, and asynchronous workers * Strong PostgreSQL and ORM fundamentals (Prisma, TypeORM, or equivalent), including diagnostic SQL, schema design, query and index optimization, and data retention * Strong working knowledge of paid\-media measurement: funnel and lifecycle event design, primary and secondary conversions, values, attribution windows, match quality, platform learning\-volume tradeoffs, and channel differences across Meta, Google, TikTok, and related platforms * Strong Git skills — branching, PR workflows, code review participation, and version control discipline * Practical fluency with AI development tools and the judgment to validate their output; AI expertise is secondary to conversion tracking, API, and backend engineering depth * Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including client\-facing technical discovery, implementation documentation, incident updates, and evidence\-based explanations **Compensation** This is a non\-US, long\-term contract role. * Non\-US Salary Range: $40k\-$80k (Based on Location and Skillset) * 12 Paid Holidays and 18 Paid Days Off Xh97EyUzbf

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - AI Platform (Forward Deployed Engineering and AI Builder Experience)(Remote Or Hybrid)
jobs.description: The pay range is $168,000\.00 \- $356,000\.00 Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well\-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits. JOIN TARGET AS A PRINCIPAL ENGINEER –AI PLATFORMS, FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING and AI BUILDER EXPERIENCE **About us:** Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. A role with Target’s AI Platform organization means the opportunity to build and evolve the foundational capabilities that enable teams across Target to develop, deploy, and operate AI\-powered products and experiences at enterprise scale. Our teams build platforms, frameworks, and developer experiences that make advanced AI technologies accessible, reliable, and scalable for engineers across the organization. As a **Principal Engineer – AI Builder Experience and Forward Deployed Engineering**, you will provide technical leadership for how engineering teams across Target build, integrate, deploy, and operate AI\-powered applications. You will work at the intersection of AI platform engineering, developer experience, and forward deployed engineering, partnering directly with product and engineering teams to accelerate complex and high\-value AI initiatives while shaping reusable capabilities for the broader engineering community. You will help architect and deliver production\-grade AI solutions, including agentic and LLM\-powered applications, while establishing scalable patterns for model and agent integration, enterprise context, evaluation, observability, deployment, and production operations. You will bring deep platform expertise directly to engineering teams, helping them navigate complex technical challenges and successfully move AI solutions from experimentation into production. A critical part of this role is translating real\-world implementation experience into improvements to the AI platform. You will identify recurring challenges and patterns across forward deployed engagements and turn those learnings into reusable APIs, SDKs, frameworks, developer tooling, reference architectures, and self\-service platform capabilities. Through this feedback loop, you will help reduce bespoke engineering and continuously improve the experience for the next generation of AI builders. You will also provide technical leadership for the end\-to\-end AI developer experience, including onboarding, development, experimentation, testing, evaluation, debugging, deployment, and observability. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product, architecture, and application teams to influence platform roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and create reference implementations that enable teams to adopt AI capabilities effectively and responsibly at scale. Given the pace of change in AI, you will stay current on emerging technologies and engineering approaches, evaluate and recommend new frameworks and tooling, publish learnings and reusable patterns, mentor senior engineers, and influence technical direction across the broader AI engineering ecosystem. We utilize Agile principles, follow best\-practice software design, participate in code reviews, and create maintainable, well\-tested codebases with relevant documentation. Core responsibilities of this job are articulated within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. About you: * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline or equivalent industry experience * 8 plus years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale software platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML systems, or distributed systems in production environments * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience and demonstrated ability to architect and deliver production\-grade systems * Experience designing and delivering AI applications, including LLM\-powered or agentic systems, and understanding of model integration, context and retrieval patterns, tool integration, evaluation, and production operations * Experience building developer\-facing capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, frameworks, libraries, developer tooling, templates, or self\-service platform experiences * Experience with modern AI engineering and platform technologies, including model APIs, agent development frameworks, evaluation and observability tooling, cloud platforms, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, and operational monitoring * Strong understanding of distributed system design, platform architecture, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, security, and production deployment considerations * Demonstrated ability to partner directly with engineering and product teams, understand complex implementation challenges, and translate those challenges into scalable technical solutions and reusable platform capabilities * Ability to operate effectively across the full engineering lifecycle, from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity * Ability to translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical approaches and create strong technical documentation, reference architectures, narratives, and recommendations for a range of audiences * Excellent communication and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to establish technical direction and drive alignment across engineering teams and organizational boundaries * Proven ability to mentor and provide technical leadership to senior engineers while influencing architecture and engineering standards without direct authority * Self\-driven and results\-oriented, with strong ownership, sound technical judgment, and the ability to balance near\-term delivery with long\-term platform scalability * Collaborative team player with experience working effectively across functions, organizations, and geographies, and with a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing This position may be considered for a Remote or Hybrid (known internally at Target as "Flex for Your Day") work arrangement based on Target's needs. A Remote work arrangement means the team member works full\-time from home or an alternate location that's not a Target location, does not have a desk at a Target location and may travel to HQ up to 4 times a year. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member's core role may be performed either remote or onsite at a Target location depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target.**Benefits Eligibility** Please paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou\_F**Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)** In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to candidate.accommodations@HRHelp.Target.com. Non\-accommodation\-related requests, such as application follow\-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Special Projects Group
jobs.description: **Project Coordinator, Special Projects Group** **Why Tarlton** Tarlton is a St. Louis\-based commercial, institutional, and industrial contractor. Our Special Projects Group handles the work that keeps our clients’ facilities running — renovations, upgrades, tenant work, and fast\-turn projects delivered under a Master Service Agreement (MSA) with a long\-standing client. The rhythm is different from a single large build. Several projects move at once, schedules are short, and the client counts on us being easy to work with. The Project Coordinator sits at the center of that: you set projects up, keep the paperwork and systems straight, and close them out. If you want to learn how a construction project actually runs from award through turnover, this is one of the best seats in the company to do it — and it is the first step in our project management career path. **Your Role** The Project Coordinator keeps project administration accurate and current so Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Superintendents can stay focused on execution. You will support projects from award through closeout — system setup, contract and financial paperwork, safety documentation, permitting, document control, and closeout records — across the Special Projects Group’s MSA portfolio. **What You'll Do** **Project Setup \& Systems** * Set up new projects in Viewpoint, Procore, and Egnyte, and keep records current as work progresses. * Upload drawings, specifications, and addenda, and distribute current revisions to the project team. * Maintain the project directory so subcontractor, vendor, and client contacts stay accurate. * Set up Building Connected sites and invite subcontractors. **Contract \& Financial Administration** * Track and file Owner Purchase Orders issued under the Master Service Agreement. * Support cost book setup and initial data entry with the Project Manager and Project Engineer. * Draft subcontract and purchase order requisition forms for Project Manager review. * Coordinate subcontractor pricing and draft proposals for approval before they go to the client. **Safety \& Site Access** * Schedule safety kickoff meetings and track Site\-Specific Safety Plans for each project. * Verify legal and OSHA\-required site postings are current, with the Safety Department and Superintendent. * Administer client badging and site access for Tarlton and subcontractor personnel, including logs, renewals, and client\-required training. **Documentation, Permitting \& Reporting** * Maintain submittal, RFI, and drawing logs. * Complete permit applications, track them through issuance, and distribute permit numbers to subcontractors. * Assemble quarterly client reporting across the MSA portfolio into a single master file. **Closeout** * Collect and file record drawings, warranties, and O\&M manuals. * Enter punch list items in Procore and assign them to subcontractors for review and distribution. * Support scheduling of pre\-commissioning, TAB, and final commissioning with the client, engineer, and subcontractors. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Experience** * Two or more years of administrative, project support, or coordination experience. Construction, engineering, or A/E industry experience preferred. * A track record of managing many small deadlines across concurrent projects without dropping items. * Comfortable working directly with subcontractors, vendors, and client contacts. * Construction management graduates and candidates with relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply. **Education \& Certifications** * High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business, or a related field preferred. * Valid driver’s license required. * OSHA 10 required within the first six months — we will get you there. OSHA 30 available. * Procore Project Manager (Project Management) certification within the first year — free, self\-paced, and built for project coordinators. * AGC Project Manager Development Program (PMDP) supported for those who want to grow toward Project Engineer. **Tools \& Software** * Procore — project setup, drawings, submittals, RFIs, punch list (training provided). * Viewpoint Vista — project setup, cost book entry, requisition forms. * Egnyte — file structure and document storage. * Building Connected — bid site setup and subcontractor invitations. * Microsoft Excel at an intermediate level for multi\-project trackers and reporting rollups. Word, Outlook, and Teams. * Bluebeam Revu preferred. **Work Location, Environment \& Travel Requirements** * Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment where the noise level is usually quiet. * If required, the employee may work from a jobsite trailer on occasion or owner\-designated office location. The noise level in the work environment can be loud due to heavy equipment, jack hammers, pneumatic tools, etc. These sounds can be non\-stop throughout the day. * Occasional local travel required between the office and project sites. * Occasional local or regional travel required for business or community events. **Tarlton Competencies** * **Leadership \& Team Development:** Provides clear direction, sets expectations, holds others accountable, and develops team members through coaching and support * **Stand Behind Our Word and Work:** Follows through on commitments, takes ownership of results, and ensures work meets high standards of quality and professionalism * **Cultivate Clients for Life:** Builds trust\-based relationships through responsiveness, clear communication, and understanding of client needs * **Build a Safe and Caring Environment:** Promotes a safety\-first culture, proactively manages risks, and looks out for others * **Gets the Job Done:** Takes ownership, removes obstacles, prioritizes effectively, and drives work forward to achieve results * **Communication and Collaboration:** Communicates clearly and works effectively across teams to build trust and alignment * **Develops and Adapts:** Seeks feedback, learns from experience, and adjusts to changing conditions and project needs **Why You’ll Like Working Here** * Complex, high\-impact projects with experienced teams * Strong partnership between field and project management * Safety\-first culture and high standards of quality * Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and long\-term career growth * A company proud to be STLMade and invested in the region **Let’s Build Together** If you’re interested in working on challenging projects with a collaborative, experienced team, we encourage you to apply. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Tarlton is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law. If you require assistance completing this application or need a reasonable accommodation, please contact recruiting@tarltoncorp.com or 314\.633\.3300 for support. Non\-Exempt

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: **WHY JOIN TAXRISE?** At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients. Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE** TaxRise is looking for a **Junior Software Developer** who is curious, technically capable, and eager to grow. This is an ideal opportunity for a recent graduate or early\-career developer who has built a technical foundation through school, internships, research, personal projects, freelance work, or simply building things on their own. We're not expecting you to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of software development, can work with existing code, and is comfortable learning by doing. You'll work on real projects from the start — making front\-end website changes, troubleshooting issues, working within existing codebases, using Git to manage and push code, and gradually taking ownership of larger projects. We're also looking for someone excited about how software development is changing. TaxRise embraces AI and emerging technology, and we want someone willing to experiment with AI\-assisted development tools, learn new ways of working, and use technology to become a more effective developer. *This role is 100% on\-site in Irvine, CA. If you're excited to work side\-by\-side with our team, we'd love to hear from you.* ### **HOW YOU'LL BE REWARDED** * **Base pay:** $80,000–$90,000 per year, depending on experience, technical ability, and demonstrated skills * Eligible for standard TaxRise benefits from day one of eligibility * Opportunity to grow your technical skills through hands\-on work with real production systems and projects ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Make front\-end changes and improvements to TaxRise websites and web applications. * Write, modify, test, and maintain code across existing applications. * Use Git and standard version\-control workflows to manage changes, push code, and collaborate with other developers. * Troubleshoot bugs and technical issues and work toward practical solutions. * Build and improve internal tools that help TaxRise teams work more effectively. * Collaborate with engineering, product, design, and business teams to turn ideas into working solutions. * Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment processes. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to support research, coding, debugging, documentation, and problem\-solving. * Take increasing ownership of features and projects as your skills develop. ### **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE** * A foundational understanding of software development and programming concepts. * Working knowledge of JavaScript and/or TypeScript. * Familiarity with HTML and CSS and the ability to make front\-end website changes. * Exposure to a modern front\-end framework such as React or similar technology. * Basic understanding of APIs and how front\-end and back\-end systems communicate. * Familiarity with Git, including repositories, branches, commits, and pushing code. * Ability to read existing code, research unfamiliar problems, and work toward a solution. * Strong communication skills and openness to feedback. * Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies and ways of working. ### **WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT** You don't need years of professional development experience to be a strong candidate. We're especially interested in people who can demonstrate that they like to build, explore, and figure things out. That might include: * Personal projects, GitHub repositories, or a technical portfolio * University or independent research * Internships, freelance development, or hackathons * Websites, applications, automations, or tools you've built on your own * Experience teaching yourself a new technology or experimenting with AI development tools A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is helpful, but demonstrated ability, curiosity, and willingness to learn are equally important to us. ### **WHO WILL THRIVE HERE** You'll likely do well in this role if you're someone who doesn't need every problem to come with step\-by\-step instructions. You research things you don't understand. You experiment. You ask good questions. You're willing to try an approach, learn from it, and change direction when there's a better solution. Most importantly, you're excited to keep learning. **We****'re looking for someone with a strong foundation, a curious mindset, and the drive to grow into an exceptional developer.** **WHAT WE OFFER** We believe in taking care of our team so they can take care of our clients. Here's what you can expect as part of the TaxRise family: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (starting after 60 days) * Paid Time Off * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Professional Development Program to support your growth * Access to our on\-site gym and gaming lounge * Catered team lunches every Friday * Fun and energizing quarterly company outings **ABOUT US** At TaxRise, our mission is simple yet impactful: to revolutionize the way taxpayers navigate their tax challenges. We believe in the power of lifting others up, and that's the driving force behind everything we do. When you join us, you're not just becoming part of a company; you're joining a movement. We're a team that thrives on celebrating successes and making a genuine impact on people's lives. We're proud to be the fastest\-growing company in our industry, and we're on the lookout for exceptional individuals to help us continue our journey of transformation. If you're ready to bring your unique talents and innovative spirit to a company where your work truly matters, TaxRise is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that's reshaping the future of tax resolution. **OUR COMMITMENT** At TaxRise, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We know that a world\-class culture stems from the diversity and talent of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. TaxRise is also committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. If you require any reasonable accommodation throughout the recruiting process, please let your recruiter know. **California Applicants:** Please review our Notice at Collection and California Privacy Policy before submitting your application by clicking here.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At Tecuity, we build the software that keeps state governments' business filings and public records running behind the scenes — real, meaningful infrastructure work from our tight\-knit team in Hyde Park, Utah. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer II, and while we'd love to find someone local to Cache County who can join us in office 4 days a week, we're just as glad to consider other Utah\-based candidates for a mostly remote setup with occasional office visits, or out\-of\-state applicants who could come on\-site around once a year, depending on our current employer status in that state. Sponsorship is not available for this position. The Senior Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining internet applications and related systems. The Senior Software Engineer II leads by example, following industry best practices, standards, and patterns to design optimal solutions to complex problems and create innovative, high\-quality solutions that meet our clients’ business needs and objectives. The Senior Software Engineer II understands the business value behind the product and must be talented in problem\-solving and making well\-reasoned decisions about software design and implementation based on knowledge and a broad range of experiences with different roles, technologies, and situations. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you are expected to be a technical authority on the business rules behind a filing type and to own complex features end to end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. You will make and guide cross\-cutting and architectural decisions, serve as a Peer Advisor and/or Team Lead to other software engineers (including reviewing Senior Software Engineer I work), and be a technical resource to project managers and business analysts in technical meetings. About the Work Our product serves Secretary of State offices – state government agencies responsible for business filings and other public records \- which means real filing deadlines, statutory requirements and citizens who rely on a working system. All new development happens on our modern .NET platform. We also maintain established .NET Framework (legacy) implementations currently in production or being migrated onto the modern platform; depending on your assignment, you may work in one or both. This is a mature, multi\-tenant product rather than a blank page. You’ll build new modules and capabilities on a well\-established modern stack, typically supporting more than one client implementation concurrently – each with its own database, release calendar, and statutes. That means real ownership: knowing the product and the client well, understanding business rules, questioning requirements that do not hold up, writing acceptance criteria and testing instructions for your own work, guiding other engineers on theirs, and seeing changes through to production. AI\-assisted development is not a pilot program here \- it is in full use and is a standard part of our engineers’ daily workflow. Claude Code is used actively and its role is expanding. You will be expected to lean into these tools to learn their strengths and failure modes firsthand and verify output rather than accept it. Our engineers treat AI as a fast, tireless collaborator that still requires oversight, and they leverage it to move considerably faster without lowering their standards. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will also help set the standard for how the team uses these tools, coaching other engineers on where they help and where they fall short. Essential Job Functions * Solve challenging problems by designing innovative, optimal solutions to complex problems. * Work closely with cross\-functional teams to gather and define requirements, determine level of effort, and contribute to user experience, design, and architecture decisions. * Serve as a key player in the implementation of software projects, including project schedules, milestones, and integration into the overall system. * Participate in all phases of the application development process. * Contribute quality code and strive for excellence within the team and company culture. * Lead the design and delivery of complex features and cross\-cutting or architectural changes across the web application, API, and database layers, with primary responsibility for their quality. * Translate business\-specific and statutory requirements into software components and applications, questioning requirements that do not hold up. * Serve as a Peer Advisor and/or Team Lead to other software engineers, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and support. * Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, including review of Senior Software Engineer I work, upholding Tecuity coding standards and Pull Request guidelines. * Write and maintain automated tests and keep changes passing pull request and build validation gates. * Use AI\-assisted developmen nctions * Experience with web technologies: ASP.NET, HTML5, JavaScript, AJAX, CSS, JSON * Practical experience with a component\-based JavaScript framework. (Our front end is React with Redux) * Experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Entity Framework Core, including migrations, alongside stored\-procedure based data access. * Experience writing automated unit tests and working in a codebase where tests gate the build. * Experience with Git in a branch\-and\-pull request workflow * Experience developing cross\-browser code and responsive CSS * Adept at database management, including designing and maintaining schemas across multiple client databases * Superior ability to write clear, concise, maintainable code * Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into functional products and solutions * Ability to efficiently identify and resolve issues that arise during the design, testing, and maintenance processes using superior problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to ensure the success of the team and project * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including participating in technical meetings with project managers and business analysts and writing clearly for non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to thrive and be productive with little or no supervision as well as in a collaborative environment * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-assisted development tooling while retaining full ownership of correctness, and to help other engineers do the same Preferred Qualifications * Experience with the Agile software development methodologies * Experience maintaining and modernizing long\-lived applications * Experience with Microsoft Azure application hosting, such as App Services, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and managed identity\-based configuration. * Experience consuming and upgrading versioned internal NuGet packages, and reasoning about the impact of a change across a dependency graph * Experience with structured logging and application monitoring, such as Serilog or Application Insights. * Experience with modern authentication, such as OpenID Connect, OAuth, or JWT. * Experience with configurable multi\-tenant or white\-label software, driven by client specifications. * Experience with government, regulated, or compliance\-driven software, and handling personally identifiable information. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps Pipelines. * Experience with web accessibility standards for public\-facing applications. * Experience with Windows desktop development, such as WinForms * Experience with reporting tools such as Active Reports Why Tecuity? Directly accountable for the value of the team's project portfolio, ensuring every initiative undertaken is clearly tied to process improvement, ease of deployment, and/or financial benefit. **Responsibilities** * Lead, manage, and develop the Process Technology Group — Process Engineers, Senior Associates, and Senior R\&D Process Engineers — providing day\-to\-day direction, coaching,
