Bash, Terraform, or similar tools where appropriate * Create and maintain knowledge articles, technical procedures, operational documentation, and service standards * Support risk and control activities by adhering to established policies, procedures, and operational standards * Recommend cost\-effective courses of action that support business and operational outcomes * Collaborate with peers, colleagues, managers, and third\-party vendors to resolve issues and achieve goals * Partner with senior infrastructure engineers on larger\-scale platform enhancements, new offerings, lifecycle work, and service improvements **Required Qualifications:** ============================ * 5\+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting Windows/Linux Server platform **Desired Qualifications:** =========================== * Strong customer\-facing skills with experience serving as a technical advisor to engineering, architecture, and project teams * Experience supporting enterprise environments across on\-premises, cloud, SaaS, end\-user computing, and hybrid platforms * Hands\-on experience with Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, virtualization, compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and endpoint technologies * Experience with VMware, Hyper\-V, Kubernetes, container\-based technologies, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform; multi\-cloud experience preferred * Experience evaluating, integrating, and operationally supporting emerging technologies, AI/ML platforms, enterprise SaaS solutions, innovation labs, proof\-of\-concept programs, sandbox environments, or pre\-production testing platforms * Experience supporting enterprise networking, identity, proxy services, secure connectivity, access management, endpoint management, or infrastructure automation * Ability to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and operational processes using PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, or similar tools * Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, problem\-solving, organizational, and customer service skills * Self\-motivated team player with technical curiosity, adaptability, attention to detail, and a passion for learning emerging technologies * Relevant cloud, infrastructure, virtualization, endpoint management, or security certifications are a plus; demonstrated hands\-on experience is valued most **Job Expectations:** ===================== * Ability to work nights, weekends, and/or holidays as needed or scheduled * Ability to lift 50\+ pounds * Visa sponsorship is not available for this position * This position offers a hybrid work schedule **Posting End Date:** 8 Oct 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Discovery Platform
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- Discovery shapes what buyers see when they open Whatnot, from the For You feed and search results to recommended live shows and listings. Discovery Platform builds the systems that make those experiences possible. Our team owns search infrastructure on OpenSearch, a low\-latency feature and key\-value serving layer, the retrieval framework that assembles feeds, and the pipelines that keep our indices fresh. Teams across Discovery and beyond rely on these systems to build and ship products. We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to lead technical work across Discovery Platform and product\-facing retrieval and recommendations. You'll spend roughly 60% of your time strengthening the platform's capacity, reliability, and shared building blocks, and 40% partnering with ranking and machine learning engineers to bring new discovery experiences to buyers. You'll join a small team of senior backend engineers who own their systems from design through production and on\-call. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role for someone who finds the most important problems in ambiguous spaces, creates a path forward, and builds solutions that improve both the buyer experience and the pace at which other teams can ship. What You’ll Do: * Design and evolve search and serving infrastructure that performs reliably through live shopping traffic spikes, including our largest sales events. * Build retrieval systems that let feed and search teams add candidate sources safely and quickly. * Partner with ranking and machine learning engineers to bring models and features into production with the latency and freshness they need. * Set technical direction for Discovery Platform and influence roadmaps across partner teams, using data and product outcomes to guide decisions. * Own complex systems end to end, from architecture and implementation through production operations and on\-call. * Raise the engineering bar through hands\-on contributions, design and code reviews, and mentorship. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York City, San Francisco, or Seattle hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Staff Software Engineer, you likely have: * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of full\-time software engineering experience, including building and operating large\-scale distributed systems in production. * A track record of leading substantial technical initiatives across teams, defining problems clearly, aligning partners, and shipping solutions through ambiguity. * Experience designing reliable, low\-latency backend systems such as search infrastructure, retrieval services, event\-driven systems, or streaming data pipelines. Experience with search or recommendations at scale is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience with technologies such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, Redis or Valkey, and Kafka or similar streaming systems. We value strong fundamentals and relevant systems experience over an exact match to our tools. * An understanding of how recommendation systems fit together, including candidate generation, ranking, and feature serving, and the ability to partner effectively with machine learning engineers. * Strong product instincts: you connect performance and reliability decisions to whether buyers discover things they want and whether sellers reach the right audience. * A commitment to hands\-on engineering, with the judgment to write code, document architectural decisions, and drive alignment when needed. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving the quality of designs, code, and operational practices. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $230K \- $290K

process, and field\-performance issues using structured problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis methods. * Identify and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness. * Establish and promote sound engineering standards, design practices, testing protocols, documentation requirements, and data\-analysis methods. * Create, review, and maintain engin ith patent or trade\-secret reviews when applicable. * Manage multiple engineering projects and priorities while meeting established technical, cost, quality, and schedule commitments. * Perform other jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Company Overview** World Emblem International is a global manufacturer of patches, emblems, and decorated products. The business operates on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central as its ERP, supported by custom middleware, ecommerce platforms, CRM/marketing systems, and production applications. As we invest in AI and modern analytics, we are building a centralized Data Lake / Data Warehouse on Microsoft Fabric to provide trusted, well\-modeled data across the business. ### **Role Summary** We are seeking a hands\-on **Senior Data Engineer** to build, scale, and own World Emblem’s new centralized data platform on Microsoft Fabric. Working within the Applications team and in close partnership with the Director of AI, you will be a key technical voice in the architecture and planning of the Data Lake / Data Warehouse project. You will design and build ETL/ELT pipelines from Business Central, custom middleware, ecommerce, and marketing systems, ensuring a solid foundation for AI initiatives and enterprise reporting. This is a **hands\-on build role**. You will write T\-SQL, design tables, views, stored procedures, and construct Fabric pipelines while taking full ownership of running and extending the platform in\-house. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Data Platform Architecture \& Build:** Participate in architecture planning for the Microsoft Fabric platform (OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, layered data zones, capacity structure, naming, and modeling standards). Partner with an external implementation partner during initial rollout and transition into full in\-house ownership. * **ETL / ELT Development \& Integration:** Design and maintain pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory (pipelines \& Dataflows Gen2\), Azure Data Factory, or SSIS. Extract data from Business Central, custom middleware, BigCommerce, HubSpot, and internal databases. Build incremental/CDC loads, error handling, retries, and idempotent processing. * **Database Engineering:** Build high\-standard tables, views, functions, stored procedures, and indexes across SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Fabric Warehouse. Design dimensional models (star schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCDs) and manage query performance, partitioning, and capacity planning. * **Data Quality \& Operations:** Implement automated quality checks for completeness, accuracy, and freshness. Reconcile key business metrics (orders, revenue, inventory) between source systems and the data warehouse. Monitor pipeline health, handle alerting, and resolve root\-cause data issues. * **Reporting \& AI Enablement:** Work with the Reporting Engineer to transition existing Power BI and SSRS reports to query the new platform instead of production databases. Deliver structured, documented datasets to the AI department for RAG systems, agents, and predictive analytics. * **Governance, Security \& CI/CD:** Implement RBAC, row/column\-level security, and data protection standards. Maintain data dictionaries and lineage documentation. Manage code, database objects, and deployment pipelines via Git and Azure DevOps. ### **Required Qualifications** * **7\+ years** of professional experience in data engineering and SQL Server database development, including production pipeline ownership. * **Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric** (OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, or Dataflows Gen2\) is **mandatory**. * **Expert T\-SQL skills:** Advanced database design, views, stored procedures, indexing, and query performance tuning. * Strong experience with **SQL Server** and **Azure SQL** (Azure SQL Database or Managed Instance). * Proven track record building ETL/ELT pipelines with Microsoft tooling (Fabric Data Factory, ADF, or SSIS) including incremental/CDC load strategies. * Strong expertise in **Data Warehousing \& Dimensional Modeling** (star schemas, facts/dimensions, SCDs). * Experience integrating data from enterprise ERPs via APIs, OData, web services, or database connections. * Hands\-on experience with **Git** and **Azure DevOps** for version control and CI/CD workflows. * Excellent technical communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to business stakeholders. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central** (or Dynamics NAV) data models and APIs. * Familiarity with **HubSpot, BigCommerce, Optimizely**, or manufacturing/production data environments. * Experience building **Power BI** semantic models (DAX) and migrating SSRS reports. * Relevant Microsoft Certifications: **DP\-700** (Fabric Data Engineer), **DP\-600** (Fabric Analytics Engineer), or **DP\-300**. * Experience preparing enterprise data pipelines for **AI / Machine Learning / RAG** use cases. **World Emblem is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).** Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. World Emblem is proud to be a drug\-free workplace. All applicants will undergo a criminal background check and pre\-placement drug screen, and we participate in E\-Verify. Monday \- Friday 8AM\-5PM EST

jobs.title: Cloud Administrator (AWS / Hybrid Infrastructure)
jobs.description: We're hiring a **Cloud Administrator** to support the **National Indian Gaming Commission (NIGC)**, the independent federal agency that regulates gaming on Indian lands under the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act. coordinate with the agency CISO on GuardDuty, Security Hub, and CloudTrail * Administer ADFS and Active Directory integration with AWS identity services **Server Operations \& Maintenance** * Maintain physical Dell servers, Windows and Linux VMs, and VMware ESXi hosts managed through vCenter across on\-prem and AWS environments * Perform OS patching, firmware/BIOS updates, capacity monitoring, SSL certificate renewals, and service restarts on approved patch schedules * Build and maintain Windows and Linux server baseline images (Sysprep, driver injection, licensing validation) in line with the agency's Standard Operating Environment * Deploy physical and virtual servers end to end, including rack\-and\-stack, RAID, iDRAC/iLO, OS install, VPC/subnet assignment, EBS attachment, and hardening * Notify the CIO and MSSP security team immediately on security incidents requiring server isolation, and follow incident response protocols aligned with NIST 800\-53 **Active Directory \& Identity Management** * Maintain domain controller health, including FSMO roles, replication, SYSVOL integrity, and DNS/SRV records * Develop and manage Group Policy Objects for all Windows devices on\-prem and in AWS, using GPMC and GPResult for auditing * Enforce a tiered admin model with RBAC, privileged account de\-provisioning, and monthly Domain Admin/Enterprise Admin audits * Run AD monitoring and produce automated daily compliance reports for the CIO through ADAudit Plus **Backup, Recovery \& Storage** * Administer Cohesity Helios backups, including scheduling, deduplication, retention, offsite sync, and daily job review * Perform file\-level, database, and application restores, instant VM recovery, and point\-in\-time rollbacks; lead annual DR and Bare Metal Recovery exercises * Maintain Dell PowerScale (OneFS), Dell Unity, QNAP, and other enterprise storage systems * Enforce least\-privilege access on storage, including iSCSI mapping, RBAC, ACL auditing, and security posture reporting **Database \& Application Server Support** * Support SQL Server clusters, MySQL, and Oracle servers at the OS level, including patching, certificates, and vendor updates * Lead third\-party vendor calls, manage vendor remote access/VPN sessions, and maintain IIS and Apache for agency\-hosted applications * Manage shared drive architecture, NTFS/NFS permissions, and group\-based ACL enforcement and auditing Required Qualifications * 7\+ years of enterprise systems administration, with 3\+ years at a Tier 3 or senior engineer level * Expert\-level Linux and Windows Server administration, including command\-line troubleshooting and scripting in Bash and PowerShell * AWS SysOps Administrator\-level experience with EC2, RDS, S3, Glacier, CloudFront, VPC, Route 53, Lambda, and CloudWatch in production * Hands\-on VMware vSphere/vCenter experience, including ESXi hosts, VM lifecycle, and snapshots * Active Directory administration expertise, including GPOs, FSMO roles, DC replication, and ADAudit Plus or similar tools * Experience with Dell PowerScale, Cohesity Helios, or equivalent enterprise storage and backup platforms * Working knowledge of NIST 800\-53 controls as applied to server hardening and vulnerability remediation Preferred Qualifications * AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or higher * Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate or equivalent * VMware Certified Professional (VCP\-DCV) * Prior experience supporting a federal agency IT environment **Clearance:** A favorable background investigation, conducted and adjudicated by the Office of Personnel Management (OPM), is required. Selected candidates must be eligible for and obtain an agency suitability determination and complete annual re\-badging. Benefits * 401(k) with company match * Dental, health, and vision insurance * Paid time off * Performance\-based bonuses * Opportunities for internal promotion and advancement within CTI's federal contract portfolio Why Team CTI For over 47 years, Cyber Technology Innovations (CTI) has delivered mission\-critical IT and R\&D services across federal, civilian, and defense agencies. Join a team of industry experts in a fast\-growing organization where your growth is earned on merit, not measured by your time in a seat. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description: DropX is an out\-of\-home delivery and returns network built for how people shop and return today. Through a growing network of pickup and drop\-off locations, service centers and hubs across the US, DropX gives marketplaces and retailers a faster, lower\-cost way to move parcels in both directions. Headquartered in Long Island, New York. Take a signed retailer or marketplace from contract to steady\-state volume — integration, process, sites and first scans — and hand a working account to the Account Manager. **Launch Ownership** * Own the launch plan for every new account from signature to steady state * Set the scope, the milestones and the go\-live criteria, and hold the date * Chair the launch call and keep one plan that Commercial, Technology and Operations all work from * Say when an account is not ready to go live, and why **Integration** * Own the integration for each client flow end to end — label, API and scan events — working with Technology rather than waiting on it * Define the scan events and data a new flow depends on before it goes live, not after * Test end to end with the client before first volume, including exception paths * Confirm the client’s systems and DropX’s reconcile before the first invoice **Network Rediness** * Work with the Regional General Managers and the Head of Network Development so sites, PUDO points and service centres are ready ahead of first volume * Check capacity against the committed ramp, not against today’s volume * De\-risk each launch before go\-live rather than fixing it afterwards **Process \& Runbook** * Build the operating runbook for each new client flow: steps, owners, systems and handoffs * Define exception handling before launch — failed scans, missed collections, returns that stall * Brief station teams and Quality Controllers on what is changing and what good looks like * Make the process repeatable so the second launch is faster than the first **Volume Ramp \& Handover** * Manage the ramp from pilot volume to committed volume against the agreed curve * Watch first scans, acceptance SLA and cost per return daily through the ramp * Hand the account to the Account Manager at agreed steady state, with the runbook and the open items written down * Run a launch review and feed what went wrong into the next one **Skills \& Experience Required** * 5\+ years in implementation, onboarding or programme delivery in parcel, returns, e\-commerce or retail technology * Has taken clients live, not only planned launches * Comfortable between a client’s technical team and a service centre floor in the same day * Able to build process and tooling where none exists yet * Strong with data — defines the measures, builds the reporting and acts on it **Technical Competencies** * Able to read an API specification and hold a technical conversation with a client’s engineers without a translator * Understands label generation, scan events, webhooks and file\-based integrations — EDI, SFTP , CSV — well enough to see what will break before it does * Can test an integration independently: build the test payloads, trace a parcel through its scan events and find where the data stops * Comfortable querying operational data directly, in SQL or equivalent, rather than waiting for a report * Advanced Excel proficiency; working fluency with AI tools and order management systems * Able to build lightweight tooling and reporting without engineering support **Desirable** * PUDO or out\-of\-home returns launch experience * Marketplace or 3PL integration experience * Early\-stage experience, establishing process from inception Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
jobs.description: **About the Role** iCapital is seeking an Associate AI Engineer to help build and scale production\-grade AI systems that deliver real business outcomes. This role is ideal for an engineer early in their career who enjoys turning ambiguous problem statements into working systems, and who pairs creative problem\-solving with disciplined measurement, reproducibility, and operational rigor. This individual will be on the AI/ML team and will work closely with senior AI and machine learning engineers, as well as cross\-functional partners, to design, implement, evaluate, and operate AI capabilities as APIs and services in a real\-world FinTech environment. This individual will be expected to bring strong analytical fundamentals, curiosity, and a bias toward delivering robust, maintainable systems. **Responsibilities** * Design and implement modular AI capabilities including LLM\-based reasoning, document intelligence (OCR/IDP), intelligent knowledge systems, and agentic orchestration to power internal and external workflow automation. * Own components of the full AI system life cycle to achieve tangible business outcomes, including scoping, POC, solution design, model development, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement in production environments. * Build robust evaluation pipelines for AI systems, defining statistically sound, problem\-specific metrics, constructing and curating benchmark datasets, and enforcing strict dataset and model versioning to ensure reproducibility and continuous improvement. * Collaborate across teams and communicate results clearly via documentation, write\-ups, and handoffs. **Qualifications** * 2\-3 years of relevant experience, including hands\-on experience developing production AI/ML systems, including exposure to AWS or cloud\-native development patterns for AI/ML workloads, and familiarity with AI development life cycle best practices * Strong proficiency in Python * Solid fundamentals in statistics, exploratory data analysis, and the ability to reason about data quality, experiments, and error patterns * Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to document work and collaborate in a team setting * Experience with modern LLM tooling (i.e. transformers, unsloth, vLLM, agentic frameworks) or document AI approaches (IDP) * Familiar with software development best practices (source control, CI/CD, testing, documentation) and working through a full development lifecycle * Experience with various agentic communication protocols, (i.e. MCP, A2A) is a plus **Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $130,000\. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full\-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: **About mPulse:** mPulse is the leader in conversational AI and member engagement for healthcare. We partner with the nation's most innovative health plans — Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Commercial — to engage members in conversations that close care gaps, improve Stars ratings, and drive better health outcomes. Our platform reaches tens of millions of Americans and is built on the belief that better health starts with better conversations. **Job Summary:** mPulse is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Data Engineer II to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and platform capabilities that support our analytics, product, and AI/ML initiatives. Our data platform processes high\-volume, high\-velocity healthcare data, enabling insights and data\-driven solutions for a growing client base. You will work cross\-functionally with Data Operations, Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to ensure data is reliable, performant, and aligned with business needs. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL, Python, dbt, and Airflow, along with a solid foundation in data warehousing and a passion for solving complex data challenges in a healthcare environment. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to support ingestion, transformation, and delivery of high\-volume healthcare data. * Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries for data transformation, validation, and performance tuning. * Develop and manage workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow, including DAG creation, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Enhance and scale data platform capabilities to support analytics, product features, and AI/ML use cases. * Build and maintain data quality frameworks, including automated data profiling, validation, and testing processes. * Monitor and optimize pipeline performance, reliability, and efficiency in production environments. * Analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable solutions, clearly communicating findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Data Operations, Product, Analytics, Data Science) to gather requirements and deliver high\-quality data solutions. * Partner with clinical and analytics teams to operationalize data\-driven insights and reporting solutions. * Contribute to documentation of data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. **Skills/Abilities/Experience:** * Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex querying, data transformation, and performance optimization. * Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and integration tasks. * Experience designing and building data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to support data ingestion, transformation, and delivery. * Hands\-on experience with modern data warehousing platforms, such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, or Microsoft SQL Server. * Experience with workflow orchestration tools, particularly Apache Airflow (DAG development, debugging, and maintenance). * Experience using dbt (data build tool) to develop, test, and manage modular data transformation workflows. * Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly AWS (e.g., S3, RDS, Lambda, Glue, DMS). * Experience with version control systems and collaborative development workflows, such as GitHub or Bitbucket. * Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools, such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Experience supporting data quality initiatives, including data profiling, validation, or monitoring frameworks. * Familiarity with data modeling and data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling. * Exposure to analytics, reporting, or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) is a plus. * Experience working with healthcare data, including claims or clinical datasets, is a plus. * Familiarity with data science or machine learning workflows from a data engineering perspective is a plus. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a related field. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and identify root causes. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional environments, working with engineering, product, analytics, and operations teams. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment. * Demonstrates self\-awareness, with the ability to recognize and communicate individual strengths and areas for growth. * Shows a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and support team members, contributing to a collaborative and positive team environment. * Effectively communicates progress, priorities, and status updates to both internal and external stakeholders in a clear and timely manner. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to stand and sit for extended period of time. * Ability to lift 50 lbs. weight. Why mPulse? • * Remote\-First \& Flexible PTO — work from wherever you're most productive * 100% Company\-Paid Employee Coverage \- Medical, dental, and vision plans with a 100% company\-paid employee\-only option, plus company contributions toward dependent coverage and company\-paid life and disability insurance. * 401(k) \+ 4% Match — with financial advisors to help you plan * 6 Weeks Parental Leave * Invest in You — 30\-60\-90 day plans and frequent training * Culture of Recognition — peer\-to\-peer bonuses \& team celebrations **Equal Opportunity:** mPulse is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions at mPulse are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. * If you require any accommodations during the application, interview, or assessment process due to a disability or any other accessibility\-related concern, please do not hesitate to reach out to our People Ops and Recruiting team at careers@mpulse.com

jobs.title: Manager, Commissioning (AMERS - Monarch)
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Nscale is building the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI. Our data centers are purpose\-built for high\-density GPU compute, which means power and cooling systems that push well past traditional enterprise loads and leave very little margin for error. The Commissioning Manager owns the commissioning program for one of our data center builds from design review through Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and handover to operations. You will lead the third\-party Commissioning Agent, coordinate the general contractor and trade partners, and report directly to the on\-site Senior Construction Manager as Nscale's accountable voice on whether a system is truly ready to carry customer load. You will manage a small team of commissioning engineers and work closely with Design, Construction, Quality, and Data Center Operations. This is a hands\-on leadership role. We need someone who is as comfortable walking down a switchgear lineup or witnessing a start\-ups of mechanical system and can running a Cx coordination meeting or reporting readiness risk to senior leadership. **Key Responsibilities** * Commissioning program ownership — develop and own the Owner's Project Requirements (OPR) alignment, Commissioning Plan, and Cx schedule for the site, fully integrated with the master construction schedule * Cx Agent and contractor management — direct the third\-party Commissioning Agent and hold the GC, MEP trades, and OFCI vendors accountable for Cx deliverables, quality, and dates * Design and submittal review — review design documents, Basis of Design, sequences of operation, and submittals for commissionability, maintainability, and resilience * Level 1–5 execution — oversee factory witness testing (FWT), installation verification, pre\-functional checks, functional performance testing, and Level 5 IST, including load bank and failure\-scenario testing * Electrical systems — lead commissioning of MV/LV switchgear, transformers, UPS, BESS, generators, ATS/STS, busway, and PDUs/RPPs, including coordination with NETA acceptance testing * Mechanical and liquid cooling — lead commissioning of chillers, cooling towers/dry coolers, CRAH/fan walls, pumps, CDUs, and direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling loops, including flushing, fill, and water\-quality verification * Controls and monitoring — verify BMS, EPMS, and DCIM point\-to\-point checks, alarms, sequences, and integration with Nscale's operations tooling * Issues and risk management — run the Cx issues log, drive deficiencies to closure, and escalate schedule, safety, or quality risks early and clearly * Safety — Help monitor and enforce lockout/tagout, energization procedures, NFPA 70E arc\-flash practices, and Nscale site safety standards during all testing activities * Reporting — deliver weekly Cx status, readiness dashboards, and executive\-level go/no\-go recommendations ahead of each energization and handover milestone * Handover to operations — ensure complete O\&M manuals, as\-builts, test records, training, warranties, and spare parts are turned over so Operations can run the facility from day one * Continuous improvement — capture lessons learned and help build Nscale's commissioning standards, scripts, and templates for future sites * Team leadership — hire, coach, and lead commissioning engineers and technicians on site **Qualifications** **Required** * 5\+ years of commissioning experience in mission\-critical facilities, with at least 2 years leading Cx on data center or similar critical\-facility projects * Proven experience delivering Level 1–5 commissioning, including leading Level 5 IST on a live project * Deep working knowledge of data center electrical (MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, switchgear) and mechanical (chilled water, heat rejection, air handling) systems * Experience managing third\-party Commissioning Agents and holding general contractors and trades to schedule and quality * Strong understanding of ASHRAE Guideline 0 and 1\.1, NFPA 70E, NETA ATS, and relevant local electrical and building codes * Ability to read and interpret electrical single\-line diagrams, P\&IDs, controls sequences, and construction drawings * Excellent written and verbal communication, including reporting to senior leadership * Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience in the field **Preferred** * Commissioning certification such as CxA (ACG/BCxA), CCP (AABC), or CPMP * Experience commissioning high\-density AI/GPU halls, including direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling and CDUs * Hyperscale or colocation owner\-side experience * Experience with BESS, on\-site generation, or utility substation interconnection * Professional Engineer (PE) license or OSHA 30 certification * Background in data center operations or critical facilities engineering **Character \& Conduct** **What We Value Most: Character \& Conduct** Technical skills can be taught. Character cannot. At Nscale, we're looking for people who show up with integrity, treat others with respect, and take genuine ownership of their work. As a senior leader on the program, this individual also sets the tone for every direct report and site team they oversee. The following traits matter as much to us as any credential or years of experience: * Integrity — does the right thing even when no one is watching; never misrepresents status, costs, or progress to protect themselves or their team * Ownership mentality — treats the program as their own and holds themselves and their direct reports accountable without being told * Respectful under pressure — stays composed and professional with contractors, trades, direct reports, and internal Nscale teams regardless of the circumstances * Transparent communicator — surfaces problems early and honestly, never buries bad news, and expects the same from the teams they lead * Team\-first attitude — ego stays at the gate; the program and the people on it come first * Reliable and consistent — shows up prepared, follows through on commitments, and does what they say they will do We actively seek references that speak to a candidate's character, not just their technical output. **Tools \& Software** * Commissioning platforms — CxAlloy, Facility Grid, or equivalent Cx management software * Construction management — Procore and/or Autodesk Construction Cloud * Scheduling — Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project * Drawings and documents — Bluebeam Revu, AutoCAD/Revit viewers * Controls and monitoring — BMS/EPMS/SCADA platforms (e.g., Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, Johnson Controls Metasys) * Microsoft 365 — advanced Excel for test tracking, issue logs, and reporting **Work Environment \& Schedule** * Hybrid schedule — split between the West Virginia construction site and remote work; on\-site presence required for testing, inspections, coordination meetings, and key milestones * On\-site work includes time in electrical rooms, mechanical yards, rooftops, and data halls * Standard schedule is Monday–Friday, with extended hours, nights, and weekends required during energization, IST, and critical milestones * Travel up to 20% for factory witness testing and support of other Nscale sites *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: As vCluster’s **AI Infrastructure Specialist,** you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production\-ready deployment. This is not a traditional professional services role; you operate pre\-sale as part of a proof of value engagement scoped to reach production. You will be one of the first team members a neocloud or AI Factory engages with at a technical depth, and the playbooks you develop will scale the motion for the next hire and customer. vCluster is gaining rapid traction with GPU AI Clouds and enterprises building AI Factories: organizations that need to offer Kubernetes as a managed service on bare metal GPU infrastructure, and need to do it fast. This role exists to make that happen. **As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, your role will include:** * **Lead Technical Deployments:** Drive end\-to\-end technical deployments for GPU neocloud and AI Factory customers, from initial bare metal configuration to a validated vCluster environment. * **Infrastructure Optimization:** Configure and troubleshoot bare metal GPU node infrastructure, including CNI configuration, GPU Operator setup, distributed storage backends, and RDMA/InfiniBand. * **Validation:** Deploy and validate Kubernetes and vCluster to provide GPU\-powered managed K8s. * **Knowledge Transfer:** Work alongside customer teams to build self\-sufficiency, ensuring they can operate and grow the platform independently. * **Scaling through Documentation:** Document reusable playbooks and deployment architectures so your learnings become the next customer's head start. * **Feedback Loop:** Collaborate with Engineering and Product to surface recurring infrastructure challenges, acting as a direct feedback loop from the field into the roadmap. * **Strategic Partnering:** Join Sales in the pre\-sales process where deep infrastructure work is required to achieve a meaningful proof of value. **This role could be a fit for you if you bring:** * **Production K8s Mastery:** 5\+ years of experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production, ideally on bare metal or in high\-complexity environments. * **GPU Fluency:** Practical knowledge of NVIDIA GPU Operators, CUDA tooling, and systems\-level configuration for GPU nodes. * **Networking Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of CNI plugins, overlay networks, load balancing, and connectivity diagnosis in layered environments. * **Storage Expertise:** Experience with persistent volume configuration, CSI drivers, and distributed systems like Ceph, Rook, Weka, or Longhorn. * **Operational Agility:** Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where you are often writing the playbook in real time. * **Modern Tech Mindset:** You thrive in environments that reject legacy tech and prefer a modern stack where you can solve a variety of problems from pipelines to internal services. ### **Bonus points for:** * **Automation Skills:** Experience writing automation scripts with Bash, Python, or Go. * **Kubernetes Depth:** Relevant certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or experience writing Kubernetes Operators. * **AI/ML Familiarity:** Experience with inference serving, GPU scheduling, and the tooling around LLM deployment. * **Documentation:** Experience building AI Automation in documentation to contribute to a shared knowledge base. **About vCluster Labs** ----------------------- We're the \#1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest\-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture\-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top\-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper\-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote\-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler\-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12\+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50\+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40\+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000\+ GitHub stars and 40M\+ tenant clusters created since 2021\. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes\-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU\-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA\-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. **Benefits** We offer the following benefits: * **Competitive Salary**: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. * **Premium Insurance**: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). * **Flexible Working Schedule:** You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. * **Workplace Flexibility:** We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. **Culture \& Values** --------------------- At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for: * **Make it Happen:** We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. * **Own the Outcome:** We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. * **Create Wow:** We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. * **Open Source, Open Mind:** We are actively contributing to and maintaining open\-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. * **Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally:** We don't just ship software; we define the state\-of\-the\-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission\-critical infrastructure platforms. Compensation Range: SGD 155K \- SGD 175K
